title: Reddit Marketer
description:
**Company Description** 
 IECHM Technology Private Limited is a one\-stop OEM manufacturer based in Chennai, India, specializing in turning ideas into real\-world products. The company manages the entire product journey under one roof, including concept development, design, engineering, and manufacturing, without relying on external vendors. IECHM offers free design, engineering, and consultation services, allowing clients to pay only for manufacturing. The team supports projects at any stage, from initial idea or sketch to prototype and full\-scale production, across all sectors except chemical and textile. This integrated approach gives IECHM a dynamic environment focused on innovation, practical problem\-solving, and end\-to\-end product development.
   

**Role Description** 
 This is a remote internship role for a Reddit Marketer. The Reddit Marketer will help build awareness of IECHM by identifying relevant subreddits, participating in discussions, and sharing informative, non\-spammy content aligned with community guidelines. Day\-to\-day tasks include researching target communities, drafting and posting content, monitoring comments, and responding to questions about IECHM’s services in a helpful and professional manner. The role also involves tracking engagement, summarizing insights from Reddit conversations, and collaborating with the team to refine messaging and campaign ideas. Interns will gain experience in community\-driven marketing, brand positioning, and content experimentation on Reddit.
   

**Qualifications**
  

* Ability to understand and navigate Reddit communities, including familiarity with subreddit rules, upvotes, threads, and Reddit etiquette.
* Strong written communication skills, with the ability to create clear, concise, and community\-appropriate posts and comments.
* Basic awareness of digital marketing principles, online community building, or social media engagement.
* Research skills to identify relevant subreddits, analyze audience interests, and surface discussion topics connected to product development and manufacturing.
* Interest in technology, engineering, product design, or manufacturing, and willingness to learn about IECHM’s services.
* Self\-motivated, able to work independently in a remote setting, manage time effectively, and provide regular updates on activity and results.
* Prior experience using Reddit, or any community platform, for personal or project\-related purposes is an advantage but not required.
* Students or early\-career professionals from any discipline are welcome; no specific degree is mandatory.

title: Junior Executive - Communication and PR/ Accounts
description:
**Company Description** 
 Asha Chennai is a Chennai\-based organization located at Luz Avenue in Mylapore, Tamil Nadu, India. The organization operates from a centrally accessible urban location, making it convenient for collaboration with local partners and stakeholders. Asha Chennai is involved in activities that require dedicated communication and coordination, offering opportunities for early\-career professionals to grow. Team members work closely with local communities and organizations, contributing to meaningful initiatives in the region.
   

**Role Description** 
 The Junior Executive – Communication and PR/Accounts role is a full\-time, on\-site position based in Chennai. The role involves drafting and distributing press releases, preparing communication materials, and supporting strategic communication initiatives to enhance the organization’s visibility. The Junior Executive will assist in managing media relations, coordinating with journalists and media outlets, and maintaining contact databases. Day\-to\-day responsibilities include writing content for internal and external communication, supporting basic accounts\-related documentation and reporting, and collaborating with team members to ensure consistent messaging. The role may also involve organizing events, tracking communication activities, and providing administrative support related to communication and PR.
   

**Qualifications**
* Strong communication and strategic communications skills, with the ability to convey clear and consistent messages.
* Experience or interest in press releases and media relations, including coordination with media contacts.
* Proficiency in writing for different formats, such as emails, reports, and public\-facing content.
* Basic understanding of accounts or administrative documentation, with attention to detail and accuracy.
* Good organizational and time\-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple tasks in a fast\-paced environment.
* Comfort working on\-site in Chennai and collaborating with diverse teams and stakeholders.
* Bachelor’s degree in Communications, Public Relations, Journalism, Business, or a related field preferred.
* Prior internship or entry\-level experience in communication, PR, or accounts is an advantage.

title: I&P GN - Song – Service- Consultant - Process Excellence-PE
description:

**Location:** 
 Bangalore/ Gurgaon/ Mumbai/ Pune/ Hyderabad/ Chennai

 Process Excellence, Process Re\-engineering, Customer Service Transformation, Lean Six Sigma
   

  

**Good to have skills:** 
 Customer Experience Design, AI\-enabled Process Design, Process Mining, CCaaS, CRM, Operating Model Design
   

  

**Experience:** 
 Minimum
 **4**

**Job Summary:**
 As a Service Operating Model \& Process Design Team Lead/Consultant, you will support process and service transformation engagements, from assessing market, customer, and technology shifts through defining future\-state process and service strategies and enabling adoption. You will combine process re\-engineering and Lean Six Sigma rigor with customer experience design to diagnose service friction, quantify its impact, and design practical future\-state processes, operating models, technology enablement, and AI integration. You will produce structured analytical work and supporting materials that enable senior practitioners to shape transformation recommendations.

* Design future\-state process specifications covering AI integration points, operating model changes, human\-machine interaction requirements, and workforce adoption approaches for the assigned domain.
* Map and model current\-state and future\-state service processes using structured notation and modelling tools; document handoffs, decision points, and channel transitions across the customer journey.
* Apply Lean Six Sigma methods, including DMAIC, value stream mapping, and root cause analysis, to identify service\-process inefficiencies and quantify improvement opportunities.
* Develop customer journey maps and service blueprints that identify key touchpoints, friction points, and opportunities to improve experience and efficiency.
* Conduct process analysis and support the delivery of digital and platform solutions across operations, including contact centre and customer service technology.
* Build analytical frameworks and data\-driven assessments using AI\-assisted visualization and analysis tools; connect process metrics to customer outcomes such as first contact resolution, handling time, containment, and satisfaction.
* Conduct benchmarking analysis using AI\-accelerated industry and peer\-comparison tools.
* Develop change\-impact assessments using AI\-assisted organizational analysis tools.
* Use relevant AI tools across tasks and deliverable creation, including creating agents and other tools that support analysis and delivery.
* Apply industry or function knowledge to review and improve domain\-specific reinvention designs and functional playbook content.


**Professional \& Technical Skills:**
**Basic Qualification** 
 :
   

  

* Proficiency in process modelling tools and software such as Visio, ARIS, or Signavio.
* Experience with process mining and data analytics tools such as Celonis or Power Automate.
* Working knowledge of how AI and automation integrate into business\-process and customer\-service design.
* Exposure to customer service or contact centre operations, including familiarity with core service metrics.
* Excellent analytical, problem\-solving, and project\-management skills.
* Ability to analyze data and translate findings into structured recommendations for senior review.


**Preferred Qualification:**
* Experience in a management consulting firm.
* Exposure to CRM or contact centre platforms such as Salesforce, Genesys, or Amazon Connect.
* Strong analytical skills and the ability to communicate complex findings in clear business terms.
* Experience working on proposals and contributing to business\-development activities.
* Lean Six Sigma certification, with Green Belt or above preferred.


**Additional Information:**
* The ideal candidate combines process\-analysis capability, customer\-centric service design, AI\-enabled transformation, and the ability to develop structured recommendations.

title: Information Technology System Administrator
description:
**About Brite** 




 Brite Systems Inc. is a U.S.\-based, AI\-led digital transformation company and a Top 1% Salesforce Summit Partner. Since 2006, we have helped government and nonprofit organizations modernize their technology, improve operations, and deliver better outcomes for the communities they serve.

We’re proud to be recognized among Indiana’s fastest growing companies, named to the Inc. 5000 list of America’s fastest\-growing private companies, and recognized as a Great Place to Work in Indiana for seven years. *

* 
* Install, configure, and maintain Windows operating systems and standard business applications.
* 
* Support Microsoft 365 applications including Outlook, Teams, Word, Excel, and OneDrive.


- 


**User Administration** 








* Create, modify, and deactivate user accounts.
* 
* Manage password resets and access permissions.
* 
* Configure email accounts, distribution groups, and shared mailboxes.
* 



**Asset Management** 




  




* Maintain the IT asset inventory, including laptops, desktops, monitors, and accessories.
* 
* Track asset allocation, returns, warranty details, and lifecycle.
* 
* Coordinate procurement and replacement of IT equipment.


- 


**Ticket Management** 








* Log, prioritize, and resolve support tickets within defined SLAs.
* 
* Escalate unresolved issues to Level\-2 or specialized support teams.
* 
* Maintain proper documentation of incidents, resolutions, and root causes.


- 


**Infrastructure Support** 








* Assist in configuring and troubleshooting LAN, Wi\-Fi, VPN, and internet connectivity.
*

* Assist with software deployment and patch management.

* Prepare laptops and user accounts for new employees.

**Documentation \& Compliance** 








* Maintain knowledge base articles and standard operating procedures (SOPs).
*

title: CloudOps Engineer III
description:
PDI Technologies is looking for a Cloud Operations Engineer III to join our CloudOps team, supporting managed cloud infrastructure for our enterprise customers on AWS. This is a senior operational role for someone who can take ownership of complex, high\-impact environments, work confidently and independently, and act as a clear communication point between customers, Professional Services, and the wider CloudOps team.
 


  


  
 


  


 You'll combine hands\-on technical delivery with strong stakeholder communication — leading incident response and change activity, running and contributing to governance and status meetings, and keeping the team informed and aligned. You'll be trusted to use your own judgement and initiative to drive issues to resolution, backed by the support and expertise of an experienced team.
 




  




**Job Responsibilities:** 
  
* Manage and support enterprise customers' cloud infrastructure on AWS, ensuring availability, performance, and security of production environments
  
* Monitor and respond to alerts via observability tooling, triaging and resolving incidents in line with agreed SLAs and SLOs.
  
* Lead incident response and root cause analysis (RCA) for complex or high\-severity issues, producing clear write\-ups and remediation actions.
  
* Carry out change management activities — including deployments, security patching, and infrastructure updates following established change control and CR governance processes.
  
* Administer and optimise AWS database infrastructure (e.g. RDS), including performance tuning, troubleshooting, and exposure/risk remediation.
  
* Support compliance and audit activity (e.g. SOC audits), ensuring operational practices meet security and regulatory requirements.
  
* Identify and help deliver cloud cost optimisation opportunities.
  
* Maintain accurate tickets, documentation, and workaround registers, and help close down accumulated technical debt
  

  



  




**Communication \& stakeholder management:** 
  
* Communicate clearly and confidently with customers, Professional Services, and internal stakeholders, both verbally and in writing
  
* Plan, schedule, and run operational and governance meetings — setting clear agendas, driving decisions, and tracking follow\-up actions to completion.
  
* Provide regular, well\-structured status updates and reporting back to the wider CloudOps team, keeping colleagues informed of progress, risks, and changes.
  
* Represent CloudOps professionally in customer\-facing forums, translating technical detail into clear, actionable communication for a range of audiences.
  

  



  




**Requirements :** 
  
* Significant experience in a Cloud Operations, DevOps, or Site Reliability Engineering role, ideally within AWS environments
  
* Strong working knowledge of core AWS services (e.g. EC2, RDS) and cloud infrastructure operations
  
* Experience with monitoring/observability tooling, incident management, and change management processes.
  
* Understanding of security patching and compliance/audit processes (e.g. SOC 2\).
  
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the confidence and credibility to lead meetings and communicate outcomes back to the team and to customers.
  
* Strong organisational skills and the proven ability to manage competing priorities under your own initiative.
  
* A collaborative team player who is equally comfortable working independently and knowing when to seek support from the team.
  
* Relevant AWS certification(s) desirable.
  

  



  




**Behavioral Competencies:** 
  

  
* Cultivates Innovation
  
* Decision Quality
  
* Manages Complexity
  
* Drives Results
  
* Business Insight
  

  


  





  




  



 PDI is committed to offering a well\-rounded benefits program, designed to support and care for you, and your family throughout your life and career.  This includes a competitive salary, market\-competitive benefits, and a quarterly perks program. We encourage a good work\-life balance with ample time off \[time away] and, where appropriate, hybrid working arrangements.  Employees have access to continuous learning, professional certifications, and leadership development opportunities. Our global culture fosters diversity, inclusion, and values authenticity, trust, curiosity, and diversity of thought, ensuring a supportive environment for all.
 



  


 We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: Assoc, Production Eng, WRB Tech
description:
**Job Summary**
 The role is accountable for providing tactical and operational support for production services across one or more technology platforms/domains, ensuring optimal service stability, availability, performance, and resilience.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Ensure maximum service quality and production stability through rapid and effective response to technical incidents, while driving continual service improvement through trend analysis, problem management, and proactive identification of improvement opportunities.
* Manage technical recovery and service restoration for High Severity Incidents (CERT/MIM), service outages, and medium/high severity incidents, providing end\-to\-end support and implementing timely resolutions within agreed SLAs.
* Lead and coordinate incident management activities, including stakeholder communications, escalation management, and technical bridge facilitation during critical incidents.
* Perform root cause analysis (RCA) for High Severity and recurring incidents, ensuring corrective and preventive actions are identified, tracked, and implemented to closure.
* Own the operational stability, availability, and performance of production systems, directing second\- and third\-level support teams for problem diagnosis and resolution in accordance with agreed SLAs and OLAs.
* Manage production changes, releases, deployments, and rollouts with zero or minimal impact to business services. Ensure comprehensive implementation, validation, rollback, contingency, and communication plans are in place for all production activities.
* Review and assess the impact of dependent changes across applications, infrastructure, databases, middleware, cloud platforms, and networks to minimize production risk.
* Drive proactive monitoring and event management by identifying opportunities for automation, alert optimization, early issue detection, and operational efficiency improvements.
* Support capacity management, resiliency testing, disaster recovery (DR), and business continuity planning (BCP) activities to ensure operational readiness.
* Create, maintain, and continuously improve Production Engineering documentation, operational procedures, runbooks, recovery guides, knowledge articles, and contingency plans.
* Ensure adherence to operational governance, security, compliance, audit, and risk management requirements across supported services.
* Provide inputs to the PE Manager for operational dashboards and service reviews, including incident trends, problem trends, availability metrics, service improvement plans (SIPs), RCA action tracking, and platform health indicators.
* Collaborate with application development, infrastructure, security, architecture, and business teams to improve reliability, reduce technical debt, and enhance service resilience.
* Participate in and support cross\-training, knowledge transfer, mentoring, and capability\-building activities within the Production Engineering organization.
* Identify and drive opportunities for automation, shift\-left initiatives, operational simplification, and reduction of manual effort to improve service reliability and support efficiency.
* Act as a technical lead during major incidents, complex problem investigations, production go\-lives, and critical business events, providing technical guidance and decision\-making support to internal and external stakeholders.


**Strategy**
* To be accountable to execute the strategy devised for the business unit


**Business**
* Fully accountable in incident, problem, change and risk management which relates to the production application/system.


**Processes**
* Create, Review and update Production Engineering documentation. Update of contingency (DR/BCP) documentation and processes


**People \& Talent**
* Participate in cross\-training and knowledge transfer activities within support teams


**Risk Management**
* Responsible to proactively identify the risks in the application and manage the mitigation actions. Responsible for managing, tracking and timely closure of risks and other compliance related issues in Risk wise (Information Security risks) \& M7 (Operational Risks).


**Governance**
* Provide inputs to management for monthly dashboard that provide information on incident and problem trends along with SIP and RCA Action Items.


**Regulatory \& Business Conduct**
* Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
* Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
* Lead the \[team] to achieve the outcomes set out in the Bank’s Conduct Principles: \[Fair Outcomes for Clients; Effective Financial Markets; Financial Crime Compliance; The Right Environment.]
* Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.


**Key stakeholders**
* PE Manager / PE Lead
* Application Development Teams
* Business \& Product Stakeholders
* CIO / Technology Leadership
* Infrastructure, DBA \& Platform Teams
* Security, Risk \& Compliance Teams
* Change, Release \& Service Management Teams (ITCRM)
* MIM / CERT Teams
* External Vendors and Service Providers


**Other Responsibilities**
* Embed Here for good and Group’s brand and values in the SRE team; Perform other responsibilities assigned under Group, Country, Business or Functional policies and procedures; Multiple functions (double hats)


**Skills And Experience**
* AWS
* Oracle
* Linux
* Kubernetes
* API


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related experinece.
* Minimum 7\+ years of experience in application Production support responsibilities and stability as part of SRE.
* JAVA / J2EE / Spring MVC, Spring Boot \& Hibernate is mandatory
* Any one of the database DB 2 / Oracle / PostgreSQL
* Linux is must have
* Knowledge in Kubernetes, AWS
* Tomcat/Jboss must have skill
* Elasticsearch should have proficient user experience
* Grafana should have proficient user experience

We question the status quo, love a challenge and enjoy finding new opportunities to grow and do better than before. **What We Offer**
**In line with our Fair Pay Charter,**

* Presentation Skills

title: Director of Academics and Operations
description:
Why this role exists
 



 Miller is a training institute the Teceze group has designed but never launched. You are hired to open it, run it and make it pay.
 



**What exists:** 
 thirty full curricula — ten AI, twenty technology — each 60 classes of three hours; nine timings across weekday and weekend patterns; two programme types, Professional and Career with a 26\-week internship; a working platform with trainer allocation, enrolment, ratings and three role portals; a marketing site with a course finder, thirty course pages and 270 FAQs; and the group's delivery reach across eleven APAC markets and the US.
 



**What does not:** 
 students, contracted trainers, revenue or published fees. The 1,800 per\-class entries are generated scaffolding, not authored lesson material. Nobody reads the leads, counselling requests and enterprise enquiries the site collects, and no email or SMS is sent to anyone. Several student\-facing promises — free counselling, two\-day responses, replacement trainers, three months of LinkedIn Learning Premium valued at INR 25,000 — are not yet operationally or contractually backed.
 



 The mandate
 



 Ninety days from your start date, three things must be true. A first cohort is teaching — on the published timetable, with contracted trainers, against material someone actually wrote. Fees are published and backed by a cohort\-level cost model you can walk through line by line. And every enquiry is answered by a named person within a stated time, through a funnel you can measure. Year one is yours to plan once those three hold.
 



 What you will own
 



**Curriculum and academic quality.** 
 Turn scaffolding into teaching material; decide what "ready to teach" means and refuse to launch a cohort below it. Keep the AI tracks current as models and tooling move. Own assessment — twelve checkpoints, the class\-30 review, the panel\-defended capstone, and what a Miller certificate actually asserts. Run a proper pilot on one track before committing the catalogue to market.
 



**Operations and delivery.** 
 Timetable and batch opening, attendance, labs, student support across 6 AM to 9 PM starts, trainer absence and cover, the enquiry\-to\-enrolment path, and the internship placements the Career programme already promises.
 



**Faculty.** 
 Recruit, audition, contract, coach and pay the trainer panel. Faculty supply is the most likely cap on year\-one growth. The group's engineering bench is both the obvious first pool and an obvious trap: a strong engineer is not automatically a trainer.
 



**Marketing, admissions and sales.** 
 You carry the enrolment number personally. Set fees, build the channel mix, run admissions as a sales team, and audit every public claim — make it true or take it down.
 



**Enterprise.** 
 A managed\-learning offer is already written: six services and three commercial models. Validate what is deliverable, price it, sell corporate cohorts, and sign nothing carrying SLAs that operations cannot hold.
 



**P\&L.** 
 Build the cohort\-level model before a fee is published, then own the levers: price, fill rate, trainer cost per contact hour, cost per enrolment, content amortisation. Report monthly on enrolments, revenue recognised versus collected, contribution by track, cash and forecast. Decide which tracks stay closed this year, and defend it.
 



**Compliance and team.** 
 Entity and licensing, student contracts, refund policy, data protection, advertising standards. Hire deliberately against the P\&L, and own the technology backlog without writing the code.
 



 The first ninety days
 


* **Days 1–30** 
 — read every curriculum, audit every public claim and either back it or remove it, draft the cohort\-economics model, and name the three to five tracks that launch first.
* **Days 31–60** 
 — author and quality\-assure the launch content, recruit and contract the first trainers, publish fees, and stand up enquiry handling with a named owner and a response SLA.
* **Days 61–90** 
 — run the pilot cohort and sit in it yourself, open paid enrolment on the launch tracks, turn on measured marketing spend, and present a year\-one plan built on economics you have tested rather than assumed.



 How you are measured
 



 Contribution margin per cohort and overall; cost per enrolment by channel; batch fill rate; completion and capstone pass rates; student satisfaction and refund rate; active trainers and time to staff a batch; enterprise pipeline and SLA attainment; tracks at teaching standard. And one that outweighs its size — unbacked public claims, at zero within sixty days and staying there.
 



 What we need from you
 


* Ten or more years in education, training or skills delivery, at least three carrying a revenue or P\&L number
* Evidence of building something from nothing, and a clear account of the parts that failed
* Real P\&L ownership: you can build a unit\-economics model and defend it under questioning
* A selling record you personally own — consumer admissions at volume, or enterprise training contracts
* Operational credibility somewhere a failure is visible to a customer within the hour
* Enough technical literacy to judge a curriculum and tell a strong trainer from a confident one
* The judgement to say no: to an unbacked claim, an unstaffable cohort, a model\-breaking discount
* Comfort doing work beneath your title for the first six months



 Desirable: experience in the APAC markets or the US, a live enterprise L\&D network, a practitioner background in AI, cloud or security, and accreditation experience.

title: Senior Research Engineer
description:
Lincoln Electric is a high\-performance industrial machinery and technology leader who helps customers manufacture and maintain vital equipment and infrastructure. Lincoln Electric’s innovative solutions enable higher quality and productivity across a variety of processes including welding, cutting, brazing, machining, process automation, and field repair. The Company leverages proprietary technologies and expertise in materials science, power electronics, automation, and intelligent software to help customers build better and achieve resilience in their operations. Headquartered in Cleveland, Ohio, Lincoln Electric is the essential ‘Linc’ that keeps the economy running. The Company operates 71 manufacturing and automation facilities across 20 countries and serves customers in over 160 countries. For more information about Lincoln Electric and its products and services, visit the Company’s website at https://www.lincolnelectric.com.
   

  

 Location:
 **Chennai**
 Req ID:
 **30172**
 Job Responsibilities
   

  

 Help transform welding flux development from an empirical, trial\-and\-error process into a predictive, data\-driven materials engineering discipline. The role focuses on understanding how variability in inorganic raw materials influences manufacturing behavior and welding performance, and applying Quality\-by\-Design (QbD), advanced analytics, and computational methods to develop more robust and consistent consumable products.
   

  

* Develop analytical characterization strategies for flux raw materials using techniques such as XRD, XRF, ICP, SEM\-EDS, FTIR, Raman spectroscopy, and thermal analysis.
* Apply statistical methods, chemometrics, and Bayesian optimization to understand the impact of raw material variability on product performance.
* Establish Quality\-by\-Design (QbD) frameworks by identifying Critical Material Attributes (CMAs) and linking them to manufacturing and welding outcomes.

title: Systems and Infrastructure Engineer III
description:
**About The Team**
 Walmart is seeking a Systems and Infrastructure Engineer III to support and operate the Walmart Cloud Native Platform (WCNP) — Walmart's enterprise Kubernetes platform powering thousands of cloud\-native workloads across global production environments. This is a platform support and operations role that demands strong hands\-on expertise in Kubernetes, container networking, load balancing, CI/CD tooling, and observability. The successful candidate will partner closely with application teams to deliver reliable platform operations, drive automation to eliminate toil, and build AI\-assisted tooling to accelerate incident response and platform efficiency. A solid understanding of container networking, traffic management, and load balancing is essential for success in this role.
   

  

 What You'll Do
   

  

 Platform Support and Operations: Serve as a primary support contact for WCNP\-hosted workloads across production and non\-production environments, managing cluster health, workload triage, incident response, and on\-call operations to meet platform SLOs.
   

  

 Cluster Build, Upgrade and Maintenance: Participate in provisioning and hardening new WCNP clusters, plan and execute cluster version upgrades with node pool rotations and control plane validations, and perform routine maintenance including node patching, certificate rotation, and etcd health checks.
   

  

 CI/CD Pipeline Support: Build, maintain, and troubleshoot CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins/GitHub Actions equivalent, integrating compliance gates and security scans and supporting application teams in adopting Golden Path deployment standards.
   

  

 Observability and Incident Response: Troubleshoot issues using monitoring solutions using Prometheus, Grafana and OpenObserve; build dashboards and alerting rules; and produce well\-documented RCAs to drive preventive action and reduce MTTR.
   

  

 Networking and Load Balancing Support: Provide hands\-on support for container networking and traffic management — Kubernetes Services, Ingress controllers, Istio service mesh, DNS, TLS termination, and load balancer configurations — diagnosing and resolving east\-west and north\-south traffic issues.
   

  

 Configuration and Change Management: Author, validate, and manage KITT configurations (Helm\-based), Kubernetes manifests, RBAC, and network policies, coordinating all changes through ServiceNow Change Management with full version control and peer review.
   

  

 Capacity Planning and Right\-Sizing: Analyse workload resource utilisation across namespaces and node pools, and implement right\-sizing strategies, HPA/VPA configurations, and autoscaler policies to balance cost and service\-level targets.
   

  

 Security and Compliance: Implement and audit Kubernetes RBAC, Pod Security Standards, Network Policies, and secrets management; integrate container image scanning into pipelines; and support compliance reviews against PCI\-DSS, SOC2, and Walmart InfoSec standards.
   

  

 Cross\-Team Collaboration and Knowledge Sharing: Partner with application, SRE, and security teams to onboard services onto WCNP, resolve platform blockers, and contribute to run books, playbook, and platform documentation.
   

  

 Automation and DevOps: Design and implement automation pipelines using Concord and Looper to eliminate manual toil in deployments, provisioning, and remediation workflows, and build reusable Helm charts to standardise platform operations.
   

  

 AI\-Assisted Automation and Tooling Development: Develop operational tools and utilities leveraging Python scripting and AI/LLM APIs — including log analysis assistants, alert triage helpers, and run book automation agents — to reduce manual effort and improve support response quality.
   

  

 What You'll Bring
   

  

 Bachelor's/Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field with 6\+ years of experience in infrastructure engineering, platform operations, or DevOps roles.
   

  

 Kubernetes Expertise: Deep, hands\-on experience with Kubernetes administration and operations — cluster lifecycle management, workload diagnostics, RBAC, autoscaling (HPA, VPA, Cluster Autoscaler), and multi\-cluster management. Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA) preferred.
   

  

 Networking and Load Balancing: Strong understanding of Kubernetes networking — Services, Ingress controllers, CoreDNS, CNI plugins, and Network Policies. Hands\-on experience with Istio service mesh for traffic management, mTLS, and L4/L7 load balancing in containerised environments.
   

  

 Cloud\-Native Platform Knowledge: Strong experience with enterprise Kubernetes platforms such as GKE, or AKS. Familiarity with Helm for deployment configuration and internal developer platform standards.
   

  

 DevOps and CI/CD: Strong experience with CI/CD pipeline tools such as Jenkins or GitHub Actions. Proficiency in GitOps workflows and progressive delivery strategies. Familiarity with policy\-as\-code tools like OPA or Kyverno (deployment gate system).
   

  

 Coding, Scripting, and Automation Tooling: Proficiency in Python and Bash for operational automation and tooling development. Ability to build lightweight CLI tools and automation scripts integrating with platform APIs.
   

  

 Observability: Hands\-on experience with Prometheus, Grafana, OpenObserve, or Datadog for SLO\-based alerting, operational dashboards, and log\-based health monitoring.
   

  

 Cloud Platforms: Experience with GCP or Azure, deploying and operating containerised workloads in cloud\-native environments.
   

  

 Security and Compliance: Working knowledge of Kubernetes RBAC, Pod Security Standards, Network Policies, mTLS, secrets management (Vault, ExternalSecrets), and compliance frameworks including PCI\-DSS and SOC2\.
   

  

 AI and Automation: Basic knowledge of AI/LLM API integration and prompt engineering to build operational tools such as log analysis assistants, alert triage helpers, and runbook automation agents. Curiosity to apply emerging AI capabilities to reduce operational toil.
   

  

 Incident Management: Experience in L2/L3 incident triage, root cause analysis, post\-incident reviews, and on\-call operations with a focus on reliability improvements.

title: Lead Cyber Security
description:
As a Senior Application \& Cloud Security Engineer (IC3\), you will take end\-to\-end technical ownership of our application security posture across Web, Mobile (iOS/Android), and Cloud (AWS) environments. You will be responsible for threat modeling, conducting deep\-dive vulnerability assessments (VAPT), embedding automated security gates into CI/CD pipelines, engineering advanced AWS WAF custom rules \& perimeter defenses, and leveraging Observability/SIEM platforms for proactive threat detection and incident monitoring.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities \& Core Scope** 



* **Web \& Mobile Application Security (AppSec)**
* **Web Application Security: Conduct comprehensive manual and automated vulnerability assessments (VAPT) across web platforms and microservice APIs based on OWASP Top 10 and OWASP API Security Top 10\.**
* **Mobile Application Security (iOS \& Android): Perform static and dynamic security assessments aligned with OWASP Mobile Application Security (MASVS) — auditing secure data storage, certificate pinning, biometric authentication, deep linking, reverse\-engineering resistance, and third\-party SDK security.**
* **Secure SDLC \& DevSecOps Automation: Integrate, tune, and scale SAST, DAST, and SCA tools (e.g., Semgrep, Checkmarx, Veracode, Snyk, SonarQube, OWASP ZAP, Burp Suite) inside GitHub Actions / GitLab CI pipelines with minimal developer friction.**
* **Threat Modeling: Lead collaborative threat modeling sessions (STRIDE / MITRE ATT\&CK) with developers and architects during sprint planning and architectural design phases.**
* **Vulnerability Remediation: Work directly with product engineering teams to provide code\-level remediation guidance, root\-cause analysis, and verification testing.**
* **AWS Security Hardening: Architect and maintain hardened AWS multi\-account structures (AWS Organizations, Control Tower, SCPs) aligned with CIS AWS Foundations Benchmarks.**
* **IAM \& Secrets Management: Design least\-privilege IAM policies, role\-based access controls, automated credential rotation, and secure key management via AWS KMS and Secrets Manager.**
* **Container \& Kubernetes Security: Enforce runtime protection, image scanning, and network policies for Docker containers and Kubernetes (EKS/ECS) workloads.**
* **Infrastructure as Code (IaC) Security: Automate Terraform security auditing using tools such as Checkov, tfsec, and Trivy before deployments hit production.**
* **Perimeter Defense \& WAF Customization**
* **AWS WAF Engineering: Architect, deploy, and fine\-tune AWS WAF and Amazon CloudFront security configurations across all edge endpoints.**
* **Custom Rule Development: Write custom regex rules, rate\-limiting policies, IP set filtering, and bot control rules to mitigate Layer 7 DDoS, credential stuffing, scraping, and zero\-day vulnerabilities.**
* **Security Observability Platforms: Monitor security telemetry across platforms such as Elastic/OpenSearch, AWS CloudWatch, or Coralogix.**
* **Threat Detection \& Alerting: Aggregate and correlate security logs (VPC Flow Logs, CloudTrail, ALB logs, WAF logs, GuardDuty findings) to build high\-fidelity detection rules and actionable alert dashboards.**
* **Incident Response Support: Assist in triaging security events, performing log forensics, and automating alert escalations to reduce Mean Time to Detect (MTTD) and Mean Time to Remediate (MTTR).**
* **Compliance Alignment: Provide technical evidence and enforce controls for SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, and CIS Benchmarks.**
* **Tooling \& Cost Efficiency: Optimize security tool utilization, eliminate redundancy, and identify cloud architecture cost savings.**



**Mandatory Qualifications (Must\-Haves):** 



* Experience: 6–9 years in Application Security, Cloud Security, and DevSecOps.
* AppSec Mastery: In\-depth knowledge of Web \& Mobile (Android/iOS) security testing, API penetration testing, and secure code review.
* AWS Cloud Security: Hands\-on experience securing AWS services (IAM, VPC, KMS, GuardDuty, Security Hub, S3, EKS/ECS).
* WAF \& Edge Defense: Proven experience configuring AWS WAF / CloudFront, including authoring custom WAF rules, rate limiting, and bot protection.
* Observability Experience: Practical experience querying and setting up alerts in modern observability/SIEM tools (e.g., Datadog, Splunk, ELK, CloudWatch, Sumo Logic).
* CI/CD Integration: Experience automating SAST/DAST/SCA scanners inside CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, GitLab, Jenkins).
* Threat Modeling: Solid track record using STRIDE and MITRE ATT\&CK frameworks for architecture reviews.



**Bonus / Good\-to\-Have (Optional):** 



* Certifications: Relevant offensive/security certifications: OSCP, AWS Certified Security – Specialty, eWPTX, CEH, or CISSP.
* Emerging Tech: Experience or research in AI/LLM Security (OWASP LLM Top 10, Prompt Injection defense, RAG security).
* Prior experience managing, administering, or launching a Responsible Disclosure Program (VDP) or Bug Bounty program (e.g., HackerOne, Bugcrowd, or internal security policy) is a strong added advantage.

**About Team**

We build the technology that powers Walmart's pharmacy, specialty pharmacy, and wellness platforms spanning prescription management, clinical workflows, patient\-facing digital experiences, and health program delivery. Our systems process millions of prescriptions annually and connect patients, pharmacists, prescribers, and payers in real time. The team operates at the intersection of technology and healthcare, building platforms that have a direct, measurable impact on patient outcomes and community health.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
 As a Quality Engineer III for Walmart Health \& Wellness, you'll have the opportunity to:
   

  

 Design, develop, and maintain robust automated test frameworks and test suites that validate the quality, reliability, and compliance of Walmart's pharmacy and health platforms
   

  

 Collaborate with software engineers, product managers, and clinical stakeholders to define acceptance criteria, test strategies, and quality gates across the SDLC
   

  

 Build and execute end\-to\-end, integration, regression, and API test suites for critical healthcare workflows including prescription processing, patient data management, and clinical integrations
   

  

 Ensure all test coverage adheres to HIPAA compliance requirements and that test environments handle sensitive patient health information (ePHI) with appropriate data masking and privacy controls
   

  

 Integrate automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines to enable continuous quality validation and fast feedback loops for development teams
   

  

 Perform thorough defect analysis, document bugs with precision, and work closely with engineers to drive timely resolution of issues
   

  

 Contribute to shift\-left quality practices — participate in design reviews, requirement grooming, and early\-stage risk identification to prevent defects before they reach production
   

  

 Adhere to Company policies, procedures, mission, values, and standards of ethics and integrity
   

  

**What You'll Bring**
 BE/B Tech/ME/MTech in Computer Science or related technical field
   

  

 Minimum 3\+ years of hands\-on experience in software quality engineering with a focus on test automation
   

  

 Test Automation — Java Stack — Proficiency in Java for building and maintaining automation frameworks; TestNG / JUnit 5, Selenium WebDriver with Page Object Model (POM), Maven / Gradle
   

  

 API Test Automation — Hands\-on experience with REST Assured and Postman / Newman; validating JSON / XML responses, status codes, schema validation, and end\-to\-end API workflow testing

 Engineering Fundamentals — OOP basics, Git branching strategies, code reviews, defect lifecycle management, and test documentation practices
   

  

 Soft Skills — Analytical and detail\-oriented mindset, precise defect reporting, collaborative, strong ownership of quality outcomes

description:
**Role: Lead Data Annotation \& AI Evaluation Specialist** 




**Experience: 5–8\+ years** 




**Location: Chennai** 




**Notice Period : Immediate** 




  





**Role Summary** 




 Objectways is seeking a highly technical
 **Lead Data Annotation \& AI Evaluation Specialist** 
 with at least
 **5 years of hands\-on experience in complex data annotation, AI/ML data operations, or model evaluation** 
 .
 



 This role will lead technically complex AI data projects involving LLMs, agentic AI, multimodal data, computer vision, NLP, model evaluation, safety evaluation, and human\-in\-the\-loop workflows.
 



 The ideal candidate must be able to take a detailed customer specification,
 **read it end\-to\-end, understand the technical and operational intent, identify ambiguities and risks, design the annotation/evaluation workflow, create examples and edge cases, define QA criteria, and guide an annotation team through successful execution.** 




 This is
 **not simply a people\-management or annotation\-production role** 
 . We need someone who can think technically and act as the bridge between the customer specification, engineering/ML teams, and annotation operations.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Read and interpret complex customer annotation, data\-generation, and AI\-evaluation specifications.
* Convert requirements into clear
 **SOPs, annotation guidelines, decision trees, examples, edge cases, and QA checklists** 
 .
* Independently determine how a project should be executed rather than waiting for step\-by\-step instructions.
* Design annotation schemas, taxonomies, labels, metadata, acceptance criteria, and review workflows.
* Understand complex multi\-turn conversations, model behavior, tool calls, system prompts, agent trajectories, and contextual dependencies.
* Work with
 **JSON/JSONL, structured data, APIs, tool\-call traces, logs, model outputs, and annotation platforms** 
 .
* Create gold\-standard examples and benchmark datasets before production begins.
* Conduct pilot annotations personally and identify gaps in customer guidelines before scaling to the annotation team.
* Define inter\-annotator agreement, arbitration, QC sampling, error taxonomy, and acceptance thresholds.
* Analyze disagreements and distinguish
 **annotator error, guideline ambiguity, tooling issues, and genuinely ambiguous data** 
 .
* Train annotators and reviewers on technically complex projects and certify readiness before production.
* Work closely with engineering and ML teams to understand model inputs/outputs and improve annotation tooling and workflows.
* Communicate directly with customers or internal project teams to raise technically meaningful clarification questions.
* Monitor production quality and identify systematic errors rather than simply reporting aggregate accuracy.
* Perform root\-cause analysis and recommend changes to guidelines, workflows, tooling, or training.
* Own annotation quality from
 **requirements → pilot → production → QC → delivery** 
 .



  





**Technical Skills** 




 The candidate should be comfortable with:
 


* LLMs and Generative AI
* AI agents and multi\-turn conversational systems
* Prompt/response evaluation
* AI safety and model behavior evaluation
* NLP annotation and classification
* Annotation schema and taxonomy design
* JSON/JSONL and structured datasets
* Tool calls, API concepts, and structured model outputs
* Python or SQL at a working level
* Regular expressions and basic scripting/data analysis
* Annotation platforms such as CVAT, Label Studio, Encord, SageMaker Ground Truth, or equivalent
* Quality metrics including accuracy, precision/recall, confusion matrices, IAA/Cohen's Kappa/Fleiss' Kappa
* Dataset validation and error analysis

title: Senior SFMC & Data Cloud Solution Specialist
description:

Your work will bring clarity, speed, and measurable value to our collaborators.
   

  

 You will join a high\-performing, digitally savvy team that partners across functions to unlock the full potential of Salesforce Marketing Cloud and Data Cloud. Your work will enable smarter targeting, seamless integrations, and reusable assets that scale globally. Can you see yourself being responsible for the journey from design to activation, and mentoring others to set the standard as we move faster together?
   

  

**Accountabilities**
* Omnichannel Solution Ownership: Lead design, configuration, implementation, testing, deployment, monitoring, and optimization of Salesforce Marketing Cloud solutions that deliver measurable outcomes.
* Journey Orchestration: Build sophisticated, cross\-channel journeys in Journey Builder using precise entry criteria, decisioning, goals, re\-entry rules, contact policies, and exits to drive conversion and retention.

* Cross\-Functional Partnership: Translate marketing and business requirements into scalable, supportable technical solutions; collaborate with data, architecture, product, and IT teams to resolve ingestion, identity, consent, and performance challenges.
* Reusable Accelerators: Identify automation and platform improvements; build reusable components, standards, and accelerators to increase speed\-to\-market across brands and markets.
* Technical Leadership: Provide code reviews, troubleshooting, documentation, training, and mentoring for junior team members; chip in to solution architecture, design documentation, estimation, governance, and handover.
* Continuous Improvement: Optimize performance, enforce coding standards and coordinate release management, and champion guidelines that drive operational efficiency and consistent quality.


**Essential Skills/Experience**
* Strong hands\-on expertise in Email Studio, Content Builder, Contact Builder, Journey Builder, Automation Studio, MobileConnect, MobilePush, CloudPages, and SFMC setup or administration.
* Experience in carrying out email, SMS, WhatsApp, and push notification use cases.
* Advanced AMPscript and SSJS; strong HTML/CSS; working knowledge of JavaScript, JSON, and reusable development patterns.
* Expert SQL skills and strong understanding of relational data models, Data Extensions, segmentation, data quality, retention, and contact architecture.
* Good hands\-on knowledge of REST and SOAP APIs, authentication, web services, webhooks, SFTP, connectors, and integration troubleshooting.
* Minimum 1\-2 years of hands\-on implementation experience with ingestion, harmonization, identity resolution, segmentation, calculated insights, and activation.
* Experience with testing, QA, deployment, monitoring, incident resolution, performance optimization, documentation, and release governance.
* 5\+ years of overall experience in marketing automation or marketing technology, including substantial hands\-on Salesforce Marketing Cloud implementation experience.
* Minimum 1\-2 years of hands\-on Salesforce Data Cloud implementation experience is mandatory.
* Proven experience delivering solutions for multiple clients, business verticals, brands, or geographies in a consulting, shared\-services, agency, or enterprise environment.
* Experience owning technical workstreams or solutions from discovery and design through build, deployment, and operational support.
* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, computer science, information technology, business systems, or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.
* Confidently engage with global stakeholders, clarify requirements, challenge assumptions constructively, and communicate risks, dependencies, and recommendations.
* Facilitate solution workshops, technical discussions, demonstrations, knowledge\-transfer sessions, and structured training programs.
* Mentor junior developers and campaign specialists through coaching, code reviews, reusable standards, and hands\-on problem solving.
* Demonstrate strong ownership, customer focus, collaboration, analytical thinking, and the ability to make informed decisions in ambiguous situations.
* Present technical concepts clearly to both technical and non\-technical audiences.


**Desirable Skills/Experience**
* Awareness or practical exposure to Marketing Cloud Next, including its evolving capabilities and alignment with Data Cloud\-led marketing workflows.
* Experience connecting SFMC and Data Cloud with Salesforce CRM, external content platforms, consent systems, analytics platforms, or other enterprise applications.
* Knowledge of Salesforce Personalization, Einstein capabilities, MuleSoft, Apex, SOQL, DevOps or CI/CD practices, and source\-control workflows.
* Exposure to regulated\-industry campaign operations, privacy, consent, data\-governance, and security requirements.
* Relevant Salesforce certifications such as Marketing Cloud Engagement Administrator, Developer, Consultant, Email Specialist, or Data Cloud Consultant.

title: Principal-Security Engineering
description:
When you join Verizon
   

  

 You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. At Verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. We do what we love — driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. Our V Team is a community of people who anticipate, lead, and believe that listening is where learning begins. In crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere \& always. Want in? Join the \#VTeamLife.
   

  

 Verizon is seeking a highly technical, hands\-on Principal Security Engineer to join our Data as a Service (DaaS) \& Analytics team. In this senior individual contributor role , you will act as the technical North Star for our analytics engineering teams, driving the cloud\-native automation strategies required to expose critical enterprise security data via robust APIs and interactive dashboards. This is an execution\-focused, "hands\-on with code" position. You will architect and build modern data products, leveraging the Google Cloud Platform (GCP) ecosystem to design scalable ETL/ELT pipelines and serverless application architectures.
   

  

**What You’ll Be Doing...**
* Architecting and optimizing large\-scale security data repositories within Google BigQuery, ensuring efficient partitioning, clustering, and storage tiering to support multi\-terabyte analytical queries.
* Designing and implementing robust, low\-latency data pipelines using GCP Dataflow services (Apache Beam) to ingest, transform, and aggregate batch and streaming data from disparate security sources into centralized data platforms.
* Designing and maintaining optimized data layers using the GCP Cloud SQL (PostgreSQL engine) to support high\-throughput analytics and data consumers.
* Leading analytics engineers technically to architect and deploy production\-grade automation solutions. Utilize GCP Cloud Run and Cloud Functions to build scalable, event\-driven microservices and high\-performance APIs that expose enterprise security data.
* Identifying opportunities to integrate AI/ML automation (e.g., Vertex AI, LLMs) to streamline manual data extraction, automate metadata tagging, and optimize pipeline orchestration.
* Driving the transition from standard visualization to a scalable data product model, establishing a comprehensive Looker dashboard catalog to streamline enterprise risk forecasting.
* Developing and maintaining a standardized semantic layer using LookML (Looker Modeling Language) to ensure data consistency, security access controls, and reusability across all security domains.
* Building comprehensive business cases and data models surrounding Enterprise Security Data Analysis and Reporting to drive long\-term security investments.


**What We’re Looking For...**
* Proven experience architecting and developing solutions within Google Cloud Platform, specifically leveraging containerized deployments via Cloud Run and serverless computing via Cloud Functions.
* Deep technical mastery of Google BigQuery architecture, including nested/repeated fields, materialized views, and BigQuery Omni or ML capabilities.
* Hands\-on experience building streaming and batch data processing pipelines using GCP Dataflow services.
* Advanced proficiency in writing complex, optimized SQL queries, with specific hands\-on administration and optimization experience using GCP Cloud SQL utilizing the PostgreSQL engine.
* Strong hands\-on coding expertise in Python to perform advanced data analysis, data mining, DevSecOps automation, and pipeline orchestration.
* Familiarity with deploying AI\-driven automation workflows to improve data pipeline resilience.
* Experience utilizing visualization platforms (e.g., Tableau, Looker, Thoughtspot) to build data\-driven stories tailored for business users at all levels.
* Experience embedding Looker visualizations directly into serverless applications or enterprise API frameworks is highly desirable.


**You’ll Need To Have**
* Bachelor degree in Computer Science/Information Systems or six or more years of work experience.
* Eight or more years of professional experience in data analytics, business analysis or comparable analytics position.
* Advanced proficiency in Python and writing complex, optimized SQL queries, with specific hands\-on administration and optimization experience using GCP Cloud SQL utilizing the PostgreSQL engine.
* Ability to write SQL against a relational database in order to analyze and test data.
* Experience with modern DataOps/DevSecOps orchestration tools (e.g., Airflow, dbt, CI/CD pipelines) applied directly to data engineering.
* Working knowledge on Threat, Risk and Vulnerability Management is an added advantage.
* Knowledge of securing cloud data delivery layers (OAuth, OIDC, API Gateways) and enforcing data privacy/governance standards.
* Cloud Certifications


**Even better if you have one or more of the following:**
* Experience in technology leadership, architecture, and Agile methodologies.
* Communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Problem solving skills to develop quick yet sound solutions to resolve complex issues.
* Experience in driving AI automation, delivering high performing and scalable applications.
* Experience with DevOps CI/CD processes to automate build and deployments.
* Experience mentoring and coaching diverse teams.
* Experience in identifying and analyzing and finding RCA for Errors and working with cross functional teams like SRE and backend team
* Experience with analytical tools and DBs like Postgres, Looker , ELK, ETL tools
* Recognizing, tracking, and communicating issues, accomplishments, milestones to the team and business partners.
* Professional Google Cloud Professional Data Engineer or Professional Cloud Architect certification.
* Good presentation and communication skills.

title: Senior Autonomous System Engineer
company: Big Bang Boom Solutions Private Limited
description:
**Job Title: Senior Autonomous Systems Engineer III** 




**Location:** 
 Chennai
 



**Department: Autonomous Systems** 




**Experience** 
 Level: 8–10\+ years
 



**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-Time
 



  





**Company Description:** 




 Big Bang Boom Solutions (BBBS) is a Chennai\-based deep\-tech defence startup focused on developing indigenous defence and security technologies. It operates as a defence solutions integrator that builds advanced systems in areas such as artificial intelligence, UAS/drone technology, electronic warfare, material science, propulsion, communication systems, and data security, aiming to create intellectual property for national defence applications.
 



 BBBS develops products such as anti\-drone defence systems, see\-through armour interfaces, smart surveillance platforms, and other custom defence technologies. The company has participated in and won multiple iDEX challenges sponsored by the Indian Ministry of Defence, receiving government grants and contracts.
 




  





**Job Summary:** 




 We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Senior Engineer to lead the development and integration of advanced autonomous aerial systems. The ideal candidate will have a strong academic background in Robotics, Aerospace, or Control Systems, with hands\-on expertise in UAV flight stacks (PX4/ArduPilot), V\-SLAM, and autonomous navigation in GNSS\-denied environments.
 



 In this role, you will lead a multidisciplinary team to design, develop, and deploy tactical UAS solutions across a variety of rotary\- and fixed\-wing platforms, driving innovation in both software and hardware integration
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 



* Lead UAS Development: Drive the design, development, and deployment of autonomous UAS platforms, including swarming behaviors and mission\-specific adaptations.
* Software Architecture \& Implementation: Architect and implement robust software solutions using ROS/ROS2, C\+\+, and Python for real\-time aerial navigation and control.
* Advanced Perception \& Navigation: Oversee Visual\-SLAM algorithms and sensor fusion (LiDAR, Radar, cameras, IMU) to enable obstacle avoidance, 3D mapping, and autonomous navigation in complex environments.
* Flight Control Systems Management: Customize and optimize flight control systems using PX4 or ArduPilot, including PID tuning and EKF optimization.
* Systems Integration: Coordinate integration across flight controllers, companion computers, and tactical payloads to ensure seamless performance.
* Simulation \& Testing: Develop, validate, and iterate autonomous behaviors in high\-fidelity simulation environments such as Gazebo, AirSim, or Unity.
* Cross\-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with hardware, avionics, and flight\-testing teams to ensure end\-to\-end system performance.
* Mentorship \& Technical Leadership: Mentor junior engineers and contribute to the technical strategy for autonomous ISR and electronic warfare roadmaps.
* Compliance \& Standards: Ensure all systems meet safety, performance, and regulatory standards, including DGCA and military reliability requirements.



  





**Required Qualifications:** 



* Education: M.E./M.Tech in Robotics, Aerospace, Autonomous Systems, or Control Systems.
* Advanced Education (Optional): Ph.D. in Robotics, Aerospace, Autonomous Systems, or Control Systems.
* Experience: 8–10\+ years in autonomous systems development, including at least 5 years focused on UAS/UAV platforms.



  





**Technical Skills:** 



* Programming \& Software: Proficient in ROS/ROS2, C\+\+, and Python within embedded Linux environments.
* UAV Dynamics \& Navigation: Strong understanding of UAV dynamics, path planning algorithms (e.g., A\*, RRT), and state estimation.
* Flight Control \& Communication: Expertise with PX4, ArduPilot, MAVLink, and UAVCAN protocols.
* Simulation \& Testing: Experienced with Gazebo, AirSim, and SITL/HITL workflows for validating autonomous behaviors.
* Perception \& Sensor Integration: Hands\-on experience with LiDAR\-based SLAM, optical flow, and GNSS\-denied positioning.
* Hardware Optimization: Skilled in debugging and optimizing compute\-constrained onboard hardware (e.g., NVIDIA Jetson and similar platforms).



  





**Preferred Attributes:** 



* Advanced Problem\-Solving: Ability to tackle complex, edge\-case flight scenarios and develop robust solutions.
* Effective Communication: Strong skills in articulating technical trade\-offs and design decisions to diverse stakeholders.
* Innovation\-Driven: Passion for pioneering tactical robotics and advancing sovereign defense technologies.

Overview:
 




  





 We are seeking an experienced Senior Linux Engineer to join our infrastructure and network engineering team, responsible for deploying, implementing, and supporting secure Linux\-based platforms within enterprise and data centre environments. The ideal candidate will have a minimum of 10 years of hands\-on experience with Linux operating systems and a strong background in network security, firewall technologies, and infrastructure deployment.
 



 This role requires expertise in NixOS, with experience in RHEL, GUIX, or other immutable operating systems. The successful candidate will also have strong knowledge of Linux networking, security zoning, stateful firewalls, and packet filtering technologies such as nftables. Experience with Cilium and Zeek is highly desirable, while exposure to Suricata will be considered an advantage.
 



  






 Roles \& responsibilities:
 



* Deploy, configure, and support enterprise Linux servers across production and non\-production environments.
* Implement and manage Linux operating systems, including NixOS, RHEL, GUIX, and other immutable OS platforms.
* Deploy and configure Linux\-based networking and security services.
* Implement Linux firewall solutions using nftables and stateful firewall technologies.
* Configure Linux networking, including Layer 2 networking, routing, VLANs, and security zoning.
* Support deployment and integration of enterprise firewall platforms, including Cisco, Fortinet, Palo Alto, and Check Point.
* Implement and troubleshoot Linux security controls, host hardening, and network segmentation.
* Configure and support Cilium for Kubernetes networking and security (where applicable).

description:
Long Description
   

  

 As our new Product Development Engineer, you will be driving end\-to\-end hardware design and development of electronic controllers, VFDs, and power\-drive systems for Grundfos's next\-generation product platforms. You'll be part of a diverse, supportive and inclusive culture, that celebrates our differences and puts people first by fostering growth, well\-being, and a sense of belonging.
   

  

 What you will be doing
   

  

 As a key part of the PD WU Controls team, you'll create impact by Architecting robust, safety\-critical electronics solutions that power sustainable water systems serving millions of people worldwide..
   

  

 Your main responsibilities include:
   

  

* Select and architect microcontroller platforms (8/16/32\-bit) and design robust electronics architecture for controllers, VFDs, soft\-starters, and power\-drive systems
* Develop schematics and PCB layouts using PADS/Altium, and perform circuit simulation using PSPICE, LT\-SPICE, or MATLAB Simulink
* Lead system\-level design including magnetics design, thermal calculations, switching/conduction loss analysis, and EMI/EMC design considerations
* Execute Design FMEA, MTBF analysis, and ensure compliance with safety standards for safety\-critical product development
* Perform board\-level testing, system integration, fault finding, and coordinate with firmware teams during code development and validation
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams including mechanical, software, and third\-party test labs to meet product requirements and certifications


 What makes you a great fit
   

  

 Above all, you are a hands\-on power electronics hardware engineer with deep expertise in embedded controller design, strong analytical skills, and a drive to deliver reliable, scalable product platforms in an agile environment. We would also imagine that you have:
   

  

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical \& Electronics Engineering or Electronics Engineering
* 7\+ years of experience in hardware design within the power electronics domain, including power supply and inverter designs
* Proficiency in PADS schematic and PCB design tools, with experience in hardware communication interfaces (RS232, RS485, SPI, I2C, CAN, USB)
* Strong knowledge of control system design (PID), motor control theory (Induction/PMSM/FOC), and interfacing power electronics devices


 It is a plus if you also:
   

  

* Experience with system design and modelling in SaberRD or MATLAB Simulink
* Knowledge of safety\-critical product development standards and third\-party certification processes
* Experience managing multiple concurrent development projects in an agile environment


 Why you will love working here
   

  

 We care! Day to day, you can look forward to:
   

  

* A working environment built around your needs, with flexible hours, home working opportunities and parental support.
* Annual bonuses, health insurance and a strong focus on well\-being activities.
* Three days' additional paid leave for volunteering in your community.
* Access to on\-demand training and learning sessions and carefully structured programmes to pursue personal and professional development opportunities.


 We are inclusive! Celebrating and valuing our differences helps us see possibilities where others can't. We therefore welcome and encourage applications from all abilities, experiences, and backgrounds.
   

  

 Are you ready to unlock possibilities at Grundfos? Apply today!
   

  

 To get to know us better, follow us on LinkedIn or visit grundfos.com

title: Field Investigator
description:
**Company Description** 
 Garuda Intelligence is a professional private detective agency based in Chennai, specializing in matrimonial and personal investigations. The agency provides discreet, confidential, and legally compliant intelligence services to individual and corporate clients. With a focus on ethical practices and client trust, Garuda Intelligence conducts thorough fact\-finding to support informed decision\-making. The team is committed to delivering accurate, timely insights while maintaining strict privacy and security standards.
   

**Role Description** 
 This is a full\-time, on\-site Field Investigator role located in Chennai. The Field Investigator will conduct surveillance, background checks, and fact\-finding related to matrimonial, personal, and other assigned cases. Daily responsibilities include gathering evidence through interviews and observation, verifying information and documents, and preparing clear, detailed investigation reports. The role requires adherence to legal and ethical guidelines, coordination with senior investigators or case managers, and maintaining strict confidentiality. The Field Investigator will regularly travel within Chennai and surrounding areas as required by case assignments.
   

**Qualifications**
  

* Candidates should possess strong investigative and research skills, including information gathering, verification, and analytical thinking.
* Candidates should possess excellent communication skills for conducting interviews, documenting findings, and preparing clear written reports.
* Candidates should possess a high level of discretion, integrity, and ethical judgment, with a strong commitment to confidentiality.
* Candidates should possess good observational skills, attention to detail, and situational awareness in field environments.
* Candidates should possess basic legal awareness related to privacy, surveillance, and evidence handling in India.
* Candidates should possess the ability to work independently in the field, manage time effectively, and handle multiple cases.
* Comfort with using smartphones, basic computer applications, and secure digital communication tools is beneficial.
* Prior experience in investigations, security, law enforcement, or related fields is an advantage.
* A relevant diploma or degree (e.g., criminology, law, psychology, or related discipline) is preferred but not mandatory.
* Willingness to work flexible hours, including evenings and weekends, based on case requirements.

The Foodhub Tech Stack is extensive: from Web and Mobile Ordering to 3rd Party Order Aggregation, Dispatch and Self\-Delivery, complete Hardware/Software POS systems, extensive array of POS integrations, On\-Premise Kiosks, QR Code Ordering and Payment, Table\-side Mobile Order/Receipt Printers, plus an extensive product and development team to support all of this.
   

  

* 5–8 years in software testing, SDET or Quality Engineering, with strong hands\-on automation experience.
* Strong programming skills in Java, TypeScript or JavaScript.
* Strong Playwright experience and automation framework design experience.
* Strong API automation experience; REST Assured or equivalent.
* CI/CD, Git, debugging and strong software\-testing fundamentals.
* Functional, integration, regression and end\-to\-end testing.
* Appium/mobile automation experience is strongly preferred.
* Selenium, TestNG/JUnit, SQL, Docker/cloud execution, performance or security testing are valuable.


**Requirements**
**AI\-Native Quality Engineering:**
* AI is a core requirement of this role. You will use AI throughout the quality lifecycle—not simply as an occasional chatbot.
* Analyze requirements and acceptance criteria; identify missing scenarios, edge cases and risks.
* Generate and improve test scenarios, automation code and synthetic test data.
* Use AI coding assistants to accelerate development, refactoring, debugging and test maintenance.
* Use AI to analyze failed tests, logs, screenshots and stack traces and accelerate root\-cause analysis.
* Explore AI\-assisted test maintenance, intelligent regression selection and self\-healing approaches.

**Automation \& Continuous Testing**
* Build scalable automation using Playwright and appropriate supporting technologies.
* Develop API automation and validation; use API\-level tests to reduce unnecessary UI testing.
* Maintain functional, integration, regression and end\-to\-end automation.
* Use Appium for mobile automation where required; Selenium experience is valuable.
* Reduce flaky tests, enable parallel execution and improve feedback time.
* Integrate automation into Jenkins or equivalent CI/CD pipelines and establish meaningful quality gates.
* Continuously identify manual testing that can be automated or eliminated.


**AI / LLM Quality**
* Test AI features for accuracy, relevance, consistency, reliability, context handling and failure behavior.
* Evaluate hallucinations, prompt injection, adversarial inputs, safety/guardrails and boundary conditions.
* Define evaluation criteria and automated evaluation pipelines for AI\-powered features.
* Experience with RAG, embedding, vector databases, conversational AI, tool/function calling or AI agents is strongly preferred.
* Understand testing of the full RAG flow: Query â Retrieval â Context â LLM â Response.

* Work closely with developers and product managers to identify quality risks early.
* Participate in refinement, sprint planning, design discussions, release planning and retrospectives.
* Investigate defects rather than simply reporting them; think from the customer perspective.
* Balance release speed with product quality in a fast\-moving Agile environment.
