title: AI Native Product Marketer
description:
**AI\-Native GTM / Product Marketing Operator**




  





**About Facilio**




  





 Facilio is the agentic platform transforming how large buildings manage their physical operations. We are the AI\-native operating layer for buildings on a mission to make buildings operationally efficient.
 



  





 Today, 150\+ enterprise customers across hospitals, universities, retail chains, landmark venues and large real estate portfolios use Facilio to drive cost efficiency, service quality, compliance and operational performance.
 



  





 With a growing presence across the US, UK, Middle East and Australia, Facilio is backed by leading global investors including Accel, Tiger Global, Dragoneer and Brookfield Growth.
 



 We aim to bring agentic AI to the physical world — moving enterprise operations from systems that record and manage work to intelligent systems that understand, decide and act.
 



  





**Build the next generation of GTM at Facilio.**




  





 At Facilio, we're building an AI\-first enterprise SaaS platform for teams that run physical operations. As AI changes how products are built, sold and marketed, we’re rethinking what a modern marketing team should look like too.
 



  





 We're looking for someone early in their career who understands
 **Product Marketing** 
 but thinks beyond traditional marketing execution.
 



  





 The old model:
 



**Marketer → thinks of an idea → uses AI → creates the asset → distributes it** 




  





 The model we're building:
 



**Understand the GTM objective → identify what needs to happen → orchestrate AI agents \+ existing systems → review \& steer the output → learn from the result → improve the system.** 




  





 This role builds and owns that shift for the PMM function. Think of it as a GTM engineer's systems fluency, aimed specifically at product marketing judgment.
 



  





**What you'll do**




  




* Understand our
 **products, customers, ICPs and GTM motions** 
 deeply enough to identify what marketing should actually do — not just execute briefs.
* Take existing PMM workflows (case studies, social posts, enablement docs, battlecards, email sequences) and rebuild them as connected mini\-agents — triggered by real events in our systems, not by someone opening a chat and typing a brief
* Define what each agent should draft autonomously vs. where it must stop and hand off to a human — this is a marketing judgment call, not just a technical guardrail
* Use AI not just to create content, but to
 **identify opportunities, generate ideas, make recommendations and trigger the next action** 
 .
* Review and QA agent output against real marketing standards: does this case study lead with the right proof point for this funnel stage? Does this battlecard actually counter the objection or just restate our positioning?
* Build systems that can take something like a product update or customer signal and determine what messaging, content, enablement or GTM action should follow.
* Bring strong judgement to the output:
 **what is worth saying, who should hear it, when, through which channel, and why.**
* Continuously measure what works and improve the underlying workflow, agent or system — not just the individual output.



  





**What you'll need to bring**




  





**1\. PMM fundamentals** 




 You understand positioning, messaging, ICPs, personas, buyer journeys, content, launches, customer stories and sales enablement — and know what good looks like.
 



**2\. GTM judgement** 




 You can look at a product, customer or market signal and figure out
 **what should happen next** 
 . You understand that the same story, proof point or message won't work equally well across every persona or funnel stage.
 



**3\. AI / agent orchestration** 




 You don't just ask Claude or ChatGPT to write faster. You instinctively ask:
 **Can this workflow be automated? Can an agent do this? What context should it have? What systems should it connect to? Where should a human stay in the loop?** 




**4\. Systems thinking** 




 You enjoy breaking messy, repetitive workflows into inputs, decisions, actions and feedback loops — and turning them into scalable systems.
 



**5\. Execution ownership** 




 You're still a doer. You can take an idea from
 **problem → system → output → measurement** 
 , rather than waiting for someone else to define the work for you.
 



  





**Who this is for**




  




* **1–3 years of experience** 
 in Product Marketing, B2B SaaS marketing, GTM, growth or a closely related role.
* Someone who is
 **curious about how things work and obsessed with making them better** 
 .
* Someone who experiments with AI tools and wants to go beyond prompting into
 **building workflows, agents and systems** 
 .
* Someone who can move between
 **customer thinking, product understanding, marketing judgement and technology** 
 .
* Someone who would rather build a system that eliminates 10 hours of recurring work than become really good at doing those 10 hours.



  





**What this role is NOT**




  




* Not a content writer who occasionally uses AI tools
* Not a pure automation/RevOps builder with no marketing instinct
* Not someone who needs an idea handed to them before they can execute — the whole point is they (and their agents) originate ideas

title: Digital Coaching Business Strategist / Digital Coaching Community Builder
description:
Digital Coaching Business Strategist / Digital Coaching Community Builder — ExpertsBIO 🎯
   


 Remote \| ₹24–60 lakh/year realistic earning \| Base \+ uncapped commission
 



  





**About ExpertsBIO** 





 India's performance marketing partner built exclusively for coaches. For 8 years we've worked with 100\+ coaches, managed crores in ad spend, and built revenue engines for some of the most recognised names in Indian coaching.
 





 Here's why this role exists. Too many coaches are getting scammed and left without the help they actually need. We're building a genuinely value\-driven community to change that. We want someone capable enough to run this on their own — and that's the point: you get to be an intrapreneur, building your own thing, but coached by people who've already done it for hundreds of coaches over 8 years, with the contacts and the playbook to match. We run on performance, not salaries and comfort. If that's your language, keep reading.
 




  





**The Role — in plain terms** 





 You'll run a free online community where coaches come to learn and grow. Your job is to genuinely help them — fix their offer, sort out their business model, guide their funnel — so they get real results and come to trust you. Because they trust you, you'll then guide the right coaches into our paid programs and tools, and earn commission on every sale. As the community grows, you find new things to offer them and make more. You build the audience, you help them, you sell to them — all of it is yours.
 




  





**What You'll Actually Do Day to Day** 



* Grow and run the community — bring coaches in, keep them engaged, make it a place they show up for.

 *teach* 
  coaches and get them results.

**What We're Not Looking For** 



* If you need a fixed salary to feel secure, this is not for you.
* If you've never worked with coaches or info\-products, this isn't the right fit.
* If you want to clock in and be chased for output, please don't apply.

**Who Thrives Here** 





 The person who 
 
*wants* 
  ₹24–60 lakh a year and has the fire to pull it off. Who's excited that their income is tied to what they build, not what they're handed. If that's you, we'll give you the audience, the offers, and the room to make serious money.

* Analyze defects identified during test cycles by capturing clear reproduction steps in Jira and partnering with developers to support quick resolution and robust verification of applied fixes.
* Apply agile testing practices including continuous validation and early feedback to improve feature quality reduce rework and accelerate delivery of stable contact center capabilities.
* Review requirements and solution designs for IVR and AWS Connect components to identify testability gaps and propose practical improvements that support reliable automation and efficient manual validation.
* Document test results expected outcomes and observed behaviors in an organized manner to provide traceability from requirements through execution and support audit or compliance needs.
* Support continuous improvement of test processes by suggesting enhancements to test templates review practices and automation opportunities that increase coverage and reduce cycle time.
* Contribute to quality metrics reporting for the agile team such as defect trends test coverage and readiness indicators to inform decision making before production releases.
* Assist in assessing channel related business scenarios by validating real world customer journeys and highlighting potential experience issues that could impact satisfaction and operational efficiency.


**Qualifications**

* Show strong familiarity with Scrum practices including participation in sprint planning daily standups reviews and retrospectives while aligning testing activities with iterative delivery.
* Exhibit proven capability in IVR testing by designing and executing voice call scenarios validating prompts and ensuring accurate routing behavior within complex call flows.

* Apply solid agile mindset by embracing incremental testing continuous feedback and cross functional collaboration to maintain high quality outcomes in a fast paced environment.
* Demonstrate good analytical and problem solving skills by interpreting requirements identifying edge cases and resolving ambiguities that could affect test coverage and reliability.
* Bring helpful exposure to channels domain knowledge such as multi touch customer journeys or omnichannel service strategies which enables realistic and meaningful test scenario design.
* Operate effectively in a hybrid work model by managing time communication and collaboration tools to keep testing activities synchronized with onsite and remote team members.
* Communicate clearly in both written and spoken form to convey test findings risk assessments and recommendations in a concise manner to stakeholders across technology and business.
* Maintain professional adaptability within day shifts by supporting planned release schedules and participating in occasional extended validation windows when project timelines demand.

Sharief Bhai is looking for a Regional Manager to own store\-level P\&L, operations, and people leadership across our Tier\-2 South cluster — including Coimbatore, Palakkad, Manipal, and surrounding markets. This role is central to Sharief Bhai's push to become a Top\-3 brand in its core markets, and offers direct ownership over revenue, cost, quality, and team performance for 6–10 stores.
 



  
 



**Role Overview** 




  
 



 The Regional Manager will be the single point of accountability for a cluster of 6–10 Sharief Bhai stores in Tier\-2 South cities. This is a high\-ownership, on\-ground role combining P\&L management, store operations, people leadership, and quality/compliance oversight. The role reports to the GM – Operations and requires frequent travel across the assigned cluster.
 



  
 



**Key Responsibilities** 




  
 



**P\&L \& Revenue (Primary Focus)** 




 ·        Own store\-level P\&L across the assigned cluster — revenue, food cost, labour cost, and controllable expenses
 



 ·        Drive top\-line growth through online (aggregator) and offline/dine\-in channels; track AOV, order volume, and discounting
 



 ·        Monitor cost levers (food cost %, wastage, utilities, manpower cost) and drive corrective action on deviations
 



 ·        Deliver monthly business reviews with clear performance narratives and action plans for underperforming stores
 



  
 



**Team Management** 




  
 



 Manage and develop a team of Restaurant Managers, and front\-of\-house (FOH) and back\-of\-house (BOH) staff
 



 Drive hiring, training, and performance management across the cluster in line with company SOPs
 



 Build a strong bench of Restaurant Managers and reduce frontline attrition
 



  
 



**Store Operations, Maintenance \& Quality** 




  
 



 Ensure stores are audit\-ready at all times; own corrective action plans for quality/food\-safety audit scores
 



 Coordinate store maintenance (equipment, infrastructure, licensing) with central maintenance and procurement teams
 



 Ensure consistent adherence to SOPs across hygiene, service, and product quality
 



 Travel \& On\-Ground Presence
 



 Conduct regular store visits across the cluster (Coimbatore, Palakkad, Manipal, and other Tier\-2 South markets)
 



 Represent store\-level ground realities in reviews with central ops, QA, and procurement teams
 



  
 



**What We're Looking For** 




  
 



 5–8 years of experience in restaurant/QSR/retail operations, including 2\+ years managing multiple units or teams
 



 Strong P\&L orientation — comfortable owning revenue and cost numbers, not just operational metrics
 



 Proven people\-management experience across store\-level teams (Restaurant Managers, FOH, BOH)
 



 Willingness and ability to travel frequently within the assigned region
 



 Working knowledge of food safety/quality audit processes and store maintenance coordination
 



 Data\-driven approach — comfortable reading store dashboards, audit reports, and P\&L statements
 



 Fluency in English and working proficiency in regional languages relevant to the cluster (Tamil/Malayalam/Kannada) preferred
 








**Success Metrics** 









 Store\-level revenue growth and cost (food \& labour) as % of revenue vs. target
 



 Quality/food\-safety audit scores across cluster stores (target: consistently above 80%)
 



 Team attrition and Restaurant Manager bench strength
 



 Store uptime/serviceability and resolution TAT on maintenance issues

title: Software Quality Engineer
description:
To make electronics, you need chips, wafers, transistors, reticles, and... To make these, you must see, test and manufacture them at scale—faster and better than ever before. That's where KLA comes in. Whether you're early in your career or an experienced professional, you'll solve complex challenges, work alongside brilliant minds and help shape the future of technology.
   

  

**Group/Division**
 The Semiconductor Products and Customers (Semi PC) business unit designs, builds and sells KLA’s product portfolio to help chip manufacturers meet high\-quality standards for technologies like AI, data centers, automotive and electronic devices. Our inspection, metrology, and analytics systems detect and monitor defects across logic and memory chips, specialty semiconductors, wafers, reticles, advanced packaging, process equipment and materials. We also develop technologies for specialty processes, IC substrates, and PCB manufacturing, including etch and deposition, component inspection, and imaging and analytics. KLA's Central Engineering organization is made up of nine Centers of Excellence (CoEs) spanning disciplines like automation, motion control, sensors, platform design, and packaging. Each CoE contributes not only technical deliverables but also deep expertise, best practices, and advanced tools that elevate both what we build—and how we build it.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
 In this role, you will play a key part in advancing business priorities by delivering high\-impact work across your area of expertise.
   

  

 Role Overview
   

  

 We are looking for a passionate
 **Quality Engineer** 
 with strong software development, automation, and AI skills. You will build frameworks, tools, and intelligent solutions that improve product testability, accelerate defect detection, and enable quality throughout the software development lifecycle.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Design, develop, and maintain scalable automation frameworks for desktop, web, API, and system\-level testing.
* Develop reusable software tools, libraries, APIs, and utilities that improve testability and engineering productivity.
* Partner with developers to review designs, improve code testability, and drive Shift\-Left quality practices.
* Integrate automated validation and quality gates into CI/CD pipelines.
* Apply AI and intelligent algorithms to generate tests, analyze logs, identify failure patterns, and accelerate root cause analysis.
* Automate the collection, transformation, and reporting of test results and quality metrics.
* Build actionable dashboards using Power BI or similar reporting tools.
* Support DevOps, continuous testing, and release\-readiness initiatives.


**Required Skills And Qualifications**
* Strong software development experience using C\#, Java, Python, TypeScript, or a similar programming language.
* Strong understanding of OOP, OOD, data structures, algorithms, design patterns, and clean coding practices.
* Experience developing automation frameworks, developer tools, APIs, libraries, or test infrastructure.
* Experience with UI automation tools such as Selenium, Playwright, WinAppDriver, or Coded UI.
* Experience with API testing frameworks such as RestAssured, Postman, SoapUI, JUnit, or TestNG.
* Knowledge of REST, SOAP, XML, JSON, SQL, Git, and web\-service technologies.
* Experience integrating automated tests into Jenkins, Azure DevOps, or similar CI/CD platforms.
* Hands\-on exposure to Generative AI, AI\-assisted coding, prompt engineering, LLM APIs, intelligent test generation, or log and failure analysis using AI.
* Strong debugging, problem\-solving, and root cause analysis skills.
* Good communication and collaboration skills.


**Minimum Qualifications**
 Master's Level Degree and 0 years related work experience; Bachelor's Level Degree and related work experience of 2 years
   

  

**About KLA**
 We provide advanced inspection tools, metrology systems, process solutions, and computational analytics that make electronics possible, tackling complex challenges. From electron and photon optics to machine learning and data analytics, we seek perfection at the most fundamental level of matter in the universe. If you want to make electronics that push industries forward and make the world a better place, join us.
   

  

**Use of AI Statement**
 At KLA, our interviews seek to understand your individual skills, problem\-solving approach and authentic thinking. To ensure a fair and consistent evaluation, the use of AI, recording tools or other technologies to generate, suggest or provide responses during interviews—whether virtual or in person—is not permitted unless explicitly approved in advance as part of a reasonable accommodation or invited by the interviewer. Use of these tools may interfere with our ability to evaluate your individual qualifications and affect your candidacy. KLA is committed to advancing innovation through responsible AI, and we value candidates who share this mindset.

title: Software Development Engineer in Test II
description:
TechGrove is the
 **Centre of Excellence** 
 for Banyan Software, based in Chennai, India. It plays a key role in supporting Banyan’s global businesses through technology, security, and software development. TechGrove brings together India’s deep pool of technical talent with Banyan’s long\-term approach to growth, creating a trusted, developer\-focused environment where people can do their best work.
 



 About Element34
   

 Element34 is building modern enterprise solutions for software quality and test automation. Our
   

 flagship product, SBOX, helps enterprises run their Selenium, Playwright and Appium tests
   

 securely within their own infrastructure, behind their firewall and within their security and
   

 compliance boundaries.
 



  

 We are part of Banyan Software, a long\-term owner of profitable vertical software businesses.
   

 Element34 operates with a lean engineering organization, giving engineers the opportunity to
   

 work closely with product, customers and leadership and see the direct impact of their work.
 



 About SBOX
   

 SBOX is an enterprise test automation platform that enables organizations to run browser and
   

 mobile automation at scale within their own environment.
   

 The platform supports Selenium, Playwright and Appium and includes capabilities around test
   

 execution, browser/device management, reporting, integrations and AI\-powered quality
   

 capabilities.
   

 We are continuing to evolve SBOX into a more AI\-native quality engineering platform, making
   

 reliability, automation intelligence and actionable quality insights an important part of the
   

 product.
 



 The Opportunity
   

 We are looking for a SDET / Quality Engineer who wants to play a key role in building the next
   

 generation of quality engineering for SBOX.
   

 As our product and engineering velocity grow, we want to make quality an integral part of how we
   

 build and release software — not something that happens only at the end of the development
   

 cycle.
   

 You will help us build stronger automation, improve regression confidence, identify quality risks
   

 earlier and create better ways of understanding and resolving failures.
   

 This is a high\-ownership engineering role. You will have the freedom to identify opportunities,
   

 propose solutions and take them from idea to implementation.
   

 You won't just be executing predefined test cases — you'll help shape how quality engineering
   

 works at SBOX.
 



 What You'll Work On
   

 Automation \& Quality Engineering
   

 ● Design, build and maintain robust automation for critical SBOX workflows.
   

 ● Develop automation using Playwright, Appium and Selenium.
   

 ● Translate product requirements, user stories and customer workflows into meaningful
   

 automated scenarios.
   

 ● Build reusable automation components and frameworks that scale with the product.
   

 ● Continuously improve regression coverage and test reliability.
   

 Test Execution \& Failure Analysis
   

 ● Build and maintain automated workflows that run reliably in CI and unattended
   

 environments.
   

 ● Work with platforms such as BrowserStack, Sauce Labs, LambdaTest or equivalent.
   

 ● Analyze test results and investigate failures across application, automation, infrastructure
   

 and environment.
   

 ● Debug failures deeply and drive them through to resolution.
   

 ● Identify and eliminate flaky tests and recurring sources of instability.
   

 Quality Strategy
   

 ● Partner with engineers and product managers early in the development lifecycle.
   

 ● Help define the right testing strategy for new features and major product initiatives.
   

 ● Identify edge cases, integration risks and potential regression areas.
   

 ● Contribute to release\-readiness decisions using meaningful quality signals.
   

 ● Continuously improve our automation architecture, testing practices and tooling.
   

 Test Management \& Defect Management
   

 ● Create and maintain test cases, workflows and regression suites.
   

 ● Track execution progress and manage defects through their lifecycle.
   

 ● Participate in defect triaging and collaborate with Engineering and Product teams.
   

 ● Improve visibility into automation health, product quality and release confidence.
 



 What We're Looking For
   

 Must Have
   

 ● Strong experience in SDET, QA Automation or Quality Engineering.
   

 ● Strong hands\-on experience with Playwright and Appium
   

 ● Experience with Real\-device/mobile testing
   

 ● Strong programming skills in Java, JavaScript/TypeScript or another programming
   

 language.
   

 ● Hands\-on experience with platforms such as BrowserStack, Sauce Labs, LambdaTest or
   

 equivalent.
   

 ● Experience building or maintaining automation frameworks.
   

 ● Experience converting requirements and user stories into automated test scenarios.
   

 ● Experience running automation in unattended/CI environments.
   

 ● Strong debugging, problem\-solving and failure\-analysis skills.
   

 ● Experience with test management, defect tracking and triaging.
   

 ● Experience working in a startup, scale\-up or lean engineering environment.
   

 ● Strong sense of ownership and ability to execute independently.
   

 ● Experience with AI testing and quality engineering, AI\-assisted coding tools
   

 Nice to Have
   

 ● API testing and automation
   

 ● Accessibility testing
   

 ● Visual regression testing
   

 ● Performance/load testing
   

 ● Docker and Kubernetes
   

 ● CI/CD platforms
   

 ● Enterprise software and security\-focused environments
   

 How We Work
   

 We are a small, experienced and highly collaborative engineering team. Our size gives every
   

 engineer the opportunity to have a meaningful impact.
   

 We value:
   

 ● Ownership — Take a problem from understanding through implementation and outcomes.
   

 ● Initiative — We appreciate people who identify opportunities and proactively make things
   

 better.
   

 ● Independent execution — You will have autonomy to decide how to solve problems while
   

 having support when you need it.
   

 ● Engineering excellence — We care about building maintainable solutions, not just getting
   

 a test to pass once.
   

 ● Speed and pragmatism — We move quickly, learn quickly and continuously improve.
   

 Because we operate with a lean structure, you will have broad ownership and visibility into your
   

 work. You won't be limited to a narrowly defined QA function — you'll collaborate across
   

 Engineering and Product and have the opportunity to influence how we build quality into SBOX.

title: Health Coach - Multilingual
description:
**Twin Health**
 At Twin Health, we empower people to improve and prevent chronic metabolic diseases, like type 2 diabetes and obesity, with a new standard of care. Twin Health is the only company applying AI Digital Twin technology exclusively toward metabolic health.
   

  

 We start by building a dynamic model of each person’s metabolism — drawing on thousands of data points from CGMs, smartwatches, and meal logs — that maps their personal path to better health. Guided by a dedicated clinical care team, our members have lowered their A1C below the diabetes range, achieved lasting weight loss, and reduced or even eliminated medications, all while living healthier, happier lives.
   

  

**Working here**
 Our team at Twin Health is passionate, talented, and united by a shared purpose: to improve the metabolic health and happiness of our members. We believe in empowering every Twin to make a meaningful impact for our members, our clients, and each other, while enjoying a supportive, collaborative work environment.
   

  

 Twin has been recognized not only for our innovation but also for our culture, including: Innovator of the Year by the Employer Health Innovation Roundtable (EHIR), selected to CB Insights’ Digital Health 150, and named one of Newsweek’s Top Most Loved Workplace® .
   

  

 With more than $100 million raised in recent funding, including a $53 million Series E round in 2025 led by Maj Invest, and a $50 million investment in 2023 led by Temasek, Twin is scaling rapidly across the U.S. and globally. Backed by leading venture firms like ICONIQ Growth, Sequoia, Sofina, Temasek, and Peak XV, we are building the most impactful digital health company in the world.
   

  

 Join us as we reinvent the standard of care in metabolic health.
   

  

**Core Responsibilities**
* Act as the primary point of contact for each assigned member—building trust, offering


 personalized support, and delivering a consistently high\-touch experience.
   

  

* Bridge the gap between health and technology by helping members understand and leverage


 the Twin platform to make informed lifestyle changes.
   

  

* Speak to members at a defined frequency, ensuring structured conversations that add value,


 instill motivation, and drive positive health outcomes.
   

  

* Provide individualized nutrition and lifestyle coaching focused on remissioning chronic


 metabolic diseases and improving overall health.
   

  

* Motivate and empower members to achieve their health goals through sustained behavior change,


 education, and encouragement.
   

  

* Interpret and review member health data daily, enabling timely and actionable interventions.
* Promote the Twin philosophy: unmonitored dieting is evil to a disrupted metabolism—members


 must heal through scientific guidance, not restriction.
   

  

* Reiterate the role of the Twin Digital Twin technology consistently to enhance understanding,


 engagement, and trust in the process.
   

  

* Take full ownership of member adherence, retention, and reactivation, using early signals to


 proactively prevent drop\-offs.
   

  

* Handle exceptions and escalations calmly and professionally, providing solutions and emotional support during moments of distress.
* Champion scoreboard\-driven performance—monitoring key metrics like member engagement,


 retention, nutrition adherence, and health outcome and referrals.
   

  

* Collaborate closely with internal teams (Doctors, Coaches \& Customer Success) to ensure


 seamless, coordinated care delivery.
   

  

* Maintain full compliance with Twin Health’s SOPs for data, communication, and service


 excellence.
   

  

 We have been made aware of fraudulent interview requests being sent using the Twin Health's name. All communications will come from official Twin Health channels and a twinhealth.com email address. We will never ask you to complete a text interview or request financial details during the interview process.

* Tech Strategy \& Vision
* IT Operating Model optimization
* Transformation strategy, roadmaps \& blueprints
* Office of CIO functions (IT Finance, Sourcing, Project Portfolio Mgt. etc)
* Product strategy \& management
* M\&A due\-diligence, planning and post integration/separation

Experience working with IT leadership (e.g., CIO, IT Director) and business leadership (e.g., CFO, COO, BU leader, etc.) to help shape and guide the IT strategic and improvement agenda
* Be a trusted advisor on 'innovation' with ability to frame key business and technology trends within the context of the client's objectives. Ability to identify the potential implications and impacts of the associated trends.

 Within the team, your role will include the following additional responsibilities:
   

  

* Ability to lead conversations with the client stakeholders. Strong communication skills as the profile requires interactions with CIO, CEO, CFO and other senior leadership

* Building and growing TST Strategy practice, developing and maintaining client relationships, and selling and delivering work as an engagement leader or Subject Matter Specialist.

* Would support in developing new solution offerings, tools and knowledge repositories
* People skill has worked independently on projects or as part of small consulting teams
* Should be self\-driven and organized person with ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced, high pressure environment
* Should have experience in pursuit teams including conceptualizing propositions and presenting solutions to client
* Create expert content for point\-of\-view and use advanced presentation, public speaking, content creation and communication skills for C\-Level discussions.
* Demonstrate strong understanding of a specific industry, client or technology and function as an expert to advise senior leadership.


**To qualify for the role, you must have**
* Strong academic background with BE/B.tech and MBA from top Tier\-1 B\-schools
* A background in Strategy Consulting (in top tier consulting firms), with 10\+ years of relevant experience in large\-scale, enterprise\-wide transformations
* Min. of 10\+ years of specific industry / sector experience through completed client engagements related to business transformation. Should have experience in any one or two industry sectors such as Financial services, Retail, Healthcare/Pharma, Telecom, e\-commerce, etc.

Should understand IT \- business alignment, IT strategy and planning, development of current and future state IT architecture, roadmaps, IT/Digital maturity assessment, etc.
* Experience with large transformation related to customer experience, process re\-engineering, digital, cloud, automation, AI/ML/advanced analytics, next\-gen / emerging tech (IoT, blockchain, virtual twins etc).

* Should be able to analyze data and translate findings into meaningful insights, integrating relevant business knowledge

title: Cyber Operate- Vulnerability Management + Anthropic - Senior Consultant
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
 As a Senior Consultant at Deloitte Consulting, you will support end\-to\-end vulnerability management engagements, assisting in the identification, assessment, prioritization, and remediation tracking of security vulnerabilities across client environments. You will work alongside senior practitioners and cross\-functional teams to deliver high\-quality outcomes, leveraging both traditional VM tooling and emerging Anthropic / Agentic AI capabilities to accelerate threat detection and response.
   

  

**Work you'll do**
 As a Senior Consultant on the Cyber Operate team, you will be responsible for leading vulnerability management engagements across client environments.
   

  

* Lead vulnerability assessment engagements across on\-premises, cloud, and hybrid environments, and manage the vulnerability management lifecycle from policy design through remediation verification.
* Serve as a primary client contact, align vulnerability management strategies to business risk priorities and regulatory requirements, and produce risk\-based dashboards and reporting for leadership.
* Design and implement Anthropic Claude\-powered automation workflows for vulnerability ingestion, triage, prioritization, and remediation guidance.
* Integrate vulnerability management platforms with security orchestration, security information and event management, and information technology service management systems to automate workflows and reduce manual effort.
* Define and improve operating procedures, service level agreements, and quality metrics; mentor junior team members; and coordinate remediation tracking across stakeholder groups.


**The team**
 Cyber Operate teams manage clients' critical cyber assets either as a fully managed service or in partnership with clients. They deliver skilled talent, cutting\-edge technologies, and robust processes to operate client cyber capabilities. This includes managing the identity lifecycle, security operations, threat intelligence, application security, business transformation, and ensuring continuous compliance. Services include Cyber\-as\-a\-Service, Managed Application Security, and Managed Extended Detect \& Respond (MXDR).
   

  

**Location: Bengaluru / Hyderabad / Pune / Chennai**
**Shift Timings: 2:00 PM to 11:00 PM IST, with flexibility required based on client expectations, engagement demands, time zone coverage, on\-call support, and after\-hours operational needs**
**Qualifications**
 Required:
   

  

* 5\-10 years of experience in cybersecurity, including 4\+ years of vulnerability management experience in enterprise or managed service environments
* Experience with vulnerability management platforms such as RiskSense, ServiceNow Vulnerability Response, Armis VIPR, Tenable.sc, Tenable.io, Qualys VMDR, Rapid7 InsightVM, Microsoft Defender Vulnerability Management, or Prisma Cloud
* Experience integrating Anthropic Claude application programming interfaces into security workflows, including prompt engineering, function calling, and tool use for triage, summarization, and remediation guidance
* Experience with vulnerability risk scoring frameworks, including Common Vulnerability Scoring System version 3 or version 4, Exploit Prediction Scoring System, CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities, and business\-risk contextualization
* Experience scripting application programming interface integrations, data pipelines, and automation of vulnerability management reporting workflows
* Experience with security information and event management platforms, cloud security posture management, container or Kubernetes vulnerability scanning, and security orchestration, automation, and response platforms
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Cyber Security, Information Security, Engineering, Information Technology, or equivalent


 Preferred:
   

  

* Experience building retrieval\-augmented generation pipelines using Claude or similar large language models against vulnerability knowledge bases
* Experience with artificial intelligence or machine learning\-based anomaly detection integrated with vulnerability management tooling for predictive risk scoring
* CISSP, CISM, Tenable Certified Security Professional, Qualys Certified Specialist, AWS Security Specialty, or Azure Security Specialty certification
* Experience with attack surface management platforms such as Mandiant ASM, CrowdStrike Falcon Surface, or Cortex XPANSE


 \#Cyber\_Cyber Operate

description:
**Company Description**
 Company Description
   

  

 We invite you to bring your Electrical System experience into play as you will be Designing electrical systems on projects to Ramboll and its Clients, in coordination with Architects and structural consultants, for all stages; i.e concept, schematic, detailed design, tender \& construction. To succeed in this role you must have minimum B.Tech/ M.Tech, preferably Bachelor of Engineering in Electrical Engineering with 4 to 8 years of professional experience in the relevant field. Are you our new Engineer\- Electrical, Buildings? Click the apply\-button to send your application.
   

  

**Inviting bright minds**
 Do you want to push the boundaries of your profession and develop your excellence in an open, collaborative and empowering culture? We work to create a sustainable future and our inspiring projects and innovative solutions aim to set the standard among our peers. You will join a global company that has been growing successfully since its founding in 1945\. Together, we lead and leave a positive impact on societies, companies and people around the world.
   

  

**You will join our Buildings Department**
 As our new Engineer– Electrical, Buildings you will be part of our global High\-Rise department, Ramboll’s dedicated team of high\-rise experts which have designed over 150 tall building projects globally, including some of the most technically challenging. You would be responsible for coordinating with project managers and/or engineers for design and draughting work in the High\-Rise department in India offices and supporting the global department which also has offices in Copenhagen, Dubai and Singapore.
   

  

**Job Description**
* Undertake electrical systems design, predominantly for building projects, including but not limited to MV and LV power systems, normal \& emergency lighting systems, earthing \& lightning protection systems, fire alarm and life safety systems, ICT, security systems and other ELV systems. To include preparation and delivery of design layouts, schematics, calculations, reports and specification from concept to tender design.
* Support for conducting primary technical reviews on design deliverables related to electrical system design.
* Preparation of load estimation for the project, including coordination with other disciplines and third party for electrical load and other requirements.
* Assist to Senior Engineer for space planning, report and preliminary calculations during concept design stage.
* Where design on middle east projects is being performed remotely with other Ramboll offices or by subconsultant, collaborate closely with those remote design teams and ensure compliance with local requirements and where directed, assist and represent the satisfactory performance of their services to local clients and stakeholders.
* Provide electrical engineering technical support and engage personally where required to successfully enable Local Authorities’ approvals on all projects.
* Mentor and coach junior and graduate engineers where directed.
* Check and review electrical design work undertaken by junior and graduate engineers.
* Forecast, plan and manage own workload and progress against agreed plan and criteria.
* Evaluate and advise to lead/senior engineer on electrical related design changes to ensure change management.
* Strong attention to detail, team working, collaboration, organization and problem\-solving skills.
* Ensure to follow QA/QC procedures in the projects.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Ensure that Health \& Safety is embedded into all work practices in line with company policies.
* Maintain and participate in Continuing Professional Development (CPD) events to develop own expertise.


**Qualifications**
* BE Electrical with 5\+ years of professional experience, out of which a minimum of 3 years should be in Middle East projects as an added advantage.
* Proven track record in building services design with different types of sectors, including high rise, commercial, residential, retail, healthcare, industrial, educational, refurbishment, etc.
* Proven record as a Project Engineer on several projects.
* Experienced in working within teams on multi\-disciplinary projects and interacting with a wide range of architectural, engineering and planning disciplines.
* Knowledge of electrical engineering principles for LV, Lighting, ELV and FA/FLS design.
* System overview knowledge of buildings mechanical and public health systems.
* An ability to adapt to different working styles and the unique business culture of the Middle East.
* Experienced in electrical design to BS\-EN, NEC, CIBSE, NFPA standards.
* A knowledge and experience of local statutory authorities’ regulations and submission requirements across Middle East, mainly UAE and KSA, such as DEWA, ADDC, SEC, SBC, Etisalat, Du, Civil Defence etc.
* Proven ability to carry out both manual and computer aided calculations, problem solving, technical analyses, etc.
* Proficient in LV power system modelling and analysis software such as Amtech (or similar), lighting software (Dialux Evo, Relux, or similar), Lightning Protection (Strike Risk or similar) and generator sizing.
* Competent use of relevant software such as MS Office suite.
* Knowledge and experience of AutoCAD, Autodesk Revit and Navisworks would be recommended.
* Knowledge of BIM automation / digitalisation techniques and standards.
* Awareness of sustainable design practices and technologies, preferably having worked on LEED or Estidama certified projects.
* Personal qualities that will help you succeed in this role include: self\-motivated, team player and able to work independently with minimum supervision and a flexible attitude in an environment with frequently changing deadlines and can be relied on to meet deadlines.

Therefore, we are committed to providing an inclusive and supportive work environment where everyone can flourish and reach their potential. title: AI SDLC – Manager
description:
**Technology Strategy and Transformation – Senior Manager – AI driven SDLC strategy**
 Join our team in Technology Strategy \& Transformation for an exciting career opportunity to help our most strategic clients realize exceptional value from AI in software delivery, a boardroom priority for organizations globally and be at the forefront of shaping how enterprises adopt AI\-native software engineering
   

  

**Practice:** 
 Technology Strategy \& Transformation, Global Network
   

  

**Areas of Work:** 
 AI Native SDLC Strategy, Agentic AI Architecture, Agentic Software Engineering, Engineering Productivity, AI Platform \& Tooling Strategy
   

  

**Level:** 
 Senior Manager
   

  

**Location:** 
 Bangalore/Gurugram/Mumbai/Pune/Chennai/Kolkata/Hyderabad
   

  

**Years of Exp:** 
 10\-15 years
   

  

**Explore an Exciting Career at Accenture**
 Do you believe software engineering is entering a new AI\-native era? Are you a problem solver who enjoys helping CIOs, CTOs, CDOs and engineering leaders rethink how software is imagined, designed, built, tested, secured and delivered using AI? Are you passionate about being part of an inclusive, diverse and collaborative culture?
   

  

 If yes, this is the right opportunity for you. Join Accenture Technology Strategy \& Transformation practice and work with global clients to shape the next frontier of enterprise software delivery using AI. Working with C\-suite stakeholders, you will help enterprises adopt AI\-native software delivery at scale and turn transformation ambition into measurable outcomes. You will help enterprises define AI\-powered software delivery transformation strategies and translate them into executable approaches, define target state SDLC, create platform and tooling strategy and architecture, engineering productivity measures, delivery operating model change and measurable value realization.
   

  

**The Practice – A Brief Sketch**
 Technology Strategy \& Transformation Practice is a part of Accenture Strategy and focuses on our clients’ most strategic priorities. We help clients achieve growth and efficiency through engineering transformation initiatives, aimed at making software delivery powered by AI to bring productivity and quality uplift, resulting in larger enterprise value delivery.
   

  

 We provide you with a strong learning environment, deep\-rooted in Technology Strategy, Software Engineering Transformation and AI\-led Reinvention, where you will work with key global clients to shape the next evolution of enterprise software delivery. As part of this high\-performing team, you will help organizations move from experimentation with AI coding tools to enterprise\-wide AI Native SDLC transformation. These are some of the initiatives you will support:
   

  

**AI Native SDLC Strategy and Roadmap:** 
 Assess current SDLC maturity, AI readiness, engineering productivity, application landscape assessment for AI driven delivery, toolchain landscape and delivery bottlenecks; define target\-state AI Native SDLC vision and pragmatic adoption roadmap
 **Engineering Productivity and AI Readiness Diagnosis:** 
 Diagnose developer experience, flow of work, quality gates, release throughput, automation levels, technology debt, test coverage, knowledge fragmentation and value leakage across large engineering organizations
 **Use Case Identification and Prioritization:** 
 Identify and prioritize AI and agentic use cases across requirements, backlog, architecture, design, coding, refactoring, testing, code review, security, release, documentation and run/operate interfaces; segment applications and teams where adoption makes business and technology sense
 **AI Native SDLC Platform and Tooling Strategy \& Architecture:** 
 Define architecture principles, reference architecture and tooling strategy across IDEs, repositories, CI/CD, DevSecOps, testing, knowledge systems, model gateways, context layer, RAG, agent orchestration, MCP, observability and governance
 **Value Case and Benefits Framework:** 
 Define productivity, velocity, quality, cost, risk and developer experience outcomes; establish measurement model, value case, benefits tracking and AI cost governance
 **Delivery Operating Model and Change:** 
 Design target\-state engineering operating model considering AI native software delivery and help organization transition to new operating model
 **Executive Advisory and Scale Strategy:** 
 Shape CxO narratives, transformation roadmaps, investment choices, vendor strategy and scale\-up plan for enterprise\-wide AI Native SDLC adoption
   

  

**Role Overview**
 We are looking for a visionary leader in Technology Strategy and Software Engineering Transformation who can help enterprises redefine how software is delivered in an AI\-native world. The role requires a senior consulting practitioner with strong understanding of enterprise SDLC, AI/ GenAI and Agentic architecture, engineering productivity, Agile, CI/CD and DevSecOps.
   

  

 The successful candidate will lead strategic advisory work across the AI Native SDLC transformation journey from current\-state maturity and AI readiness assessment to target\-state SDLC design, AI use case prioritization, platform and tooling strategy, value case development, benefits framework, roadmap definition and operating model change.
   

  

 The role requires executive presence, strong consulting capability and the ability to independently engage CIOs, CTOs, CDOs, CISOs, engineering leaders and product/platform teams. The candidate should be able to shape compelling transformation narratives, facilitate senior stakeholder alignment and translate AI\-powered software delivery ambition into practical, business\-aligned decisions and measurable outcomes.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**AI Native SDLC Strategy and Advisory**
* Lead current\-state SDLC maturity, AI readiness and engineering productivity assessments across large engineering organizations
* Define target\-state AI Native SDLC ambition and strategy across all stages of fotware delivery and software maintenance
* Conduct application landscape assessment to Identify applications, products and teams best suited for AI\-native and agentic SDLC adoption based on value, feasibility, risk and readiness
* Identify, structure and prioritize AI and agentic use cases across the software delivery lifecycle, linking them to engineering productivity, quality and measurable outcomes
* Facilitate senior stakeholder alignment on the adoption priorities, transformation choices and approach


**Target\-State SDLC Design, Architecture and Tooling Strategy**
* Design AI\-Native delivery workflows and agentic patterns across all stages of SDLC
* Define AI Native SDLC platform reference architecture across ALM, IDEs, repositories, CI/CD, DevSecOps, testing, observability, knowledge systems, model gateways, RAG/context layer, MCP/tool interfaces and guardrails with responsible AI frameworks pre\-built in the design
* Advise clients on AI platform, toolchain and vendor strategy, including integration approach, security, data/IP considerations, cost and developer adoption
* Define architecture principles, reusable patterns, guardrails, governance constructs and agentic evaluation criteria required to scale AI\-Native engineering responsibly
* Work with architecture, platform, security and engineering teams to connect strategy with implementation realities while maintaining an advisory and transformation\-planning focus


**Value Realization, Productivity Measurement and Engineering Operating Model**
* Build AI Native SDLC value cases covering various dimensions across productivity, quality, risk, experience and cost
* Define benefits framework and productivity measurement approach using baselines, KPIs, telemetry, DORA, SPACE, flow metrics, adoption metrics and executive reporting
* Define AI value economics and cost governance across licensing, token consumption, model usage, chargeback/showback, cost guardrails and benefit realization
* Design target engineering operating model covering product/platform ownership, AI SDLC center of excellence, roles and responsibilities, governance forums, enablement and change adoption
* Translate target\-state architecture and operating model into a phased transformation roadmap covering quick wins, foundational enablers, pilots, scaling waves and governance milestones


**Executive Advisory and Market Development**
* Lead CxO\-level conversations on AI Native SDLC strategy, engineering productivity, platform choices, tooling strategy, value realization, governance and operating model change
* Create expert content, PoVs and use executive storytelling, presentation and communication skills for C\-level discussions
* Support strategic pursuits, client account development and growth initiatives through differentiated advisory propositions, points of view, solution narratives and proposal leadership.
* Collaborate across different capabilities and teams to shape holistic client solutions and connect AI Native SDLC transformation with broader enterprise reinvention priorities
* Develop thought leadership, market perspectives, offering assets and reusable modernization frameworks
* Lead and mentor teams on AI, modern engineering, software delivery and engineering productivity measures


**Core Skillsets \& Tools**
**Enterprise Software Engineering and SDLC**
* Strong understanding of enterprise software delivery, including Agile, DevOps, DevSecOps, CI/CD, test automation, secure SDLC, release management, platform engineering and SRE concepts.
* Ability to assess SDLC maturity, engineering practices, delivery bottlenecks, toolchains, governance and productivity across large, distributed engineering organizations.
* Strong understanding of engineering productivity, developer experience, software quality, technical debt, application complexity and delivery value streams.
* Ability to design future\-state SDLC processes, governance models and transformation roadmaps aligned to business and engineering outcomes.
* Application Architecture, Engineering and AI


**AI / Agentic Fluency, Tools And Platform Capabilities**
* Strong understanding of GenAI, LLMs and agentic software engineering concepts, including prompt engineering, context engineering, RAG, MCP, agent orchestration, MCP, guardrails and evaluations
* Practical understanding of AI\-assisted SDLC use cases across requirements, backlog, architecture, coding, code review, refactoring, testing, security, documentation, release support and operations handover
* Familiarity with leading AI coding and SDLC tools such as GitHub Copilot, OpenAI Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, GitLab Duo, Amazon Q Developer, Gemini Code Assist, Sourcegraph Cody, Atlassian Rovo or equivalent tools
* Familiarity with AI platforms and agentic orchestration tools such as Microsoft/Azure AI Foundry, Amazon Bedrock, Google Vertex AI, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen/CrewAI, LangSmith/MLflow or equivalent platforms.
* Understanding of enterprise context and knowledge architectures using code indexing, embeddings, vector databases, enterprise search, knowledge graphs, RAG and model ecosystems including OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Llama and open\-source models.
* Ability to define toolchain architecture, vendor evaluation criteria, integration patterns, pilot approach, rollout considerations and governance required for scalable AI Native SDLC adoption.


**Value, Economics and Productivity Measurement**
* Ability to formulate AI Native SDLC value cases across productivity, cycle time, quality, risk, cost, developer experience and business agility outcomes
* Strong understanding of productivity measurement approaches including DORA, SPACE, flow metrics, adoption telemetry, developer surveys, quality metrics and release metrics
* Ability to assess AI economics, including license cost, token consumption, model usage, cost\-to\-serve, utilization, chargeback/showback and benefit realization governance
* Ability to connect AI adoption choices to measurable business outcomes and executive\-level investment decisions


**Consulting And Communication Skills**
* Strong consulting toolkit across structured problem solving, hypothesis\-led analysis, benchmarking, assessment design, facilitation, executive storytelling, business case development and roadmap definition
* Ability to drive CxO\-level conversations with credibility, influence senior stakeholders and align business, engineering, architecture, security, finance and technology teams
* Ability to independently lead client discussions, develop thought leadership, create compelling transformation narratives and shape opportunities in ambiguous environments
* Experience leading proposals, strategic pursuits, senior client relationships and high\-performing consulting teams


**Read More About Us.**
* The rise of forerunners
* Recent Blogs


**What’s in it for you?**
* An opportunity to work on transformative projects with key G2000 clients
* Potential to Co\-create with leaders in strategy, industry experts, enterprise function practitioners and, business intelligence professionals to shape and recommend innovative solutions that leverage emerging technologies.
* Ability to embed responsible business into everything—from how you service your clients to how you operate as a responsible professional.
* Personalized training modules to develop your strategy \& consulting acumen to grow your skills, industry knowledge and capabilities
* Opportunity to thrive in a culture that is committed to accelerate equality for all. Engage in boundaryless collaboration across the entire organization.


**About Accenture:**
 Accenture is a leading global professional services company, providing a broad range of services and solutions in strategy, consulting, digital, technology and operations. Combining unmatched experience and specialized skills across more than 40 industries and all business functions — underpinned by the world’s largest delivery network — Accenture works at the intersection of business and technology to help clients improve their performance and create sustainable value for their stakeholders. With 569,000 people serving clients in more than 120 countries, Accenture drives innovation to improve the way the world works and lives. Visit us at www.accenture.com
   

  

**About Accenture Strategy \& Consulting:**
 Accenture Strategy shapes our clients’ future, combining deep business insight with the understanding of how technology will impact industry and business models. Our focus on issues such as digital disruption, redefining competitiveness, operating and business models as well as the workforce of the future helps our clients find future value and growth in a digital world. Today, digital is changing the way organizations engage with their employees, business partners, customers and communities. This is our unique differentiator. To bring this global perspective to our clients, Accenture Strategy's services include those provided by our Capability Network – a distributed management consulting organization that provides management consulting and strategy expertise across the client lifecycle. Our Capability Network teams complement our in\-country teams to deliver cutting\-edge expertise and measurable value to clients all around the world. For more information visit https://www.accenture.com/us\-en/Careers/capability\-network

 We are the only professional services organization who has a separate business dedicated exclusively to the financial services marketplace. Join Digital Engineering Team and you will work with multi\-disciplinary teams from around the world to deliver a global perspective. Aligned to key industry groups including Asset management, Banking and Capital Markets, Insurance and Private Equity, Health, Government, Power and Utilities, we provide integrated advisory, assurance, tax, and transaction services.  We are looking for a Senior Engineer with 4–6 years of IT experience and strong expertise in Identity and Access Management (IAM), Windows Server platforms, and multi\-cloud integration (Azure, AWS, GCP). In this role, you will design, implement, and manage secure and scalable identity solutions, modernize Active Directory environments, and support enterprise hybrid cloud adoption. You will also drive automation, enforce compliance, and collaborate closely with architects, developers, and security teams to deliver enterprise\-grade solutions.

The Digital Engineering practice works with clients to analyse, formulate, design, mobilize and drive digital transformation initiatives. We advise clients on their most pressing digital challenges and opportunities surround business strategy, customer, growth, profit optimization, innovation, technology strategy, and digital transformation. * Identity \& Windows Platform Management

+ Implement and support SSO, MFA, Conditional Access, federation, and hybrid identity integrations for SaaS and on prem applications.

* Incident, RCA \& Operational Leadership
+ Own high priority technical incidents, lead major incident bridges, and drive swift service restoration.

* Reliability, Monitoring \& SRE Practices
+ Improve service reliability through proactive monitoring, trend analysis, observability enhancements, and SLO/SLI tracking.
+ Reduce MTTR and strengthen uptime through SRE methodologies and data driven insights.

* Automation, IaC \& Cloud Integration
+ Architect and implement automation using PowerShell, Terraform, Ansible, Python/Shell.
+ Drive IaC, GitOps, config drift controls, self healing mechanisms, and automated policy enforcement across cloud and identity workloads.

* Modernization, Migration \& Lifecycle Management
+ Lead modernization programs, platform upgrades, identity transformations, cloud migrations, and EOL remediation efforts.
+ Conduct dependency mapping, cutover planning, post migration validation, and maintain updated asset inventories.

* Security, Compliance \& Governance
+ Enforce RBAC, least privilege, Zero Trust, and configuration standards across all platforms.
+ Ensure compliance with ISO, CIS, NIST, maintain audit readiness, and uphold ITSM processes (Incident, Problem, Change).

* Collaboration, Mentoring \& Stakeholder Engagement
+ Partner with architects, application teams, cybersecurity, and cloud teams to deliver secure and scalable solutions.
+ Provide L3 technical support, mentor junior engineers, conduct code reviews, and develop high quality runbooks, SOPs, and knowledge sharing assets.
+ Present operational insights and reliability metrics to leadership to support data driven decisions.


**Required Skills**
**Skills and attributes for success**
* 4–6 years of core experience across IAM, Windows, Linux/Unix, and Cloud, including AD/ADFS, Azure AD, AWS IAM, Google Identity, Windows Server, GPO, and PKI.
* Expert level Linux/Unix administration, including deep kernel tuning, performance debugging, advanced filesystem analysis, and OS level troubleshooting.
* Strong cloud engineering expertise across Azure/AWS/GCP—covering networking, compute, storage, IAM, hybrid connectivity, and platform security.
* Advanced scripting \& automation engineering using Shell, Bash, Python, PowerShell, Terraform, and Ansible, with ability to build reusable automation frameworks.
* Advanced patching \& vulnerability management, including patch strategy design, automated patch cycles, remediation workflows, and compliance enforcement.
* SRE driven reliability engineering, including SLO/SLI definition, error budgets, chaos testing exposure, proactive monitoring, MTTR reduction, and systemic issue elimination.
* Strong observability \& monitoring expertise using Azure Monitor, CloudWatch, Splunk, Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, Dynatrace—able to build dashboards, alerting standards, and log pipelines.
* Security \& compliance grounding, including Zero Trust, RBAC, least privilege, MFA/SSO, federation, NIST/ISO/CIS benchmarks, and audit readiness.
* Hands on migration \& modernization experience, including provisioning workflow optimization, Windows/IAM/cloud migrations, EOL remediation, lifecycle upgrades, and environment cutovers.

title: Infra Managed Service Analyst
description:
**Job Summary**
 As an Application Tech Support Practitioner aligned to the ITAM practice, you will be the data\-quality and lifecycle steward for the client's Hardware Asset Management and Configuration Management Database estate on the Now Platform. Your typical day will involve executing Discovery and inventory reconciliation, maintaining asset and CI records, driving HAM workflow tickets (procurement → receive → deploy → maintain → retire → dispose), running CMDB Health remediation, and producing scheduled governance reports. You will work under moderate supervision and own an assigned CI class group or hardware category as the SME to L1 and L3 teams.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 HAM
   

  

 Execute the end\-to\-end hardware asset lifecycle on ServiceNow HAM/HAM Pro\-on Order, In Stock, In Use, In Maintenance, Retired, Disposed states\-for end\-user devices, data center equipment, network gear, and consumables.
   

  

 Maintain alm\_asset and alm\_hardware records: asset tags, serial numbers, ownership, location, cost\-centre, depreciation, and warranty/lease attributes.
   

  

 Process and fulfil IMAC (Install, Move, Add, Change) tickets, hardware refresh/reclamation, transfer orders between stockrooms, and disposal orders with full audit\-trail documentation.
   

  

 Understand HAM / CMDB normalization concept\-resolve unnormalized models, manufacturer aliases, and EOL/EOSL dates; drive normalization to ≥95% target.
   

  

 Perform scheduled and ad\-hoc inventory audits (including Mobile Agent/barcode scanning); reconcile physical vs. system records and remediate ghost/missing assets.
   

  

 Track lease and warranty data, raise renewals 60\-90 days in advance, and feed refresh planning into Procurement.
   

  

 Maintain stockroom, bundle, consumable, and model\-category data per defined policy.
   

  

 CMDB
   

  

 Maintain CI hygiene across CMDB CI classes within scope.
   

  

 Apply and tune Identification \& Reconciliation Engine (IRE) rules\-identification rules, reconciliation rules, data source precedence, and inclusion rules\-for assigned CI classes; resolve duplicate\-CI and overloaded\-CI exceptions.
   

  

 Drive and configure CMDB Health remediation against Completeness, Compliance, and Correctness KPIs in CMDB Workspace; clear orphan/stale/duplicate CI failures before the failure threshold is reached.
   

  

 Configure and process CI attestation, Data Certification, and CMDB Workspace Data Manager retirement/delete policies for stale CIs.
   

  

 Maintain CI relationships per the Common Service Data Model (CSDM 5\.0\)\-Foundation, Ideation \& Strategy, Design \& Planning, Build \& Integration, Service Delivery, Service Consumption, and Manage Portfolios domains.
   

  

 Build and schedule operational reports and Performance Analytics widgets covering CMDB Health %, Hardware Normalization %, Asset Refresh due, Stockroom inventory, and Audit findings.
   

  

**Required Skills**
 3\+ years of hands\-on ServiceNow/others administration with at least 2 years on HAM and/or CMDB.
   

  

 Demonstrated working knowledge of HAM lifecycle states, asset/model/category data model, stockrooms, transfer orders, purchase orders, receiving slips, asset bundles, and disposal orders.
   

  

 Working knowledge of CMDB tables, CI classes, and CSDM concepts.
   

  

 Hands\-on with IRE identification rules, reconciliation rules, and at least one duplicate\-CI deduplication exercise.
   

  

 Working knowledge of CMDB Health (Completeness, Compliance, Correctness) and dashboard remediation.
   

  

 ITIL v4 process awareness\-Incident, Problem, Change, Configuration Management, Service Request.
   

  

 Import Sets/Transform Maps fundamentals; ability to read JavaScript/Glide script for basic edits.
   

  

 Strong written and oral communication in English; ability to run client status calls.
   

  

 Tools \& Technologies
   

  

 ServiceNow Modules
   

  

 HAM, HAM Pro, ITAM, CMDB, Discovery, Service Mapping, ITSM, Performance Analytics, Mobile Agent, CMDB Workspace, Hardware Asset Workspace, Now Assist for ITAM (awareness).
   

  

 Educational Qualification:
   

  

 15 years of full\-time education
   

  

 Flexible to work in any shift, including rotational shifts, based on business requirements

title: DevSecOps Engineer
description:
**Job Title :** 
 DevSecOps Engineer
 



**Experience:** 
 4\+ Years
 



**Location:** 
 Mumbai/Chennai/Pune
 



**Employment Type:** 
 Long\-Term Contract
 



  





**Job Overview** 




  





 We are seeking a highly skilled Senior DevOps / DevSecOps Engineer to design, implement, automate, and maintain cloud infrastructure and deployment platforms for enterprise applications.
 



 The role will focus heavily on Microsoft Azure, Kubernetes/AKS, Argo CD, Argo Workflows, Terraform, Helm, Azure Blob Storage, Azure File Share, CI/CD automation, security, observability, and production operations. The successful candidate will work closely with application development, architecture, security, QA, and platform teams to deliver reliable, secure, scalable, and highly automated application platforms across Dev, QA/UAT, and Production environments.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**Azure Cloud Infrastructure** 



* Design, provision, configure, and maintain Azure cloud infrastructure for enterprise application workloads.
* Manage Azure resources for application hosting, networking, security, storage, identity, and monitoring.
* Deploy and manage containerized workloads using Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS).
* Manage Azure Container Registry (ACR) for container image storage and distribution.
* Configure and maintain Azure Key Vault for secrets, certificates, and sensitive configuration.
* Manage Azure Storage Accounts, Blob Storage, and Azure File Shares.
* Support Azure database infrastructure, backups, monitoring, start/stop operations, and performance\-related activities.
* Implement Azure RBAC and Managed Identities following least\-privilege principles.
* Support scalability, high availability, disaster recovery, and operational resilience.



**Kubernetes / AKS** 



* Design, deploy, configure, and maintain Kubernetes/AKS environments.
* Deploy and manage microservices and containerized workloads.
* Work with Kubernetes resources including:
* Deployments
* Services
* ConfigMaps
* Secrets
* Ingress
* Service Accounts
* Jobs/CronJobs
* Namespaces
* Configure resource requests/limits, autoscaling, health probes, and rollout strategies.
* Troubleshoot pod failures, scheduling issues, image\-pull failures, networking issues, configuration problems, and deployment failures.
* Implement and maintain Kubernetes RBAC, service discovery, networking, and persistent storage.
* Support production Kubernetes operations and incident resolution.



**Argo CD / GitOps** 



* Implement and maintain GitOps\-based deployment models using Argo CD.
* Configure Argo CD applications, projects, repositories, environments, and synchronization strategies.
* Maintain Helm\-based deployment configurations and environment\-specific values.
* Troubleshoot synchronization, health\-check, deployment, and configuration issues.
* Implement controlled and auditable deployments across Dev, QA/UAT, and Production.
* Promote declarative and version\-controlled application delivery practices.



**Argo Workflows** 



* Design, configure, and maintain Argo Workflows for application and platform automation.
* Develop workflow templates for build, validation, migration, deployment, and operational activities.
* Troubleshoot workflow failures, dependencies, parameters, artifacts, secrets, and execution issues.
* Integrate Argo Workflows with Kubernetes and other project services.



**Terraform / Infrastructure as Code** 



* Provision and manage Azure infrastructure using Terraform.
* Develop reusable and maintainable Terraform modules.
* Manage Terraform providers, variables, outputs, state, dependencies, and environment\-specific configurations.
* Implement infrastructure changes through controlled CI/CD pipelines.
* Troubleshoot Terraform plans, state issues, dependencies, and deployment failures.
* Follow Infrastructure as Code best practices to ensure consistent and repeatable environments.



**Helm \& Application Configuration** 



* Develop and maintain Helm charts for Kubernetes applications.
* Manage environment\-specific Helm values and configurations.
* Integrate Kubernetes deployments with Azure Key Vault and secure configuration mechanisms.
* Ensure sensitive information is never hardcoded in source repositories or deployment manifests.
* Standardize application configuration across Dev, QA/UAT, and Production.



**CI/CD \& Release Automation** 



* Design, implement, and maintain CI/CD pipelines for microservices and platform components.
* Automate:
* Source validation
* Application builds
* Unit/integration testing
* Container image creation
* Security scanning
* Image publishing
* Deployment
* Release validation
* Integrate pipelines with Git, ACR, Kubernetes, Helm, Argo CD, and Argo Workflows.
* Implement controlled promotion strategies across Dev, QA/UAT, and Production.
* Troubleshoot pipeline failures, deployment issues, and release problems.



**DevSecOps \& Security** 



* Integrate security practices throughout CI/CD and infrastructure processes.
* Implement container image and dependency vulnerability scanning.
* Secure credentials, tokens, passwords, certificates, and API keys.
* Use Azure Key Vault or approved secret\-management mechanisms.
* Implement least\-privilege access using Azure RBAC, Kubernetes RBAC, and Managed Identities.
* Review Kubernetes manifests, Terraform configurations, Dockerfiles, and Helm charts for security issues.
* Support security remediation, compliance, and governance requirements.
* Experience with tools such as Trivy, SonarQube, OPA, or Kyverno is an advantage.



**Networking** 



* Work with Azure and Kubernetes networking components including:
* Azure Virtual Networks
* Subnets
* NSGs
* Private Endpoints
* Private DNS
* DNS
* Load Balancers
* Application Gateway
* Ingress
* Routing
* Firewall configuration
* Troubleshoot application connectivity, DNS, ingress, load\-balancing, and network\-related deployment issues.
* Understand internal vs. external traffic and connectivity between Azure services and AKS workloads.



**Monitoring, Logging \& Observability** 



* Implement monitoring, logging, alerting, and observability for infrastructure and applications.
* Monitor:
* Kubernetes clusters
* Pods and nodes
* Application health
* CPU/memory utilization
* Deployment health
* Pipeline health
* Infrastructure availability
* Work with Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, Application Insights, Prometheus, and Grafana.
* Investigate production incidents using logs, metrics, Kubernetes events, and diagnostic tools.
* Support alerting, incident management, root\-cause analysis, and preventive actions.



**Production Support** 



* Provide L2/L3 DevOps and platform support for production environments.
* Troubleshoot infrastructure, Kubernetes, networking, configuration, and deployment issues.
* Support production releases, rollback, and recovery activities.
* Perform root\-cause analysis for recurring issues.
* Participate in incident management and post\-incident reviews.
* Maintain operational documentation and troubleshooting procedures.



**Database \& Migration Support** 



* Support deployment\-related database migration requirements for microservices.
* Integrate automated database migrations into application deployment processes where required.
* Ensure migrations are executed securely and consistently across environments.
* Coordinate with development teams on migration\-related deployment activities.



**Collaboration \& Technical Leadership** 



* Collaborate closely with developers, architects, QA, security, and infrastructure teams.
* Define and enforce DevOps and deployment standards.
* Participate in architecture and infrastructure discussions.
* Review Terraform, Helm, Kubernetes, and CI/CD changes.
* Mentor junior DevOps engineers.
* Identify opportunities to improve automation, reliability, security, performance, and deployment efficiency.



  





**Must\-Have Technical Skills** 




  





 • Microsoft Azure
 



 • Kubernetes / AKS
 



 • Docker
 



 • Argo CD / GitOps
 



 • Argo Workflows
 



 • Terraform / Infrastructure as Code
 



 • Helm
 



 • Strong CI/CD pipeline experience
 



 • Git
 



 • Azure Key Vault
 



 • Azure Container Registry (ACR)
 



 • Azure VNet, Subnets, NSGs, DNS, Load Balancers, Ingress, and Routing
 



 • Azure RBAC, Kubernetes RBAC, Managed Identity, secrets management, and vulnerability scanning
 



 • Linux administration and troubleshooting

 You'll own the words behind our ads, landing pages, and funnels: understand the audience, find the angle, write the hooks and scripts, watch the numbers, and rewrite based on what the data says.

* A strong copywriter above all — ads, hooks, headlines, landing pages, emails, and video scripts

* Familiar with coaching, consulting, EdTech, or info\-products

* Comfortable with UGC scripts, VSLs, short\-form video, and nurture sequences
* Uses AI tools well, but knows when human craft matters more
* Fluent written and spoken English
* 1–3 years in performance/digital marketing (strong portfolio can override this)



  





 📊 HOW YOU'LL BE MEASURED
 



 CTR, CPL/CPA, lead quality, landing page conversion, ROAS, writing output, winning hooks identified, and client revenue influenced by your copy.

 Reliable laptop, stable internet, power backup, IST availability, strong English, and a portfolio with real performance data.

* You can't show your own writing with real performance data

* You want to strategize but not write daily — this role writes

 We're not after pretty sentences. We want a writer who can answer: "What should we say, to whom, why will they care, how do we package it, and how do we know it's working?"
