title: SAP Training/ Capability Development
description:
**Role Overview** 




 Mindsprint is building a full\-scale SAP Academy to create a continuous, predictable pipeline of deployable SAP talent — spanning campus recruits (engineering, CA, CMA, MBA), adjacent/transferable hires, and existing employees needing upskilling. The Academy Lead owns this end\-to\-end: cohort design, classroom delivery, capstone projects, live\-project deployment, account\-specific coaching, leadership\-behavior development, and governance. This is a program\-ownership role, not a pure trainer role — building curriculum, managing a faculty pool of senior consultants, maintaining training infrastructure, and reporting progress to practice leadership.
 



  





**Business Objectives** 



* **Build and operationalize** 
 a structured 3\-month SAP Academy for campus recruits across engineering, CA, CMA, and MBA entry points, with staggered intake windows, and create a repeatable pipeline to hire, train, and deploy adjacent or transferable talent into live projects.
* **Reduce time\-to\-productivity and pre\-deployment attrition** 
 through measurable, gated readiness checkpoints (iMocha, capstone, mentor sign\-off), while upskilling experienced hires on emerging SAP areas — S/4HANA, Clean Core, BTP, SAP\-AI/Joule.
* **Institutionalize the Academy** 
 — governance, faculty rotation, calendar cadence, and career\-pathway linkage — so it operates independent of any single individual's bandwidth.



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* **Cohort \& Curriculum Design —** 
 Design a rolling cohort model routing campus recruits from different academic backgrounds into functional or technical tracks after a common foundation module. Own the full 3\-month curriculum architecture (foundation, track\-specific training, capstone, pre\-deployment gate), refreshed continuously against cohort feedback and the evolving SAP/AI landscape (S/4HANA, Clean Core, RISE).
* **Training Delivery \& Capstone Evaluation —** 
 Conduct or coordinate instructor\-led, virtual, and hands\-on training across SAP modules, personally facilitating at least two modules; build and manage a rotating faculty pool of senior consultants and guest SMEs. Design end\-to\-end capstone scenarios in a sandbox environment that mirror real client builds, with defined evaluation rubrics and senior evaluators.
* **Deployment \& Assessment —** 
 Manage the shadow\-to\-full\-time deployment pipeline (mentor/buddy assignment, transition gates); own the 30/60/90\-day post\-deployment feedback cycle and feed gaps back into curriculum design. Administer iMocha assessments at entry, checkpoint, and pre\-deployment stages, tracking score trends as a leading indicator of readiness.
* **Account \& Leadership Development —** 
 Design account\-specific onboarding content (org structure, SAP landscape, terminology) for each active account, coordinating leadership introductions and buddy assignments. Run a recurring leadership\-behaviors track — communication, customer centricity, executive presence — including role\-plays and leadership touchpoints across the program.
* **Tools, Domain \& Infrastructure —** 
 Ensure recruits are proficient in Excel, PowerPoint, and Word to client\-ready standards; coordinate Day\-1 onboarding to internal systems (Grow, Darwin Box) with HR. Partner with ISG (or an equivalent domain partner) on Food \& Agri and other industry\-understanding sessions sequenced after SAP foundations. Own sandbox S/4HANA systems, capstone environments, iMocha/LMS licensing, training materials, and training\-room/virtual logistics across Chennai and Bangalore.
* **Program Governance —** 
 Run the review cadence — weekly cohort pulse checks, bi\-weekly track\-lead syncs, monthly steering committee reviews, quarterly effectiveness reviews. Maintain a central metrics dashboard (intake data, iMocha and capstone scores, shadow\-to\-full\-time conversion time, 90\-day feedback, attrition) and own the operationalization roadmap from design through steady\-state scale\-up. Drive SAP\-AI adoption and tie Academy completion to a visible career\-pathway credential.



  





**Required Skills \& Competencies** 



* **SAP Expertise —** 
 Strong functional and/or technical knowledge in two or more SAP modules (FI/CO, MM, SD, HCM, PP/QM, ABAP/BTP, etc.). SAP S/4HANA experience strongly preferred; familiarity with Clean Core and BTP is an advantage. Exposure to implementations, rollouts, RISE with SAP, or support environments.
* **Program Ownership \& Instructional Design —** 
 Demonstrated experience designing or running a structured, multi\-week training program or academy — not just delivering individual sessions. Ability to build curricula, assessment frameworks, and capstone/evaluation rubrics from scratch, and to create digital learning content (e\-learning modules, videos, quick\-reference guides).
* **Facilitation \& Stakeholder Skills —** 
 Excellent facilitation and presentation skills, able to simplify complex technical concepts for varied audiences. Strong stakeholder management across HR, Track Leads, account delivery leaders, Project Managers, and external domain partners; an analytical, metrics\-driven, learner\-centric mindset.



  





**Qualifications:** 




 Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, IT, Business, or a related field. SAP certification(s) preferred. Training or instructional\-design certifications (e.g., Train\-the\-Trainer, Instructional Design) are a plus.
 



  





**Preferred Experience:** 




 Experience in large\-scale SAP transformation programs (e.g., RISE with SAP S/4HANA migrations); exposure to global training rollouts across multiple geographies or entities; familiarity with agile project environments; prior experience setting up or scaling a corporate academy, campus\-to\-competency pipeline, or GCC\-style capability\-building function; and exposure to commodity, agri, or manufacturing industry domains.

By identifying risks early, NURA aims to improve treatment outcomes and support long\-term health. NURA operates dedicated screening centers in multiple cities across India, including Bengaluru, Gurugram, Mumbai, Hyderabad, Calicut, and Chennai. Team members work in a technology\-forward environment that prioritizes preventive healthcare and patient education.
 



**Role Description** 
 This full\-time, on\-site Registered Nurse role is based at the NURA center in Chennai. The Registered Nurse will provide direct patient care during screening visits, including preparing individuals for procedures, monitoring vital signs, and assisting with AI\-enabled imaging workflows as needed. Responsibilities include collecting medical histories, supporting physicians and other clinicians, administering medications when indicated, and ensuring adherence to established protocols and infection control standards. The nurse will educate patients about screening results, follow\-up recommendations, and lifestyle modifications, while maintaining detailed and accurate clinical documentation. The role also involves coordinating appointments, supporting quality improvement initiatives, and contributing to a safe, efficient, and patient\-centered environment.
 



**Qualifications** 







* Valid Registered Nurse license and completion of an accredited nursing program; bachelor’s degree in nursing (BSN) preferred.
* Clinical skills in patient assessment, vital sign monitoring, basic emergency response, and safe medication administration.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills to educate patients, collaborate with multidisciplinary teams, and provide compassionate care.
* Ability to follow clinical protocols, maintain accurate documentation, and uphold high standards of infection control and patient safety.
* Comfort working with healthcare technology and diagnostic equipment; openness to learning AI\-enabled imaging and digital workflows.
* Experience in preventive care, outpatient services, or diagnostic centers is an advantage; prior oncology or lifestyle disease screening experience is a plus.
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced, on\-site clinical setting in Chennai, with strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

 Bachelor’s or master’s degree in electrical, Electronics, Instrumentation, Mechatronics Engineering, or a related technical discipline.

description:

Founded in Denmark, Ramboll is a people company. We invite you to contribute to a sustainable future working in an open, collaborative and empowering culture.
   

  

**Ramboll in India**
 Ramboll has more than 1,000 experts working across five offices in India applying their passion to deliver innovative solutions in markets as diverse as Buildings, Transport, Planning \& Urban Design, Water, Environment \& Health and Energy. Founded in Denmark, Ramboll is a people company. We invite you to contribute to a sustainable future working in an open, collaborative and empowering culture.

 As one of the top 10 building designers in the world, Ramboll works on more than 10,000 building projects each year. 5,000 experts across the world specialize in creating more innovative, sustainable and livable buildings. We place particular emphasis on our livable buildings concept where we balance the cultural, social and physical values of buildings, to improve the quality of life for building users.
   

  

**You will join our High\-Rise Buildings** 
**Department**
**About The Role**
 Join Ramboll’s global High\-Rise Buildings team, which has delivered over 150 tall building projects worldwide. As a Senior BIM Modeller, you will contribute to BIM project delivery by producing
 **high\-quality, well\-coordinated, and technically accurate 3D models and 2D drawings** 
 , ensuring timely delivery and compliance with standards across all design stages.
   

  

**Job Description**
 Your key tasks and responsibilities will be:
   

  

  

* Deliver accurate and coordinated structural models and drawings from concept to As\-built using Autodesk Revit and AutoCAD.
* Ensure adherence to Ramboll templates, standards, and BIM Execution Plan (BEP) for all deliverables.

* Apply correct Revit workflows: modelling, tagging, view templates, worksets, schedules, and coordination processes.
* Develop Revit families, generate PDF/DWG exports, and prepare drawings as needed.
* Perform clash detection, resolve coordination issues, and maintain discipline model links.
* Support automation processes and manage ACC Revit workflows (Publish/Share/Consume).
* Communicate proactively with the BIM Manger/BIM Lead regarding project challenges and propose improvements.
* Carry out self\-checks to ensure compliance with QA standards and checking procedures.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Civil/Structural Engineering.
* Min. 5 to 10\+ year of work experience in 3D BIM and REVIT. Dynamo knowledge will be an added advantage
* Experience in implementing the BIM Adoption of different BIM authoring tools and collaboration technology.
* Good knowledge of local/ International building standards
* Proficient with MS Office (Work, Excel, MS Project, PowerPoint).
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a global team.
* Problem\-solving and proactive approach to project delivery challenges.
* Ability to develop Revit families and manage multi\-disciplinary model integration
* Autodesk Revit, AutoCAD, Navisworks Manage, Solibri, BIMCollab.
* Familiarity with RTV Exporter, DiRoots/Naviate/Ideate tools, Rhino, Dynamo, and ACC features.


**Additional Information**
**Inviting bright minds to solve the world’s climate challenge**
 Do you want to push the boundaries of your profession and develop your excellence in an open, collaborative and empowering culture? We work to create a sustainable future, and our inspiring projects and innovative solutions aim to set the standard among our peers. You will join a global company that has been growing successfully since its founding in 1945\. Together, we lead and leave a positive impact on societies, companies and people around the world.

 Apply online. Attach your CV, cover letter and relevant documents showcasing why you are the right fit for the role, and when you are available to start. We look forward to receiving your application.

title: Director IT
description:
**Job Family**
 IT Management (India)
   

  

**Travel Required**
 Up to 25%
   

  

**Clearance Required**
 None
   

  

**What You Will Do**
 The Director, India IT – Applications \& Transformation Leader is the senior leader accountable for the full India IT organization and its contribution to Guidehouse’s global technology strategy. The role combines enterprise leadership for India with a primary mandate to build a strong, scalable application capability that supports major platforms such as Workday and Microsoft Dynamics, as well as custom\-developed capabilities such as Engagement Hub.
   

  

 This leader will shape talent, delivery methods, technical depth, and business partnership across the India team. The role will work closely with global application portfolio leaders, business\-function executives, architecture, cybersecurity, data and AI, and operational teams to translate enterprise priorities into secure, scalable solutions and sustained business outcomes.
   

  

 An India IT Operations Lead will report to this role and will manage day\-to\-day regional operations, service delivery, infrastructure coordination, and operational execution. The Director remains accountable for the performance, integration, talent strategy, and overall effectiveness of the entire India IT organization.
   

  

**Key Outcomes**
* Build India into a strategic center of excellence for enterprise applications, platform configuration, integration, testing, technical delivery, and application support.
* Create durable delivery capacity for Workday, Microsoft Dynamics, and custom\-developed enterprise capabilities, including Engagement Hub and future digital products.
* Increase India IT’s ability to engage business functions as a consultative transformation partner, not only as a task\-oriented delivery resource.
* Establish clear accountability between application delivery and India operations, with the Operations Lead managing daily run responsibilities and escalating material risks and decisions.
* Develop a high\-performing talent model with strong succession, technical career paths, leadership depth, and the ability to flex capacity across strategic priorities.
* Improve delivery predictability, solution quality, operational readiness, documentation, and transition from project delivery into ongoing support.


**Key Responsibilities**
* India IT Enterprise Leadership
* Serve as the senior leader accountable for the full India IT organization, spanning application delivery, engineering, platform support, operations, and shared technology services.
* Translate global IT strategy, portfolio roadmaps, and business priorities into an integrated India capability, workforce, and execution plan.
* Act as the principal technology partner for India\-based leaders while maintaining strong alignment with Guidehouse global CIO leadership and enterprise portfolio owners.
* Create a unified culture across application and operations teams with clear decision rights, performance expectations, service ownership, and escalation paths.
* Represent India IT in enterprise governance, investment, capacity, risk, and transformation discussions.
* Enterprise Applications \& Product Capability
* Build and lead application capabilities supporting Workday, Microsoft Dynamics, and custom\-developed enterprise products such as Engagement Hub.
* Partner with global portfolio leaders and business\-function leadership to understand functional strategy, shape roadmaps, assess requirements, and convert priorities into executable delivery plans.
* Establish platform and product ownership discipline across design, configuration, development, integration, testing, deployment, enhancement, and support.
* Develop reusable technical and delivery capabilities across application engineering, integration, quality assurance, DevSecOps, data, automation, and production readiness.
* Ensure India teams develop deep platform expertise and business\-domain understanding rather than operating solely as general\-purpose delivery capacity.
* Create mechanisms to share talent and specialized expertise across portfolio teams without diluting business\-domain accountability.
* Business Transformation \& Functional Partnership
* Bring direct experience supporting transformation in large, complex organizations, including the modernization of core business functions such as human capital, finance, sales, marketing, legal, resource management, or enterprise operations.
* Challenge fragmented or purely technical requirements and help leaders define future\-state processes, capability roadmaps, operating\-model implications, and measurable outcomes.
* Promote simplification, standardization, automation, and adoption of platform\-native capabilities before introducing unnecessary customization.
* Delivery Excellence \& Modern Engineering
* Establish consistent delivery practices for agile execution, product management, DevSecOps, release readiness, quality engineering, documentation, and application lifecycle management.
* Improve predictability across strategic programs through disciplined scope, dependency, capacity, risk, issue, and milestone management.
* Partner with Enterprise Architecture, Cybersecurity, Data and Agentic Foundations, and Strong Operations to ensure solutions comply with architecture, data, security, integration, and production standards.
* Advance the responsible use of AI\-enabled and agentic development methods to increase team capacity, quality, speed, and reuse while preserving human accountability and control.
* Create a clear project\-to\-operations transition model, including acceptance criteria, knowledge transfer, support ownership, service levels, monitoring, and continuous improvement.
* Operations Leadership \& Delegated Run Accountability
* Lead and develop the India IT Operations Lead, who will be accountable for daily regional operations, support coordination, operational performance, business continuity, and service improvement.
* Set objectives, decision rights, service expectations, metrics, and escalation thresholds for India IT operations while avoiding duplication with global Strong Operations ownership.
* Retain executive accountability for India service performance, workforce integration, major incidents, operational risk, and the effectiveness of the application\-to\-operations handoff.
* Ensure regional operations comply with enterprise standards, security requirements, audit obligations, and global service\-management processes.
* People, Organization \& Capability Development
* Build, lead, and develop multidisciplinary teams across application platforms, custom development, integration, testing, data, operations, and technical leadership.
* Define the India application talent strategy, including priority skills, hiring profiles, sourcing approach, internal mobility, succession, and leadership development.
* Establish communities of practice and technical career paths that deepen expertise in Workday, Microsoft Dynamics, modern development, integration, quality engineering, and application support.
* Coach leaders to operate with greater business acumen, consultative capability, accountability, urgency, and enterprise perspective.
* Partner with Talent Acquisition and Human Capital teams to attract, develop, engage, and retain high\-caliber technology talent.
* Governance, Risk, Financial \& Vendor Management
* Own the India IT workforce and delivery plan, budget inputs, resource allocation, vendor utilization, and cost optimization in alignment with global IT priorities.
* Provide transparent reporting on delivery, application health, operational performance, capacity, talent, risks, financials, and improvement plans.
* Ensure compliance with corporate policy, cybersecurity standards, privacy requirements, audit obligations, change control, and regulatory commitments.
* Oversee strategic delivery partners and vendors, holding them accountable for quality, outcomes, knowledge transfer, contractual performance, and value.
* Identify and mitigate concentration, continuity, talent, delivery, security, and operational risks across the India technology organization.


**What You Will Need**
* Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related discipline.
* 15\+ years of progressive enterprise technology experience, including significant leadership responsibility in a global or large\-scale organization.
* Proven experience leading enterprise application delivery, platform teams, or technology transformation across multiple business functions.
* Demonstrated experience building or materially scaling offshore or India\-based application capabilities, including talent, delivery methods, governance, and leadership depth.
* Strong knowledge of core business functions and the ability to connect process, data, controls, and technology into an integrated transformation agenda.
* Experience supporting major enterprise platforms such as Workday, Microsoft Dynamics, SAP, Oracle, Salesforce, ServiceNow, or comparable products; direct Workday and/or Dynamics experience is strongly preferred.
* Experience delivering or supporting custom\-developed enterprise applications using modern engineering, integration, testing, DevSecOps, and lifecycle\-management practices.
* Proven success partnering with senior business and technology executives, influencing across organizational boundaries, and leading through ambiguity.
* Demonstrated ability to manage geographically distributed teams, complex delivery portfolios, budgets, vendors, risk, and organizational change.


**What Would Be Nice To Have**
* Master’s degree in technology, engineering, business administration, or a related field.
* Direct leadership experience with Workday HCM or Financials, Microsoft Dynamics 365, Power Platform, Azure, or enterprise integration platforms.
* Experience modernizing back\-office or front\-office functions in a large professional\-services, consulting, financial\-services, healthcare, government\-services, or similarly complex enterprise environment.
* Experience establishing product\-oriented operating models, centers of excellence, full\-lifecycle platform management, and measurable service or transformation outcomes.
* Familiarity with AI\-enabled software delivery, agentic development, data platforms, enterprise architecture, cybersecurity, and cloud operating models.


**About Guidehouse India**
 At Guidehouse India, we’re redefining what’s possible by creating opportunities that change lives. Guidehouse is a global professional services firm that delivers advisory, technology, and managed services to clients across both the commercial and public sectors. Our teams turn bold ideas into solutions that transform industries, strengthen communities, and drive meaningful impact worldwide.
   

  

 Across our Chennai, Trivandrum, and Gurugram locations, you’ll find opportunities where your passion and curiosity help shape what comes next. With cutting edge benefits, innovative learning and development programs, and a people first culture, we empower our people to lead with purpose.
   

  

 We continue to expand our teams and capabilities across India, investing in state\-of\-the\-art offices and high impact work. Here, you’ll collaborate with experts from around the world, build deep expertise, explore new domains, and accelerate your professional growth while making a real impact.
   

  

**What We Offer**
 At Guidehouse India, we are committed to supporting the well\-being of our people and their families at every stage of life. We offer competitive compensation and a comprehensive benefits package designed to help you thrive both inside and outside the workplace.
   

  

 Our benefits include resources such as in house physician consultations, nutritious food options at the workplace, and confidential counseling through our Employee Assistance Program, along with other wellness focused offerings that support your overall well being.
   

  

 Our comprehensive learning and development programs ensure you’re continuously upskilled and ready to tackle what’s next, so you can shape your own career path while contributing to meaningful, purpose driven work.

All information you provide will be kept confidential and used only as required to support the recruitment process.

description:
**Company Profile**
**Lennox (NYSE: LII)** 
 Driven by 130 years of legacy, HVAC and refrigeration success, Lennox provides our residential and commercial customers with industry\-leading climate\-control solutions. At Lennox, we win as a team, aiming for excellence and delivering innovative, sustainable products and services. Our culture guides us and creates a workplace where all employees feel heard and welcomed. Lennox is a global community that values each team member’s contributions and offers a supportive environment for career development. Come, stay, and grow with us.
   

  

**Job Description**
 The Lead Architect owns the end\-to\-end technical design of enterprise applications built on Java and the Spring ecosystem. The role combines hands\-on architecture of cloud\-ready, event\-driven microservices with technical leadership across the software development lifecycle \- setting standards, mentoring engineers, driving engineering excellence and ensuring solutions are scalable, secure, resilient, and aligned with business goals. You will collaborate closely with cross\-functional teams, including developers, product managers, and business stakeholders, to deliver innovative and future\-proof solutions.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Own the end\-to\-end architecture for assigned systems, from solution design through detailed component, integration, and deployment architecture.
* Translate business and product requirements into scalable, secure, and maintainable technical solutions while collaborating closely with business, product, and delivery teams.
* Define and maintain architectural standards, best practices, governance frameworks, and technical roadmaps.
* Ensure non\-functional requirements including performance, scalability, security, availability, resilience, and fault tolerance are incorporated into all solutions.
* Design and oversee the development of Java\-based, cloud\-ready microservices using Spring Boot, REST APIs, and event\-driven architectures.
* Provide architectural guidance to development teams and ensure implementation aligns with the approved architecture.
* Partners with product and delivery leads to estimate effort, sequence work, and manage architectural dependencies and technical risks.
* Lead the development of new features, enhancements, and modernization initiatives across the application landscape.
* Participate in and provide technical leadership throughout the Software Development Lifecycle (requirements, design, development, testing, deployment, and support).
* Conduct architecture and code reviews to ensure compliance with coding standards, security guidelines, and quality best practices.
* Drive engineering excellence through Agile architecture, DevSecOps practices, CI/CD automation, and cloud adoption.
* Optimize application performance, troubleshooting complex technical issues, and continuously improving system reliability.
* Mentor architects and senior developers while fostering collaboration, innovation, and technical excellence.
* Promote knowledge sharing through technical documentation, architecture artifacts, workshops, and training sessions.
* Stay current with emerging technologies and evaluate their applicability to improve business outcomes and engineering capabilities


**Qualifications**
* 10–12 years of experience in enterprise application development, with at least 3\+ years in a Solution Architect or Technical Lead role.
* Proven experience designing and delivering enterprise\-scale, distributed applications and microservices.
* Strong expertise in Java SE/EE and Spring ecosystem (Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Spring Security).
* Proficiency in Java as the primary language, with working knowledge of Python or JavaScript as an advantage.
* Experience designing RESTful APIs, microservices, event\-driven architectures, and integration using SOAP where required.
* Experience with messaging platforms such as Kafka or RabbitMQ and API Gateway technologies.
* Strong knowledge of relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server) and database design principles.
* Familiarity with front\-end technologies such as HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and frameworks like React.
* Experience with Git and modern software development workflows.
* Experience implementing DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and cloud\-native deployment patterns.
* Hands\-on experience with a major cloud platform (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and experience with containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes).
* Familiarity with observability and monitoring tooling (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, ELK) and SLO/SLA definition.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with the ability to troubleshoot complex technical issues.
* Ability to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions aligned with enterprise architecture.

title: Junior Payment Dev/Test EngineerFull Stack Engineer
description:
**Junior Payment Dev/Test Engineer** 




**IntelloCore** 
 \| Engineering – Payment Assurance
 



 preferred
 **Location:** 
 Noida/Chennai (Hybrid)
 



**Experience:** 
 1–3 years
 



**Employment type:** 
 Full\-time
 



  





**About the role** 




 Payments fail in ways ordinary software doesn't. A single mis\-set bit in an ISO 8583 bitmap, a response code that maps to the wrong outcome, a settlement file that doesn't reconcile — and real money is stuck.
 



 We're hiring a
 **Junior Payment Dev/Test Engineer** 
 to help build the validation that catches those failures before they reach production. You'll work alongside Payments SMEs, developers and product teams on payment flows, payment switches, and the automation frameworks that validate them.
 



 This is not a traditional QA execution role. You'll build across
 **payment domain \+ development \+ automation \+ validation \+ integration \+ performance** 
 — and grow into genuine payments engineering expertise.
 



  





**What you'll do** 




**Learn the payments domain properly** 



* End\-to\-end card transaction processing: authorisation, clearing and settlement
* Issuing and acquiring flows
* POS, ATM, EFTPOS, payment gateway and payment switch architecture
* Work directly with senior Payments SMEs on complex real\-world scenarios



**Work with payment messages** 



* Build working knowledge of ISO 8583 — MTI, bitmaps and data elements
* Create, modify and validate request/response messages
* Perform field\-level validation, message comparison, and mapping/transformation checks
* Validate response codes and transaction outcomes
* Develop a foundation in ISO 20022 message families and flows



**Build and validate APIs** 



* Design and execute REST API validation scenarios
* Validate JSON and XML payloads, HTTP status codes and business responses
* Positive and negative path coverage
* Postman collections, automated with Newman or equivalent
* Build reusable API validation utilities



**Automate** 



* Develop and maintain Playwright automation
* Execute automated regression suites
* Contribute to CI/CD\-based automated validation



**Investigate failures** 



* Analyse failed transactions and pinpoint the exact point of failure
* Work through application logs and transaction traces
* Reproduce, document and retest defects with clear evidence
* Partner with developers through to resolution



**Document what you learn** 



* Validation scenarios, conditions and expected results
* Execution reports and investigation findings
* Transaction flow diagrams and reusable payment knowledge assets



  





**What we're looking for** 




**Must have** 



* 1–3 years in software development, QA automation or payment technology
* Hands\-on dev/test exposure to payments — ISO 8583, ISO 20022, payment switches
* Playwright
* Working knowledge of Python
* Basic SQL and Git
* Solid grounding in the SDLC and software testing principles
* Strong debugging and analytical instincts



**Nice to have** 



* Card issuing, merchant acquiring, EMV, payment gateways
* JMeter, Newman
* Jenkins, GitHub Actions or GitLab CI
* Maven, Docker
* Rest API validations



**You'll do well here if you** 



* Investigate problems logically rather than guessing
* Have real attention to detail — in payments, the detail
 *is* 
 the job
* Can read a technical specification and work from it
* Take ownership of what you build
* Genuinely want to learn how money moves



**Education:** 
 Bachelor’s degree in computer science, IT, Engineering or a related discipline. Candidates with relevant development, automation or payments experience preferred.
 



**What the first two months look like** 




 By the end of your first 1–2 months, you should be able to:
 


* Walk through an end\-to\-end card payment transaction
* Read and interpret ISO 8583 messages
* Create and execute payment validation scenarios
* Write Playwright automation scripts and run automated regression suites
* Analyse a failed transaction from logs and traces to root cause
* Write defect reports someone else can act on
* Run basic performance tests
* Independently own a small payment validation module

title: Deputy Chief Financial Officer, Trilogy (Remote) - $1,600,000/year USD
description:
Most finance executives inherit a system. You will redesign one, then decide where the capital goes.
   

  

 Trilogy is looking for the executive who can turn a portfolio of businesses into a capital allocation system: continuously ranking where the next dollar should go, backing those decisions with rigorous models, and moving capital toward its highest\-return uses. You will own the calls that matter: fund or kill a business line; invest or hold; acquire or walk away; refinance or pay down debt. Every recommendation must connect strategy to cash, liquidity, covenants, risk, and enterprise value.
   

  

 Just as important, you will architect an AI\-native finance function built to scale without decision bottlenecks. This does not mean sprinkling AI tools onto a traditional finance organization. You will redesign reporting, planning, controls, portfolio monitoring, and decision support around what AI and automation can now do. You won't need to personally build every workflow, but you must use AI deeply enough to know its edges: where it accelerates analysis, where it fails, and where expert judgment must take over. The result should be a smaller, more senior, higher\-leverage finance organization rather than a growing pyramid of people and processes.
   

  

 You will operate directly with Trilogy's CEO, board, lenders, and capital partners, with personal accountability for the financial truth behind major decisions. As Deputy CFO, this is a $1\.6M/year W\-2 salaried role for someone who has already earned credibility at serious financial scale and now wants the mandate to compound enterprise value across an entire portfolio. If you want your impact measured by the quality of your capital decisions and the financial system you leave behind, apply.
   

  

**What You Will Be Doing**
* Allocating capital across the portfolio: Run capital and portfolio reviews, rank competing uses of capital on risk\-adjusted return, and make clear fund, hold, restructure, exit, debt\-paydown, or acquisition recommendations.
* Architecting an AI\-native finance system: Redesign planning, reporting, consolidation, controls, portfolio monitoring, and financial workflows around AI, automation, and scalable systems rather than additional headcount.
* Driving investments and transactions: Build and defend the financial case for strategic investments, M\&A, financing, and refinancing, including integrated models, downside scenarios, capital structure, covenant implications, and execution plans.
* Owning board and capital\-partner communication: Give the CEO, board, lenders, and capital partners fast, quantified, defensible truth, with recommendations that make the decision and trade\-offs explicit.
* Building a high\-leverage finance leadership team: Set the bar for a small group of exceptional finance leaders while creating systems that allow new ventures and greater complexity to be absorbed without linear organizational growth.


**What You Won’t Be Doing**
* Running finance as a reporting factory. Closing the books and producing audit workpapers are the Controller's responsibilities. Your job is to turn financial information into better capital decisions.
* Building a large finance organization to handle complexity. Scale should come from better systems, AI leverage, automation, and exceptional people, not layers of management.
* Adding AI as a superficial productivity tool. You will architect workflows around its real capabilities and limitations, which requires substantial firsthand use.
* Producing strategy decks without financial consequences. Major recommendations must carry the integrated model, downside case, capital implications, and execution guardrails behind them.
* Managing the board through narrative. The numbers, assumptions, risks, and recommended action should be clear enough to withstand scrutiny.


**Deputy Chief Financial Officer Key Responsibilities**
 Build a durable, AI\-native finance function that compounds enterprise value across Trilogy's portfolio by allocating capital to its highest\-return uses and creating financial systems and controls that scale without decision bottlenecks.
   

  

**Basic Requirements**
* Experience as the most senior finance decision\-maker, or their direct deputy, for a business or portfolio with $100M\+ in annual revenue across multiple legal entities.
* Personal ownership of major capital\-allocation decisions, including the ability to explain what was funded, reduced, or rejected; the dollars involved; the trade\-offs; and your recommendation.
* Decision ownership on at least one $25M\+ closed M\&A, financing, or refinancing transaction, with direct responsibility for negotiation, financing selection, board recommendation, or post\-close integration.
* Direct experience presenting to and taking live questions from a board of directors.
* Ownership of an external audit relationship under US GAAP or IFRS, directly or through a Controller reporting to you.
* Hands\-on experience with a true enterprise ERP such as SAP, NetSuite, Oracle, Workday, or equivalent.
* Recent experience re\-architecting a finance workflow around AI, with enough regular personal AI use to understand where the technology is reliable, where it is not, and how those boundaries should shape finance\-system design.
* Ability to operate integrated 3\-statement models and defend assumptions, downside scenarios, covenant math, capital structure, and recommendations under live questioning.
* Strong written and verbal English, with experience communicating directly with CEOs, boards, lenders, or capital partners.
* Located within the UTC−8 to UTC\+3 time\-zone range.


**Nice\-to\-have Requirements**
* CPA, ACA, ACCA, CIMA, CFA, MBA, or comparable finance credential.
* Earlier career experience in private equity, investment banking, M\&A, corporate finance, or another environment requiring rigorous modeling and high\-stakes capital decisions.
* Experience rebuilding a finance function rather than simply inheriting and operating one.
* Experience across a portfolio, multi\-entity, or PE\-backed operating environment.


**About Trilogy**
 Hundreds of software businesses run on the Trilogy Business Platform. For three decades, Trilogy has been known for 3 things: Relentlessly seeking top talent, innovating new technology, and incubating new businesses.
   

  

 Our technological innovation is spearheaded by a passion for simple customer\-facing designs. Our incubation of new businesses ranges from entirely new moon\-shot ideas to rearchitecting existing projects for today's modern cloud\-based stack.
   

  

 Trilogy is a place where you can be surrounded with great people, be proud of doing great work, and grow your career in leaps and bounds.
   

  

 There is so much to cover for this exciting role, and space here is limited. Hit the Apply button if you found this interesting and want to learn more. We look forward to meeting you!
   

  

**Working with us**
 This is a full\-time (40 hours per week), long\-term position. The position is immediately available and requires entering into an independent contractor agreement with Crossover as a Contractor of Record. The compensation level for this role is $800 USD/hour, which equates to $1,600,000 USD/year assuming 40 hours per week and 50 weeks per year. The payment period is weekly. Consult www.crossover.com/help\-and\-faqs for more details on this topic.

You will have the opportunity to work with our global internal and external partners to drive future improvements in the performance of our technology infrastructure platforms, ensuring that we are increasing the reliability and optimizing its capacity.  Core Role Competencies
   

  

 Technical Knowledge: Has a recognizable area of technical competence. Familiar with appropriate standards. Applies subject domain knowledge to meet organizational need/guide actions. Keeps up with current and possible future technological developments in the field.
   

  

 Processes/ Procedures: Ensures processes and procedures are in place for self and others to use. Seeks ways to improve existing processes, making adjustments or recommending reengineering improvements.

Evaluates controls to help mitigate negative outcomes through prevention, detection and correction. Identifies the risks of negative outcomes, including inadvertent error or fraud. Ensures ongoing compliance with regulatory requirements.
   

  

 Stakeholder Management: Identifies key partners and their influence, implements techniques for communicating/engaging and managing expectations. Has frequent interactions. Finds the appropriate balance of completing claims by various groups of stakeholders, acting fairly and in consideration of cultural and ethical factors.
   

  

 Client Centricity: Uses insights from customer relationships to anticipate their needs and provide services beyond their expectations. Actively seeks information to understand client issues, expectations, and needs.

When making decisions, uses a mix of analysis, wisdom, experience and discernment. Assesses business needs, anticipates problems. Works independently and is self\-directed.

description:
**Company Description**
**About Ramboll**
 Ramboll is a global leader in sustainable architecture, engineering, and consultancy. At Ramboll Tech, we drive digital transformation across Ramboll, setting the pace for how technology transforms the built environment. Our mission is to become the leading tech\-enabled partner for sustainable change.
   

  

 If you are passionate about shaping high\-impact digital products and want to connect product strategy with engineering execution, cloud platforms, data, integration and AI\-enabled capabilities, this is your opportunity.
   

  

**Ramboll globally**
 Ramboll is a leading engineering, architecture and consultancy company. Working at one of our offices in 35 countries you will join 16,000 fellow bright minds in creating innovative and sustainable solutions within Buildings, Transport, Energy, Environment \& Health, Architecture, Landscape \& Urbanism, Water and Management Consulting. Combining local experience with global knowledge, we help shape the society of tomorrow.
   

  

**Inviting bright minds**
 Do you want to push the boundaries of your profession and develop your excellence in an open, collaborative, and empowering culture? We work to create a sustainable future and our inspiring projects and innovative solutions aim to set the standard among our peers. You will join a global company that has been growing successfully since its founding in 1945\. Together, we lead and leave a positive impact on societies, companies, and people around the world.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Application Security Specialist India**
 Are you motivated by turning complex security and compliance risks into clear, decision‑ready insights? Do you want to work at the intersection of information security, data compliance and governance in a global organisation? Are you looking to make a tangible impact on how a leading consultancy manages cyber and data‑related risks?
   

  

 If this sounds like you, or you’re curious to learn more, then this role could be the perfect opportunity. Join our Information Security and Data Compliance department
   

  

**Your new role**
 The Application Security Specialist operates at the intersection of
 **Information Security and Assurance (ISA) and DevSecOps, ensuring that application security is embedded, measurable, and compliant** 
 across Ramboll’s global digital landscape and application development.
   

  

 This role focuses on integrating security into engineering workflows while aligning with enterprise security frameworks such as ISO 12207 /ISO/IEC 27001 / CIS 18 and industry best practices like OWASP.
   

  

 The Application Security specialist is responsible for identifying, analyzing, and mitigating security vulnerabilities in applications throughout the software development lifecycle (SDLC). This role works closely with development, DevOps, and security teams to ensure secure coding practices and compliance with organizational and industry standards. You will work closely with RAMTECH, data compliance, regulatory and business teams.
   

  

 Your key responsibilities will be:
   

  

**Alignment \& Assurance**
* Translate security policies into actionable technical controls for development teams
* Ensure alignment with:


 ISO/IEC 27001
   

  

 CIS Critical Security Controls
   

  

 OWASP Top 10
   

  

  

* Support internal/external audits by providing application security evidence andmetrics
* Contribute to risk registers, control effectiveness reviews, and exception handling


**DevSecOps Enablement**
* Embed application security controls into CI/CD pipelines across business units
* Drive adoption of security\-by\-design and shift\-left security practices
* Integrate and manage tools for:


 oSAST, DAST, SCA, Secrets Scanning
   

  

  

* Partner with DevOps teams to standardize secure pipelines globally


 Confidential.
   

  

**Application Risk Management**
* Perform risk\-based vulnerability assessments and prioritize remediation
* Align risk ratings aligned with Cyber and Information security risk methodology
* Track remediation SLAs and report on risk posture to CISO office.
* Conduct threat modeling for critical applications and digital solutions


**Security Testing \& Validation**
* Oversee and/or perform:
* Secure code reviews
* Penetration testing (manual \& automated)
* Validate vulnerability fixes and ensure closure meets compliance requirements
* Establish baseline security requirements for all applications


**Developer Security Advisory**
* Act as a security champion enabler across distributed engineering teams
* Provide secure coding guidance and conduct targeted training sessions
* Develop reusable secure design patterns and reference architectures.


**Metrics, Reporting \& Continuous Improvement**
* Define and track KPIs such as:
* Vulnerability density
* Mean Time to Remediate (MTTR)
* % of applications onboarded to DevSecOps pipelines
* Build dashboards for leadership visibility and regulatory reporting
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives across global teams


**Qualifications**
**Required Skills \& Qualifications**
**Technical Skills**
* Strong understanding of:
* Web technologies (HTTP, REST APIs, microservices)
* Authentication and authorization mechanisms (OAuth, JWT, SSO)
* Knowledge of common vulnerabilities (e.g., SQL Injection, XSS, CSRF)
* Experience with security tools such as:
* SAST: Checkmarx, Fortify
* DAST: Burp Suite, Acunetix
* SCA: Snyk, Black Duck
* Familiarity with programming languages (Java, Python, JavaScript, .NET)


**Security Knowledge**
* Hands\-on experience with OWASP Top 10 risks
* Understanding of threat modeling methodologies
* Experience in bridging policy\-to\-technical implementation gaps
* Knowledge of cloud security (AWS, Azure, GCP) is a plus


**About You**
* 5\+ years in Application Security, Cyber Security, or Software Development
* Experience working in Agile/DevOps environments
* Prior experience in secure coding or vulnerability management preferred
* Certifications (Preferred)
* Certified Secure Software Lifecycle Professional (CSSLP)
* Offensive Security Certified Professional (OSCP)
* Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP)
* GIAC Web Application Penetration Tester (GWAPT)


**Nice to Have**
* Experience with bug bounty programs
* Knowledge of container security (Docker, Kubernetes)
* Experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) security tools


**Additional Information**
**What we can offer you**
* Flexible work environment with the possibility of working from home.
* Commitment to your professional and personal development.
* Leaders guided by Ramboll’s Leadership Principles.
* A culture that welcomes you as the unique person you are.
* The long‑term thinking of a foundation‑owned company.


**Ready to join us?**
 Please submit your application and CV online. We invite diversity in all its forms and encourage applicants from all groups to apply.

description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**EY\-Cyber Security\-IAM\- SailPoint IIQ Senior**
 At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
   

  

 We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
   

  

 Join EY and help to build a better working world.
   

  

**About Global Delivery Services**
 Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
   

  

 Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000\+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
   

  

 Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy \& Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high\-quality, value\-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
   

  

 Enablement Services provides cost\-effective, high\-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
   

  

 Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 We’re looking for consultants in the cyber security team to work on various Identity and Access Management projects for our customers across the globe. Also, the professional shall need to report any identified risks within engagements and share any issues and updates with the leadership/management on a timely basis
   

  

 In line with EY’s commitment to quality, you’ll confirm that work is of the highest quality as per EY’s quality standards and is reviewed by the next\-level reviewer. As an influential member of the team, you’ll help to create a positive learning culture, coach and counsel junior team members and help them to develop.
   

  

 As a member of the Identity and Access Management (IAM) team this position will contribute towards execution of an IAM roadmap that meets security requirements, implementation and adoption of secrets management, management of machine identities and definition of access policies that meet their needs and are in line with overall IAM Program.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* 3\-7 years of experience in designing and deploying IIQ\-based Identity Governance and Administration solutions
* Ability to drive IGA projects including project management, team management, client management.
* Should have experience in implementing at least one complete IAM SDLC engagements projects. This must include activities such as requirements gathering, analysis, design, development, testing, deployment and application support
* Must have experience in SailPoint IIQ \& IDN architecture, design, development, configuration, testing, integration, and deployment.
* Must have experience in source/ Identity profile configuration, transform/rule development, workflow configuration, JML process and certification, Password sync.
* Must have experience in onboarding AD, JDBC and web service applications to IIQ/IDN
* Must have experience in deployment of virtual appliance, understanding different VA architecture, deploy rules in cloud/VA, High availability/DR configuration
* Configuration and deployment of IQService in cloud and on\-prem environments
* Must have hands on experience in configuring quick link, custom work flow, reports, developing service account management modules, integration with other tools like Service Now, CyberArk etc and plugin development
* IIQ Installation, set up and initial configuration/ upgradation to different versions of IIQ, Standard service build set up and configuration
* Professional IT certifications are a plus.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.


**What We Offer You**
 At EY, we’ll develop you with future\-focused skills and equip you with world\-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
   

  

 Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
   

  

 To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability\-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
   

  

**Our Commitment:** 
 As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
   

  

**Professional Development:** 
 From entry\-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
   

  

**People and Culture:** 
 In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
   

  

**Benefits** 
 : Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting\-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
   

  

**How to Apply:** 
 If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user\-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.
   

  

 Successful candidates advance to a competency\-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.
   

  

 “We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity \& Inclusion”.
   

  

**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

 for the Customer Support technology ecosystem. The architect will partner closely with Customer Support Operations, Customer Experience (CX), Product, Engineering, and IT teams to design scalable, secure, and high\-performing solutions across
 **Freshdesk** 
 , customer support platforms, and enterprise integrations.

 **Freshdesk, Zendesk, Salesforce Service Cloud, ServiceNow Customer Service Management (CSM), or similar enterprise service management solutions** 
 , along with strong expertise in integrations, automation, AI, and enterprise architecture.
   

  





 As a

* Own the architecture and technical roadmap for Customer Support applications and related integrations.
* Design scalable solutions across

* Design and govern integrations using REST APIs, webhooks, middleware, and event\-driven architectures.

* Partner with business stakeholders to identify opportunities for automation and continuous improvement.
* Mentor administrators, business systems analysts, and engineers on architecture standards and best practices.

* Customer Support application architecture and technology roadmap.
* Case management and workflow architecture.
* Omnichannel support design including email, chat, messaging, and voice.
* Integration architecture and middleware strategy.
* Automation and AI strategy.
* Platform governance and security.
* Build vs. configure vs. integrate decisions.
* Long\-term scalability and platform modernization.



**Technical Skills**



* Strong experience architecting enterprise Customer Support platforms such as
 **Freshdesk, Zendesk, Salesforce Service Cloud, ServiceNow CSM** 
 , or similar solutions.
* Deep understanding of customer support operations including case management, ticketing, SLAs, routing, queues, knowledge management, and omnichannel support.
* Experience with REST APIs, middleware platforms, webhooks, and enterprise integrations.
* Experience implementing workflow automation using platform\-native capabilities and low\-code/no\-code tools.
* Knowledge of CRM integrations and customer lifecycle processes.
* Experience with AI\-powered customer service capabilities and Generative AI technologies.
* Strong understanding of enterprise application architecture, security, data modelling, and governance.
* Ability to troubleshoot complex application and integration issues across multiple platforms.



**Leadership Skills**



* Ability to influence architecture decisions across business and technology teams.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Proven experience leading enterprise platform implementations and transformation initiatives.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.



 Ability to mentor technical teams and establish architecture standard
   

  

  

  




**Qualifications**
* 7 \- 12 years of IT experience with
 **5\+ years supporting or architecting enterprise Customer Support platforms** 
 .
* Proven experience designing and implementing enterprise customer support solutions.
* Hands\-on experience with
 **Freshdesk** 
 is highly preferred.
* Experience with
 **Zendesk, Salesforce Service Cloud, ServiceNow CSM, or similar platforms** 
 is strongly preferred.
* Experience with enterprise integrations, APIs, middleware, and workflow automation.
* Experience implementing AI\-enabled customer support capabilities is a plus.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Information Systems, or a related field.



**Preferred Experience**



* Experience supporting global Customer Support or Customer Experience organizations.
* Experience leading Freshdesk implementations, migrations, or platform modernization initiatives.
* Familiarity with ITIL practices and Service Operations.
* Experience with integration platforms such as Workato, MuleSoft, Boomi, or similar technologies.
* Experience evaluating and implementing AI solutions that improve customer support operations and agent productivity.

* Drive continuous improvement initiatives by identifying opportunities for innovation and operational efficiency.

* Strong programming skills in Python, including experience with scripting, automation, and application development.
* In\-depth knowledge of cloud computing concepts and hands\-on experience with Amazon Web Services infrastructure and services.

title: Engineer, Product Applications
description:
**Company Overview**
 KLA is a global leader in diversified electronics for the semiconductor manufacturing ecosystem. Virtually every electronic device in the world is produced using our technologies. No laptop, smartphone, wearable device, voice\-controlled gadget, flexible screen, VR device or smart car would have made it into your hands without us. KLA invents systems and solutions for the manufacturing of wafers and reticles, integrated circuits, packaging, printed circuit boards and flat panel displays. The innovative ideas and devices that are advancing humanity all begin with inspiration, research and development. KLA focuses more than average on innovation and we invest 15% of sales back into R\&D. Our expert teams of physicists, engineers, data scientists and problem\-solvers work together with the world’s leading technology providers to accelerate the delivery of tomorrow’s electronic devices. Life here is exciting and our teams thrive on tackling really hard problems. There is never a dull moment with us.
   

  

**Group/Division**
 With over 40 years of semiconductor process control experience, chipmakers around the globe rely on KLA to ensure that their fabs ramp next\-generation devices to volume production quickly and cost\-effectively. Enabling the movement towards advanced chip design, KLA's Global Products Group (GPG), which is responsible for creating all of KLA’s metrology and inspection products, is looking for the best and the brightest research scientist, software engineers, application development engineers, and senior product technology process engineers. The Broadband Plasma Division (BBP) provides market\-leading patterned wafer optical inspection systems for leading\-edge IC manufacturing. Logic, foundry, and memory customers depend on BBP products to detect yield\-critical defects for process debug and excursion monitoring at advanced process nodes. BBP flagship products include the 29xx and 39xx series which leverage Broadband Plasma technology to capture a wide range of defects with ultimate sensitivity at the optical inspection speeds needed for inline defect monitoring.
   

  

**Job Description/Preferred Qualifications**
**Application Development Engineer**
**Responsibilities:**
* Customer support: Product value demonstration during beta testing, Head\-to\-Heads (H2H) and tools in the ramp phase, thereby enabling product penetration/adoption at world\-wide customers. This includes\-investigating semiconductor manufacturing yield issues and providing inspection solutions; creating \& sharing product value statements and use\-cases with engineering, marketing and sales groups; training customers and other applications engineers.
* Product Demonstration: Provide specific product demonstrations on all aspects of highly complex products to customers and assess potential applications to meet customer needs
* Product Characterization: Work on test plan development and execute detailed characterization of the tool/algorithm performance and provides clear feedback to the Engineering teams for product improvement, especially during Alpha/Beta tests.
* Problem Diagnosis/Troubleshooting: Respond to customer requests and perform routine to moderately complex problem diagnosis and problem resolution.
* Customer Relationship: Interacts with customers to educate and coordinate activities. Good working knowledge of customer use case and is expected to understand customer needs and improve customer relations.
* Training: Conduct customer product demonstrations and technical training including on\-site training of Field Applications Engineers and end users.
* Documentation: Document all test results and lessons learned in BKMs (Best Known Methods), training documents, Demo reports, or, Alpha/Beta test reports and transfer product knowledge to Field Applications teams.
* Presentation/Communication Skills: Generate demo and test reports and strong presentation skills for internal and customer review.


**Requirements:**
* We are looking for high energy, self\-driven and motivated engineers who are interested in working in High Tech. The semiconductor space is a fast paced, high stress environment that gives applications engineers a lot of autonomy to work and drive projects on their own. Ideal candidates appreciate the opportunity to have high levels of accountability, working well with limited supervision and thrive in a work environment where they can drive projects on their own.
* Candidate must have Master’s or bachelor's degree in Engineering, Physics, Material Science, or related fields.
* Must have excellent oral and written communication, organizational, analytical, and interpersonal skills.
* Candidate must be a strong team player.
* \>50% travel will be required


**Minimum Qualifications**
 Master's Level Degree or work experience of 0 years , Bachelor's Level Degree or work experience of 1 years

 We have an amazing opportunity for a IAM lead architect, IT Security available within our Global Business Services division. This position has been created due to growth. IAM lead Architect, IT Security will be Accountable and Responsible for defining the identity fabric — the standards, reference architectures, and integration patterns and working closely with project teams as well as internal / external groups to protect and enhance the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of Wolters Kluwer assets.
   

  

 This position location is Pune or Chennai, India .
   

  

 As IAM lead Architect, IT Security, you will be accountable for defining IAM architectures, standards, road maps for all our IAM programs to secure access to personal and confidential information at Wolters Kluwer. In this role, you will be required to demonstrate proficiency in identity and access concepts as they pertain to every area of security management. Your role will also include interfacing with all other areas of the security organization and responding to 3rd party audits and internal audits, and interfacing with internal business unit IT representatives on global information security initiatives and compliance tasks and projects.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities:
   

  

* Define and own the enterprise identity architecture strategy, reference architectures, and engineering standards aligned to business and regulatory requirements across US and EU jurisdictions.
* Produce and maintain the IAM RACI — resolving ownership boundaries between Access Management, IGA, Privileged IAM, Access Management, and NHI pillars.
* Establish and govern the IAM Architecture Review Board (ARB), ensuring architectural sign\-off on all material identity, access, and authentication changes.
* Own the identity fabric design — the authoritative directory model, hybrid sync strategy, group and role taxonomy, and attribute schema across AD and Entra ID.
* Define integration standards for all IAM tool\-to\-tool connections: SailPoint to AD, CyberArk to Entra PIM, CIEM to SIEM, and emerging NHI tooling.


 Zero Trust and Cloud IAM Architecture
   

  

* Architect and enforce Zero Trust identity controls across hybrid and multi\-cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP), including least\-privilege, just\-in\-time access, and continuous access evaluation.
* Define cloud IAM governance standards: Entra ID tenant architecture, AWS IAM permission boundaries, Azure RBAC design, and GCP IAM policy structure.
* Drive the architectural strategy for CIEM integration — ensuring cloud entitlement visibility, toxic combination detection, and least\-privilege remediation at scale.
* Own the identity component of the organization’s Zero Trust roadmap, including micro\-segmentation, device trust, and identity\-aware network policy.


 NHI and AI Identity Architecture
   

  

* Define the Non\-Human Identity (NHI) governance architecture — covering service accounts, managed identities, service principals, pipeline identities, and AI agent identities.
* Design the secrets management architecture integrating CyberArk Secrets Manager, Azure Key Vault, and CI/CD OIDC federation for keyless pipeline authentication.
* Architect the AI agent identity model — defining how AI agents authenticate, what permissions they hold, how their actions are audited, and how their lifecycle is governed.
* Produce architectural guidance for MCP server identity controls and LLM API key governance for emerging AI tooling (Claude Code, Copilot, custom agents).


 Regulatory and Compliance Architecture
   

  

* Ensure identity architecture satisfies GDPR, NIS2, DORA, SOC 2 Type II, and ISO 27001 requirements across all operating regions.
* Translate evolving regulatory requirements (EU AI Act, Cyber Resilience Act, SEC cybersecurity rules) into actionable identity architecture changes.
* Partner with Legal, Privacy, and Data Protection Officers to embed Privacy\-by\-Design and data minimization at the identity architecture layer.
* Maintain the IAM architecture risk register — classifying, prioritizing, and driving remediation of architectural debt and control gaps.


 Cross\-Pillar Governance
   

  

* Serve as the primary architectural authority for the IAM program — covering Access Management and Controls and Audit operationally where dedicated leads are not yet in place.
* Chair the IAM Architecture Guild, fostering a community of practice across distributed identity engineers in US and EU time zones.
* Present identity architecture posture and program progress to the IAM Owner, CISO, and executive leadership.
* Evaluate and govern the IAM toolchain — rationalizing tool overlap, driving consolidation decisions, and managing vendor relationships for identity platforms.


 Our Interview Practices
   

  

*To maintain a fair and genuine hiring process, we kindly ask that all candidates participate in interviews without the assistance of AI tools or external prompts. Our interview process is designed to assess your individual skills, experiences, and communication style. We value authenticity and want to ensure we’re getting to know you—not a digital assistant. To help maintain this integrity, we ask to remove virtual backgrounds and include in\-person interviews in our hiring process. Please note that use of AI\-generated responses or third\-party support during interviews will be grounds for disqualification from the recruitment process.*
*Applicants may be required to appear onsite at a Wolters Kluwer office as part of the recruitment process.*

title: Algorithm Manager
description:
**Company Overview**
 KLA is a global leader in diversified electronics for the semiconductor manufacturing ecosystem. Virtually every electronic device in the world is produced using our technologies. No laptop, smartphone, wearable device, voice\-controlled gadget, flexible screen, VR device or smart car would have made it into your hands without us. KLA invents systems and solutions for the manufacturing of wafers and reticles, integrated circuits, packaging, printed circuit boards and flat panel displays. The innovative ideas and devices that are advancing humanity all begin with inspiration, research and development. KLA focuses more than average on innovation and we invest 15% of sales back into R\&D. Our expert teams of physicists, engineers, data scientists and problem\-solvers work together with the world’s leading technology providers to accelerate the delivery of tomorrow’s electronic devices. Life here is exciting and our teams thrive on tackling really hard problems. There is never a dull moment with us.
   

  

**Group/Division**
 With over 40 years of semiconductor process control experience, chipmakers around the globe rely on KLA to ensure that their fabs ramp next\-generation devices to volume production quickly and cost\-effectively. Enabling the movement towards advanced chip design, KLA's Global Products Group (GPG), which is responsible for creating all of KLA’s metrology and inspection products, is looking for the best and the brightest research scientist, software engineers, application development engineers, and senior product technology process engineers. The LS\-SWIFT Division of KLA’s Global Products Group provides patterned wafer inspection systems for high\-volume semiconductor manufacturing. Its mission is to deliver market\-leading cost of ownership in defect detection for a broad range of applications in the production of semiconductors. Customers from the foundry, logic, memory, automotive, MEMS, advanced packaging and other markets rely upon high\-sample wafer inspection information generated by LS\-SWIFT products. LS (Laser Scanning) systems enable cost\-effective patterned wafer defect detection for the industry’s most sophisticated process technologies deployed in leading\-edge foundry, logic, DRAM, and NAND fabs. SWIFT (Simultaneous Wafer Inspection at Fast Throughput) systems deliver all\-wafer\-surface (frontside, backside, and edge) macro inspection that is critical for automotive IC, MEMS, and advanced packaging processes as well as foundry/logic and memory fabs. LS\-SWIFT operates from a global footprint that includes the US, Singapore, India and Germany, and serves a worldwide customer base across Asia, Europe and North America.
   

  

**Job Description/Preferred Qualifications**
 Responsibilities:
   

  

* Provide technical leadership in algorithm design and development for wafer inspection products.
* Collaborate with system, product, and domain experts to define algorithm performance requirements and deliver customer‑driven solutions.
* Mentor and motivate engineers to solve complex technical and investigative problems.
* Represent the algorithms team during system‑level hardware and software integration.
* Develop, validate, and deploy image processing, computer vision, and machine learning algorithms.
* Support software quality and reliability activities as part of the development lifecycle.


 Qualifications:
   

  

* Strong background in image processing and computer vision; working knowledge of machine learning and deep learning.
* Proficient in C/C\+\+ and MATLAB; experience on Unix/Linux platforms.
* Hands‑on experience with object‑oriented and/or functional programming.
* Python and ML frameworks (e.g., TensorFlow) experience is a plus.
* Strong problem‑solving skills with the ability to work effectively in a fast‑paced environment.
* Good communication and collaboration skills with emerging technical leadership capability.


**Minimum Qualifications**
 PhD in CS/EE/Math/Physics with 3\+ years of experience, or MTech/MS/BTech/BS in CS/EE with 6\+ years of experience.

 Be aware of potentially fraudulent job postings or suspicious recruiting activity by persons that are currently posing as KLA employees.
