title: Lead Engineer
description:
**Who We Are**
 Arcadia is the AI\-powered energy intelligence platform for businesses. We replace fragmented tools and manual workflows with one platform to pay utility bills, buy energy, and advance sustainability — across every location, at enterprise scale.
   

  

 Trusted by Fortune 2000 companies, Arcadia combines unified data, AI\-powered analytics, and expert advisory to help enterprise teams save money, mitigate risk, and
 ****cut carbon****
 .
   

  

**We Deliver This Through Three Comprehensive Solutions**
* Utility Bill Management: Automating the entire utility bill lifecycle — from data capture and validation to payment processing and auditing.
* Energy Procurement Advisory: Bringing together comprehensive data, AI\-powered analytics, market expertise, and a strong partner network to make sophisticated procurement options accessible to all.
* Sustainability Reporting — Verified emissions data with seamless integration into leading sustainability platforms.


 Tackling the world's most complex energy challenges requires diverse thinking. We're building teams of people from different backgrounds, industries, and disciplines — united by a belief that energy management should be simple, intelligent, and a genuine driver of business value.
   

  

**Benefits**
* Competitive compensation based on market standards
* We are working on a hybrid model with remote first policy
* Apart from Fixed Base Salary potential candidates are eligible for following benefits
* 
+ Flexible Leave Policy
+ Office located in the heart of the city in case you need to step in for any purpose

* We provide comprehensive coverage including accident policy and life insurance.
* Medical Insurance (1\+5 Family Members)
* Flexible Benefit Plan
* Awards and Bonus
* Annual performance cycle
* Quarterly engagement activities
* A supportive engineering culture that values diversity, empathy, teamwork, trust, and efficiency


**What We're Looking For**
 We are seeking a Lead Engineer to be the technical anchor of our Growth \& Governance (GnG) squad in India — the team that acquires utility data from thousands of unreliable third\-party sources, extracts and audits it, and turns it into the trusted dataset the rest of the Arcadia platform is built on. Formats change without notice, sources fail silently, and correctness is visible to customers, so our core expertise is building systems that stay accurate against data that refuses to cooperate.
   

  

 This is a hands\-on role with real ownership. You will own architecture for one or more of our services, lead projects end to end, act as a second point of technical review alongside the Engineering Manager, and mentor a team of earlier\-career engineers.
   

  

 AI has moved where the hard part of engineering sits. Producing code is no longer the bottleneck; deciding whether the produced code is the
 **right**
 answer is. We are looking for someone already well ahead on AI\-driven development who also has the architectural judgment to reject its confident wrong answers — and to teach a team of earlier\-career engineers to do the same rather than defer to the model.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Own the architecture and technical direction of one or more services in our acquisition, extraction, and audit pipeline, and lead medium\-to\-large projects on them end to end
* Translate ambiguous problems into engineering\-ready designs, and decompose large efforts into pieces the team can build in parallel
* Act as a primary design and code reviewer — the second layer of judgment on AI\-assisted designs and pull requests, catching architectural drift and silent correctness defects early
* Set the bar for AI\-driven development on the squad — and bring your own view of what that should look like
* Own a category of reliability and technical\-debt work end to end, without derailing roadmap commitments
* Share in the squad's production support rotation for the services you own, and improve what pages us
* Mentor earlier\-career engineers: raise their design instincts, review quality, and independence
* Partner with Product, Operations, our Data Analytics Engineering team, and US\-based engineering counterparts to shape requirements and drive cross\-team initiatives


**What Will Help You Succeed**
****Must\-Haves****
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
* 8\+ years of software development experience at a SaaS or technology company, the majority building and operating backend or distributed systems in production
* A clear track record of owning projects end to end — from design through production — not just delivering assigned components
* Currently hands\-on. You have shipped production code within the last two years
* Experience with enterprise Java (Spring / Spring Boot preferred) and Python
* SQL and relational data modelling at depth — you have designed schemas that survived real growth, and debugged correctness problems in the data rather than only in the code
* Experience building and operating high\-volume data pipelines and third\-party integrations, where correctness matters as much as throughput
* Experience with event\-driven and asynchronous systems (streaming or queueing — Kinesis, Kafka, SQS or similar), including what goes wrong under retries and at\-least\-once delivery
* Deployed and operated systems on AWS or similar, on containerised platforms (Kubernetes / ECS)
* Production operability. You have owned services you were paged for — metrics and dashboards (Prometheus / Grafana, CloudWatch, Datadog or similar), structured logging, tracing, and alerts that fire on customer\-visible symptoms rather than on every anomaly
* Strong AI\-driven development practice. You work daily in agentic coding tools and are fluent at managing context and steering them across a large, unfamiliar codebase. AI is central to how this squad works, so you should already be ahead on it — with your own view of what good looks like and the judgment to know when the output isn't
* Architectural judgment. You can articulate the tradeoffs behind a design, choose the simpler option when it holds, and explain why you rejected the alternatives — including when the alternative came from a tool or from a more senior voice in the room
* Technical rigor. Testing strategy across the pyramid, observability and alerting built in rather than bolted on, security and maintainability treated as requirements
* Demonstrated mentorship. You've been the person a team goes to, and you've levelled others up
* Clear written and verbal communication. You write designs people can act on, and you work well with a distributed team across time zones
* Flexibility to join evening meetings up to \~8:30 PM IST to collaborate with US\-based counterparts


****Nice\-to\-Haves****
* Experience shipping AI/LLM\-backed features to production — latency, accuracy, cost, evaluation, and human\-in\-the\-loop design
* Experience building SQL data pipelines (Snowflake \+ dbt preferred)
* Experience in the energy industry, or another domain requiring deep knowledge of messy, unreliable source data

description:

**General Summary**
 The WLAN Performance Test Engineer is responsible for validating the throughput, latency, RF performance of Wi\-Fi products and Power efficiency under various real\-world and lab conditions. The role ensures compliance with IEEE 802\.11 standards and identifies performance bottlenecks at PHY/MAC layers.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Performance Validation
* Conduct throughput testing using tools such as iPerf, IxChariot, octoScope, Spirent, or IXIA.
* Validate performance across different Wi\-Fi standards (802\.11ac/ax/be).
* Measure PHY data rate, throughput, Packet loss, Jitter, Latency, retransmission rate
* RF \& OTA (Over\-the\-Air) Testing
* Perform RF validation including RvR, RSSI, SNR,Adjacent channel interference
* Simulate customer field environment and test performance with different devices including iOS, Mac, Android, Windows
* Execute testing inside shield boxes or anechoic chambers.
* Load \& Scalability Testing
* Validate performance under high client density scenarios.
* Simulate concurrent traffic (VoIP, video streaming, web traffic).
* Interference Testing
* Test performance under co\-channel and adjacent channel interference.
* Evaluate performance in 2\.4GHz, 5GHz, and 6GHz bands.
* Automation \& Scripting
* Develop automation scripts using C Sharp, Python.
* Automate log collection, KPI extraction and triaging.
* Debug \& Root Cause Analysis
* Analyze packet captures (Wireshark).
* Interpret logs from AP, STA, and driver layers.
* Work with firmware and PHY teams for issue resolution.
* Establish performance benchmarks and release qualification criteria
* Mentor engineers, review test strategy/design and promote testing best practices
* Support customer escalations with in\-depth performance analysis.


**Required Skills \& Qualification**
* Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree
* 10\-15\+ years of experience in WLAN System or performance validation
* Wireless Protocols: Strong understanding of IEEE 802\.11 standards (a/b/g/n/ac/ax/be), OFDM, MIMO, MU\-MIMO, QoS (WMM)
* Tools: Experience with IXIA / Spirent / Keysight test equipment, iPerf, Wireshark
* Networking: Knowledge of TCP/IP stack and preferred experience in Layer 2/Layer 3 networking.
* Analytical tools: Expertise in log analysis tools (Wireshark, tcpdump) for troubleshooting connectivity and performance issues
* Automation framework development experience


**Minimum Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 4\+ years of Systems Test Engineering or related work experience.


 OR
   

  

 Master's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 3\+ years of Systems Test Engineering or related work experience.

title: GROWTH EXECUTIVE
description:
Growth Executive – Student Engagement \& Memberships
   

  

* Reports to the Success Manager


 We're hiring someone whose whole job is to bring people back.
   

  

 Every fitness company talks about new sign\-ups. Fewer talk about the student who trained hard for four months, then life happened — a project, a move, a bad week — and hasn't logged in since.
   

  

 That student is who this role is for.
   

  

 Why this role exists
   

  

 In 2026, our growth is driven as much by the students already with us as by new sign\-ups. Attendance, re\-activation and renewals are where the next chapter is won.
   

  

 You'll design comeback campaigns for students who've gone quiet, work with our coaches to understand why people drop off, own renewals end to end, and make sure the membership experience — plan changes, payments, the lot — feels seamless.
   

  

 It's a role for someone who can invent a campaign on Monday and cheerfully chase a pending payment on Tuesday. Creative and operationally disciplined. Warm on the phone, sharp in the spreadsheet.
   

  

 You'll work shoulder\-to\-shoulder with our coaching team, because engagement problems are rarely just data problems. They're human ones.
   

  

 What you'll own
   

  

 Engagement \& re\-activation
   

  

* Plan and run engagement campaigns for inactive, low\-attendance and at\-risk students
* Design creative re\-engagement initiatives — comeback programmes, challenges, win\-back offers, milestone moments
* Work closely with coaches to understand why students drop off, and turn that into
* interventions that actually move attendance


 Memberships \& renewals
   

  

* Communicate with current and past students on attendance, renewals and plan options
* Support membership growth through renewals and relevant cross\-sell and up\-sell conversations — consultative, never transactional
* Own renewal payment follow\-ups end to end. This is a critical part of the role


 Data \& reporting
   

  

* Track and analyse engagement, attendance and membership data to support decisions
* Maintain accurate membership and engagement records in our CRM
* Produce regular reports on engagement, renewals and revenue against quarterly targets


 How you'll work
   

  

* Use CRM tools and Google Workspace to track every effort — nothing lives only in your head
* Look for the automation, then keep the human touch on top of it
* Bring a growth mindset and a start\-up mentality


 What we need from you
   

  

* 2\+ years in customer success, account management, community management, inside sales or a closely related role. Exceptional freshers with the right temperament are welcome to apply
* Strong English communication, verbal and written. You'll write campaign copy and have renewal conversations on the same day
* Comfort owning payment and renewal follow\-ups — persistent, organised, and never awkward about it
* High proficiency with Google Workspace / MS Office, and hands\-on experience with an online CRM
* Ability to read data and turn it into an action, not just a chart
* Creative thinking paired with operational discipline — you can invent a campaign and also run the checklist that ships it
* A calm, patient, empathetic manner with students. Many of the people you'll speak to left because life got hard
* Based in Chennai and able to work on\-site with the coaching team


 Nice to have
   

  

* Experience in a B2C, subscription or membership\-led business
* Background in fitness, sports, wellness or education
* Hands\-on with marketing automation or CRM workflow building — WhatsApp or email journeys, lifecycle campaigns
* Spreadsheets beyond the basics — pivots, cohort views, retention curves
* A training practice of your own. It helps you speak our students' language


 Your first 90 days
   

  

 First 30 days You know our membership plans, CRM and student segments cold. You've run your first re\-activation outreach list and sat in on classes with the coaching team. By day 60 You own the renewals follow\-up cycle independently. A first comeback campaign is designed, shipped and measured. By day 90 You're reporting engagement, renewals and revenue on a regular cadence, and you've brought a measurable lift in attendance or renewal rate on at least one student segment.
   

  

 What you get
   

  

* A balanced, respectful work culture that respects your life outside work
* Free membership at The Quad — train with coaches who've transformed thousands of lives
* Health insurance, annual health checkups and wellness support

title: Senior Adobe Commerce Engineer
description:
The Senior AEM Engineer is responsible for designing, developing, and delivering Adobe Experience Manager (AEM) solutions and related platform integrations across the full project lifecycle. This role will be also responsible to work with team of developers under the guidance of technical lead to deliver the requirements. This role will also be responsible for supporting existing implementation via enhancements and bug fixes.
   

  

 In addition to strong technical knowledge of the AEM and integrated platform this position requires strong communication and interpersonal skills to build and maintain trusted relationships with various business stack holders and partners. Work will be managed with supervision of lead and encouraged to take initiative on ideas, best practices etc...
   

  

**Role / Responsibilities:**
* Design \& define technical approaches to achieve business requirements, review with technical leader board, documents and develops the solution along with the team.
* Ensures the delivery and success of AEM enterprise\-level integration and development involving upstream and downstream systems
* Participates in gathering of technical and functional requirements from business teams during discovery phase and translate it into AEM solution and document it
* Create development approach along with team and present it for approval with technical leader board along with efforts
* Should be hand on AEM features and functionality to develop custom solution including back\-end integration and ready to develop them along with development team
* Should be creative and OOTB thinker to bring best practices in development approaches
* Suggest alternative technical solutions to meet business requirements more efficiently and/or with greater reusability and/or long\-term solution
* Perform reviews and provide inputs/directions to the development team during design and development phase
* Experience and exposure in agile methodologies.
* Excellent communication skills and customer relationship building skills


**Technical Skills**
* Strong hands\-on experience of AEM Components, editable Templates, Client Libraries, Taxonomy, metadata management, Forward and Reverse Replication, Workflows, Content Publishing, Tagging, Campaigns, Analytics and Targeting.
* Experienced with third party integrations e.g. Search Integrations, Authentication Handlers, Web services Integrations, etc
* Hands on experience in dispatcher configuration mainly sling mapping, vhost and url rewrite etc…
* Experience working with E\-Commerce platforms is highly desirable (e.g. Magento, SalesForce Commerce Cloud etc.)
* Extensive experience in application deployment (Cloud deployment/In\-house deployment)
* Good understanding of integration patterns and content\-centric application development patterns using AEM, Search, Commerce package or other platforms.
* Good understanding of AEM capabilities including Multi\-site manager and Blueprinting, and the use of Online marketing components such as advanced targeting/ personalization, and multi\-variate testing.
* Should have configured and designed AEM multi\-tenant solutions and delivered it
* Designed and implemented tagging and data layers for complex analytics scenarios, content targeting and personalization scenarios
* Experience in performing product and technology research and analysis to formulate solutions to business specific requirements
* Experience in implementing, enhancing, and troubleshooting AEM installations and administration issues
* Should have conducted code reviews for ongoing projects to ensure optimal code quality and appropriate design patterns are used
* Having one or more of the following certifications is a plus. AEM Developer, Adobe AEM Advanced developer


**Experience** 
  

  

* Overall 6\+ years of experience in delivering enterprise solutions
* Minimum 4\+ years of experience developing with AEM Touch UI(version 6\.4 and higher, As a Cloud Service will be preferred)
* Minimum 4\+ years solution designing \& executing AEM sites build:
+ Editable Template
+ Touch UI Components (React/Sightly/JSP/Java/Angular)
+ Servlet, Services, Third Party Integration
+ Server side caching build (symphony, EHcache etc…)
+ Context Hub and campaign
+ Sling models and exposure
+ Experience and content fragment
+ Context aware configuration (OSGI configuration)
+ Styling system/Multitenant architecture
+ MSM (Blueprint, Live copy, Language copy)
+ Replication and triggering jobs or event on activation/deactivation
+ Dispatcher configuration
+ Front end and server side debugging and fixing issue
+ Performance improvement and SEO debugging and tracking
+ Experience with Analytics tools like (google analytics or adobe analytics
+ Experience with targeting tools like (Adobe Target or double click etc…)
+ Experience with Tagging system like (google tag manager or adobe launch)
+ Experience with eCommerce platform Magento aka Adobe commerce will be plus
+ Experience with integrating SalesForce will be plus
+ Experience with integrating Product management system will be plus
+ Experience utilizing BitBucket, GitHub, Jira and Confluence
+ Experience with cloud offerings as a hosting platform
+ Experience on designing CI/CD process
+ Experience on customizing GDPR presentation
+ Strong sense of ownership and accountability with a commitment to deliver quality outcomes that balance technical and business goals
+ Broad web and digital knowledge with an aptitude for troubleshooting and problem solving.

title: Customer Value Lead
description:
**Do you have experience in managing innovation projects?**
**Are you a team Player?**
**About Our Team**
 The Customer Value Lead will sits within Journal Operations and is responsible for accelerating key strategic projects for Journal Operations, drive the right process and governance to drive Innovation across organization and contribute to development of key enablers such as learning ecosystem. .
   

  

**About The Role**
 Focused on core customer problems and an AI first mindset, the Customer Value Lead is accountable for driving the innovation initiatives, discovery, and value realisation of initiatives — including intelligent automation and Product capabilities — across end to end publishing processes.
   

  

 Acting as a strategic thought partner and accelerator for innovation, this role strengthens the quality of ideas and increases their likelihood of successful progression by challenging assumptions, quantifying value, surfacing risks and dependencies, connecting opportunities across domains, and providing structure and direction throughout discovery, product shaping, and implementation.Working closely with Business, Product, Technology, Operations, CX, Editorial, and vendor teams, the role orchestrates delivery of prioritized initiatives across multiple stakeholders, resolves dependencies and blockers, and provides governance, decision\-making structure, and visibility to leadership.
   

  

 The role can also involve defining and tracking metrics and creating benefits frameworks, using experimentation and data to validate assumptions and inform go/no\-go decisions, and ensures right prioritization of individual initiatives to deliver on our strategy.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Innovation Strategy, Initiatives \& Discovery**
* Assess new opportunities, establishing clear criteria for progression and prioritisation based on customer impact, business value, risk, and effort.
* Lead or consult on discovery activity, challenging the problem definition to ensure the right problem is being solved before investment is made.
* Define target outcomes, identify affected users and stakeholders, and quantify the potential impact of opportunities under consideration.
* Surface risks, assumptions, and dependencies early, and determine what needs to be validated (e.g. through research, prototyping, or experimentation) before an initiative progresses.


**Product Management \& Solution Shaping**
* Translate validated opportunities into clear product/solution requirements, defining journeys, outcomes, and success measures.
* Support prioritisation of requirements and features in partnership with Product and Technology, ensuring business value and customer impact drive sequencing.
* Work with Product and Technology teams through elaboration, design, and implementation, providing business input and decisions at key stages.
* Ensure delivered solutions remain aligned to the original business problem and intended outcomes, escalating and course\-correcting where scope or design drifts.
* Own business\-side delivery oversight, coordinating UAT, release readiness, and go\-live activities to ensure a smooth transition into live service.


**Intelligent Automation**
* Shape the roadmap for intelligent automation within the product, identifying where AI\-driven capabilities can most effectively support user tasks, decisions, or interactions, and building the business case for each opportunity.
* Partner with Technology and Design teams to define the underlying requirements — the logic, data and knowledge sources, and integration/API needs the capability depends on — along with the guardrails, escalation paths, and human\-in\-the\-loop or assisted\-service touchpoints needed to manage risk, edge cases, and complex scenarios.
* Establish clear quality and performance measures (such as accuracy, containment or resolution rates, error/escalation rates, and customer satisfaction), and agree the testing, validation, and release criteria required before deployment.
* Once live, monitor performance and usage data, incorporate user feedback, and drive continuous optimisation and retraining to ensure the capability keeps pace with changing needs and continues to deliver measurable value.


**Orchestration, Governance \& Delivery Acceleration**
* Act as the central connective point across Business, Product, Technology, Operations, CX, Editorial, vendor, and other partner teams, resolving dependencies and unblocking delivery.
* Identify blockers and risks early, establish clear ownership, and drive decisions to keep initiatives moving when they span multiple teams.
* Establish and maintain operational governance to ensure enhancements align with service policies, compliance requirements, and readiness standards, communicating major changes and contingency plans clearly


- 

**Cross\-Functional Leadership \& Value Realisation**
* Act as the central coordination point across Business, Product, Technology, Operations, CX, and other partner teams, facilitating alignment on priorities, service impacts, and adoption readiness across initiatives.
* Champion change enablement and adoption, ensuring capabilities are understood and effectively embedded into ways of working, and build a cross\-functional stakeholder community to share performance insights, lessons learned, and improvement opportunities.
* Establish baselines, targets, and KPI frameworks for initiatives, and maintain a benefits/impact monitoring framework to track value realised against the original business case.
* Track adoption, performance, quality, and other operational outcomes, using data and structured experimentation to test assumptions and inform go/no\-go decisions.
* Escalate operational risks, dependency conflicts, and delivery blockers through appropriate governance channels, and connect insights and outcomes across initiatives to identify opportunities for reuse or broader strategic alignment.


**Requirements**
* 6–10 years of experience in service operations, digital support operations, automation initiatives, or business\-facing roles within technology\-enabled environments.
* Demonstrated experience delivering measurable improvements in service efficiency, operational performance, and customer satisfaction.
* Experience identifying and evaluating automation or digital enhancement opportunities from a business and service impact perspective.
* Strong understanding of customer support operations, including case management workflows, escalation models, SLAs, and service risk considerations.
* Experience partnering with Product and Technology teams to translate operational priorities into structured business requirements and improvement initiatives.
* Proven ability to drive adoption of digital tools or automation capabilities within operational environments.
* Strong analytical and stakeholder communication skills, with the ability to translate performance insights into clear recommendations.
* Bachelor's degree in Business, Operations Management, Engineering, Technology, or a related field. Relevant certifications (Lean, Six Sigma, Agile, ITIL, Service Management) are advantageous.


**Work in a way that works for you**
 We promote a healthy work/life balance across the organisation. We offer an appealing working prospect for our people. With numerous wellbeing initiatives, shared parental leave, study assistance and sabbaticals, we will help you meet your immediate responsibilities and your long\-term goals.
   

  

* Working flexible hours \- flexing the times when you work in the day to help you fit everything in and work when you are the most productive


**Working for you**
**Benefits**
 We know that your wellbeing and happiness are key to a long and successful career. These are some of the benefits we are delighted to offer:
   

  

* Comprehensive Health Insurance: Covers you, your immediate family, and parents.
* Enhanced Health Insurance Options: Competitive rates negotiated by the company.
* Group Life Insurance: Ensuring financial security for your loved ones.
* Group Accident Insurance: Extra protection for accidental death and permanent disablement.
* Flexible Working Arrangement: Achieve a harmonious work\-life balance.
* Employee Assistance Program: Access support for personal and work\-related challenges.
* Medical Screening: Your well\-being is a top priority.
* Modern Family Benefits: Maternity, paternity, and adoption support.
* Long\-Service Awards: Recognizing dedication and commitment.
* New Baby Gift: Celebrating the joy of parenthood.
* Subsidized Meals in Chennai: Enjoy delicious meals at discounted rates.
* Various Paid Time Off: Take time off with Casual Leave, Sick Leave, Privilege Leave, Compassionate Leave, Special Sick Leave, and Gazetted Public Holidays.
* Free Transport pick up and drop from the home \-office \- home (applies in Chennai)


**About The Business**
 A global leader in information and analytics, we help researchers and healthcare professionals’ advance science and improve health outcomes for the benefit of society. Building on our publishing heritage, we combine quality information and vast data sets with analytics to support visionary science and research, health education and interactive learning, as well as exceptional healthcare and clinical practice. At Elsevier, your work contributes to the world’s grand challenges and a more sustainable future. We harness innovative technologies to support science and healthcare to partner for a better world.

title: DEM_Technical Services Engineer
description:
Job Location: Bangalore, Chennai, Hyderabad, Noida, Pune
   

  

 Location Flexibility: Multiple Locations Globally
   

  

 Req Id: 12233
   

  

 Posting Start Date: 9/10/26
   

  

 At Fujitsu, we've been driven to create a sustainable world through innovation since 1935\. Today, we lead in digital transformation globally with our 130,000 employees across 50\+ countries. We empower our diverse community to achieve greatness through career development and opportunities. Explore our internal positions and join us in shaping a brighter future. Thank you for being a part of Fujitsu. We look forward to growing together toward a brighter future.
   

  

**DEM (Digital Experience Management) Analyst**
**Key Responsibilities:**
* The DEM Analyst is responsible for proactively analysing the digital experience of end users and identifying potential areas for improvement within End User Experience Management technologies, such as Nexthink, Lakeside Systrack, and Aternity, as part of the End User Analytics Services that Fujitsu provides to our customers.
* As the DEM Analyst, you will focus on analysing the digital experience scores on a proactive basis and providing reports to account team stakeholders on the key issues that are causing drops in digital experience and recommendations for improvement areas.
* You will also conduct deeper investigations with support from relevant resolver groups, utilizing the DEM tool and other key service performance data, such as ticket analysis, to understand the breadth and impact of the issue.
* You will oversee the implementation of any new requirements from improvement recommendations and are responsible for reporting the status and benefits of these improvements.
* Continuous learning is an important part of this role and you will be expected to participate in learning sessions and reading facilitated by our vendor partners or the Centre of Excellence (aka DEM Dojo) use cases and best practices.
* It is expected that the role owner will have a close relationship with the Digital Advisor and the CEC Digital Adoption \& UX Lead.
* The Digital Advisor is an additional advisory role who is deployed on a project\-basis that will be responsible for defining and shaping the digital experience score and XLAs and will also identify the first set of improvement opportunities and recommendations.
* You will be expected to continue the work of the Digital Advisor once the service is in a steady state and work through the improvement backlog or identify new opportunity areas.
* This continuation also includes working closely with the CEC Digital Adoption \& UX Lead to create a complete picture of user experience, with your focus being on technology\-level experience and the DA \& UX Lead focusing on service\-level experience.
* The DA \& UX Lead will be a key stakeholder in providing requirements for any use cases that involved contact with end users. You will be responsible for managing the requirements for any new use cases identified as part of the improvement plan, working with the DEM Business Analyst and DEM Technician to ensure successful delivery of these requirements.
* You will play a key role in progressing the service along the maturity roadmap to ensure it brings tangible business benefits. Where there is no Digital Advisor allocated to the account, the role will involve a period of transition to support the baselining and configuration of the digital experience score, based on requirements from the customer and account team, and the initial set of recommendations for improvement areas based on use cases and best practices from the DEM Dojo.
* The role should follow the ITIL Service Value System Principles Focus on value Start where you are Progress iteratively with feedback Collaborate and promote visibility
* Think and work holistically Keep it simple and practical Optimize and automate Success factors Value Decreased incidents and contacts at the service desk through proactive investigation and problem management of end user issues Increased adoption and use of a virtual assistant, by enabling more use cases through the integration of DEM technologies with the virtual agent
* Decreased MTTR of Fujitsu managed services resolver groups by educating them on using DEM technologies to resolve issues and through the implementation of their use case and dashboard requirements
* The exploitation of the DEM technologies to drive account ROI and transformation of roles towards proactive continuous improvement Increased end user digital experience scores tied into outcome\-based CI Successful launch and program activity, minimize delays Meet contractual KSVI commitments Customer renewals / good news stories and references
* Supporting the CI Service Delivery Manager to drive change and improvements Maturity assessment benefits realization / understand customer journey mapping Required


**Experience**
* Strong experience of working with virtual teams Ability to present, visually, service reports
* A high degree of problem and creative thinking skills Planning, prioritization skills, a passion for customer service and high\-quality delivery
* Demonstrate good interpersonal skills, diplomacy in dealing with customers and internal teams Good experience of at least one DEM technology (Aternity, Nexthink, Lakeside Systrack), including supporting the utilization of the technology for tangible benefit
* Certification in at least on DEM technology to an analyst level Experience in 2nd line support and triaging issues to 3rd line resolver groups Experience in problem or incident management, with a good understanding of how the end user impact of technology issues Ideally, a good understanding of other automation technologies, such as Resolve and RPA


**Mandatory Skills**
 Nexthink, PowerShell Script Developer, Windows 10, 11 OS Knowledge.
   

  

 Relocation Supported: No
   

  

 Visa Sponsorship Approved: No
   

  

 At Fujitsu, we are committed to an inclusive recruitment process that values the diverse backgrounds and experiences of all applicants. We believe that hiring people from a wide variety of backgrounds makes us stronger, not because it's the right thing to do, but because it allows us to draw on a wider range of perspectives and life experiences.

description:
**Company Overview**
 Stellantis is a leading global automaker and mobility provider that offers clean, connected, affordable, and safe mobility solutions. Our Company’s strength lies in the breadth of our iconic brand portfolio, the diversity and passion of our people, and our deep roots in the communities in which we operate. Our ambitious electrification and software strategies and the creation of an innovative ecosystem of strategic, game\-changing partnerships are driving our transformation to a sustainable mobility tech company.
   

  

 The driving force behind us is the diverse and talented group of employees around the world who bring their passion and experience to their work every day. And while we are a truly global organization, we remain deeply rooted in the communities in which we operate and where our colleagues live and work.
   

  

 With industrial operations in nearly 30 countries, Stellantis could consistently exceed the evolving needs and expectations of consumers in more than 130 markets, while creating superior value for all stakeholders.

* Budget \& Performance: Manages IT budgets, tracks key performance indicators (KPIs), and optimizes system performance.
* Project Management: Oversees infrastructure projects, including planning, timelines, staffing, and implementation.


 Key Focus Areas
   

  

* Stability \& Availability: Ensures systems run optimally with high uptime.
* Data Security: Protects valuable organizational data.
* Scalability: Prepares infrastructure for future growth and increased demands.

 Architect / Lead SME

 We are looking for an experienced Oracle OCI Exadata Architect with strong hands\-on expertise in designing, administering and supporting enterprise Oracle database environments on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI).
   

  

 The candidate must have strong experience with OCI Exadata Database Service on Dedicated Infrastructure (ExaDB\-D), Exadata VM Clusters, Oracle Database 19c/23ai, RAC, Grid Infrastructure, ASM, Data Guard, RMAN, Exadata patching, performance tuning, OCI networking and disaster recovery.

 Strong working knowledge of OCI infrastructure supporting Exadata environments, including:
   

  

 VCN \& Subnets \| Client \& Backup Networks \| NSGs \| Security Lists \| Route Tables \| DRG \| DNS/SCAN \| FastConnect \| Site\-to\-Site VPN \| OCI IAM \| Vault/KMS \| OCI Monitoring \| Alarms \| Object Storage \| TDE

 OCI Exadata / ExaDB\-D \| Exadata VM Clusters \| Oracle Database 19c \& 23ai \| Oracle RAC \| Grid Infrastructure \| ASM \| Data Guard \| RMAN \| Exadata Patching \| AWR/ASH \| Performance Tuning \| OCI Networking \| Linux \| Backup \& Recovery \| DR \| Database Migration \| Patching \& Upgrades
   

  

**Experience Supporting Large Enterprise Oracle Database Environments Is Required.**
 Experience with Oracle E\-Business Suite R12\.2 running on OCI Exadata will be an added advantage.

* Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Architect Professional
* Oracle Cloud Database Services Professional

title: Performance Marketer
description:
Senior Performance Marketing Manager
 



 Location: Chennai
 



 Work Mode: Full\-Time, Work From Office
 



 Experience: 4\+ years
 



 Employment Type: Full\-time
 



  





 Department: Performance Marketing
 



  





 Reporting To: CEO
 



  





 About Spinta Digital
 



 Spinta Digital is a full\-service digital marketing and creative agency working with ambitious brands across healthcare, D2C, wellness, real estate, education, SaaS and technology.
 



  





 We are looking for a Senior Performance Marketer who has strong hands\-on experience across both Lead Generation and E\-commerce campaigns, with a deep understanding of tracking, attribution and conversion optimisation.
 



  





 This is a hands\-on role for someone who understands that performance marketing is not simply about running ads — it is about building the complete journey from tracking and targeting to acquisition, conversion and revenue.
 



  





 The Role
 



 You will be responsible for planning, executing, managing and optimising paid advertising campaigns across Meta Ads and Google Ads, covering both lead\-generation and e\-commerce businesses.
 



  





 A critical part of this role is having strong technical knowledge of conversion tracking and measurement, including Meta Conversions API (CAPI), Google Enhanced Conversions, GA4, Google Tag Manager and server\-side/event\-based tracking.
 



  





 You should be comfortable getting into the technical side of tracking rather than depending entirely on developers or analytics teams.
 



  





 Key Responsibilities
 



  





 Paid Media Management
 


* Plan and execute performance marketing strategies across Meta Ads and Google Ads.
* Manage both Lead Generation and E\-commerce campaigns.
* Develop campaign structures based on business objectives, customer journey and funnel stages.
* Manage budgets and optimise campaigns to achieve CPA, CPL, ROAS, CAC and revenue targets.
* Develop audience strategies including prospecting, retargeting, lookalikes and customer audiences.
* Manage campaign testing across audiences, creatives, offers, landing pages and messaging.
* Identify opportunities to scale winning campaigns while maintaining efficiency.
* Continuously monitor campaign performance and take corrective action when targets are not being achieved.



  





 E\-commerce Performance
 


* Manage campaigns focused on product purchases and revenue generation.
* Work with Shopify and other e\-commerce platforms.
* Understand the complete funnel from Landing Page → Product View → Add to Cart → Checkout → Purchase.
* Optimise campaigns based on ROAS, CAC, AOV, conversion rate and contribution margin.
* Work with product feeds and Google Merchant Center.
* Understand Shopping / Performance Max / Search / Display / YouTube campaign ecosystems.
* Identify funnel leakage and work with CRO/creative teams to improve conversion rates.



  





 Lead Generation
 


* Build and optimise campaigns for lead generation across multiple industries.
* Work with different lead\-generation objectives including enquiries, consultations, registrations, applications and qualified leads.
* Understand the difference between Lead, MQL, SQL and actual revenue.
* Optimise campaigns based on lead quality and downstream conversion rather than simply CPL.
* Work with CRM data to understand which campaigns, audiences and keywords are generating actual business.
* Develop strategies for improving lead quality while maintaining acquisition efficiency.



  





 Tracking \& Attribution — Critical Requirement
 


* The candidate must have hands\-on experience implementing and troubleshooting conversion tracking, not just using dashboards to read campaign results.



  





 You should have experience with:
 



  




* Meta
* Meta Pixel implementation
* Meta Conversions API (CAPI)
* Event setup and mapping
* Event deduplication
* Browser \+ server\-side event tracking
* Event Match Quality
* Advanced Matching
* Purchase, Lead, ViewContent, AddToCart and other standard events
* Meta Events Manager
* Diagnosing discrepancies between Meta and website/CRM data
* Google
* Google Enhanced Conversions
* Google Ads conversion tracking
* GA4
* Google Tag Manager
* Google Analytics events and conversions
* Google Merchant Center
* Google Ads ↔ GA4 integration
* Offline conversion imports where applicable
* Understanding GCLID / UTM parameters and attribution
* Analytics \& Attribution
* GA4
* Google Tag Manager
* UTM strategy
* Cross\-channel attribution
* Understanding discrepancies between Meta, Google Ads, GA4 and Shopify/CRM
* Ability to audit tracking setups and identify data gaps
* Understanding first\-party and server\-side tracking concepts
* Experience working with tools such as Elevar, Northbeam or similar attribution/tracking platforms is a strong advantage.



  





 Creative \& CRO Understanding
 



 A strong performance marketer should understand creative — not just media buying.
 



  





 You will:
 



  




* Analyse which creatives are driving CTR, CVR and conversions.
* Work with designers and copywriters to develop better\-performing ads.
* Identify creative fatigue.
* Recommend new creative concepts based on campaign data.
* Provide clear briefs for new ad creatives.
* Analyse landing pages and identify potential conversion issues.
* Work with the creative and development teams to improve the overall customer journey.
* Reporting \& Analysis
* Prepare regular performance reports and dashboards.
* Analyse campaign performance at campaign, ad set/ad group, keyword, creative and audience levels.
* Identify the why behind performance changes rather than simply reporting numbers.
* Provide clear recommendations and action plans.



 Track key metrics including:
 


* ROAS
* CAC
* CPA
* CPL
* CTR
* CPC
* CPM
* Conversion Rate
* AOV
* Revenue
* Lead Quality
* Funnel Conversion Rates



 Requirements
 


* 4–7 years of hands\-on performance marketing experience.
* Strong experience managing both Lead Generation and E\-commerce campaigns.
* Strong hands\-on experience with Meta Ads Manager and Google Ads.

* Build AI\-based rule optimization frameworks for IT/OT security controls, improving traffic filtering, segmentation policies, and alert accuracy.
* Leverage AI for OT network traffic optimization, enabling intelligent routing, congestion minimization, and adaptive policy enforcement.
* Implement AI\-powered device behavior profiling, establishing baselines for PLCs, HMIs, and IoT/IIoT assets to detect unauthorized or abnormal activities.
* Apply AI in PLC code analysis and review, identifying logic anomalies, misconfigurations, and potential security vulnerabilities in industrial control systems.
* Utilize AI/ML for network threat detection, including intrusion detection, lateral movement analysis, and zero\-day attack identification in IT/OT environments.
* Design and optimize prompt engineering strategies to effectively leverage GenAI tools for IT/OT security use cases such as incident investigation, log analysis, and threat intelligence enrichment.
* Enable AI\-driven continuous monitoring and predictive risk analytics to enhance IT/OT resilience and reduce operational downtime.
* Build reusable methods, accelerators, reference architectures, and runbooks that strengthen the firm’s AI Network \& Infrastructure Security offerings and improve repeatability across sectors and accounts.
* Manage client expectations, delivery scope, solution quality, risks, and technical escalations while coaching teams and enabling long\-term client capability through documentation and knowledge transfer.


**Required Qualifications**

* Experience with OT security tools (Nozomi, Claroty, Armis, Dragos, Cisco Cyber Vision) and OT vulnerability management.
* Expertise in XDR, Zero Trust, and regulatory frameworks (IEC 62443, CIS). Hands\-on with NGFWs (Palo Alto, Cisco, Fortinet, Azure Firewall) and VMware virtualization security.
* Skilled in SSE/SASE platforms (Netskope, Zscaler, Akamai) and secure access technologies (VPN, ZTNA, DNS security).
* Strong capability in multi\-vendor security integration across IT, OT, and cloud environments.
* Strong client\-facing communication and the ability to operate as a trusted technical advisor to senior stakeholders.


**Ideally, you’ll also have**
* Good soft skills i.e. verbal \& written communication, technical document writing etc
* Strong project management, negotiation and interpersonal skills
* Prior experience working in Advisory or Technology Consulting industry
* Customer orientation skills
* Industry related certification (e.g. CISSP, CISA, CISM, SABSA, PRINCE2, TOGAF)
* Vendor related certifications (e.g. Zscaler, Nozomi, Netskope, Palo Alto Networks, Cisco \& others)


**Why join us**
 Join a globally connected cybersecurity practice helping clients protect their network \& infra structure security portfolio in an AI\-driven world. You will work at the intersection of IT/OT Network , Infrastructure security, and frontier AI — helping shape practical, scalable solutions that reduce risk, enable trust, and support secure business transformation. This is consistent with the internal positioning of the network \& infrastructure security practice as technology\-enabled, consulting\-led, and globally delivered.

* Global, cross\-functional teams
* Mix of advisory, architecture, engineering, and delivery
* Exposure to strategic client programs and market\-shaping offerings
* Opportunity to build reusable assets, accelerators, and modernization patterns consistent with a global delivery model

 Do you want to push the boundaries of your profession and develop your excellence in an open, collaborative and empowering culture? We work to create a sustainable future and our inspiring projects and innovative solutions aim to set the standard among our peers. You will join a global company that has been growing successfully since its founding in 1945\.  Are you passionate about
 **concept, FEED \& detailed engineering / EPIC**

 **technically ambitious** 
 and skilled
 **Automation / SCADA** 
 for our Chennai location.
   

  

 Do you have experience designing and implementing SCADA\-systems and network solutions? Do you want to help shape the future of the utility sector with innovative and secure solutions?
   

  

 If this sounds like you, then this position might be the right opportunity. Join our team, where we work to create a sustainable future through advanced technological solutions.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Key responsibilities, tasks \& important relations**
 To add one Lead Automation Engineer in Power Systems to support High voltage design and detailed engineering of transmission, distribution and offshore / onshore substation engineering activities for Energy Systems group of Ramboll Energy division, Chennai
   

  

 As our new SCADA/ICS/DCS and network specialist, you will participate in a wide range of complex national and international projects with a strong focus on substations and TSO interfaces. You will contribute your expertise in SCADA system design, substation automation, network architecture, and cyber security across projects related to FACTS, HVDC, hydrogen infrastructure, and data centers. The scope of work spans from early concept development and interface definition with TSOs through specification, detailed design, procurement, implementation, and commissioning. Projects are delivered in close collaboration with multidisciplinary teams in a highly professional and continuously developing environment alongside experienced colleagues.
   

  

**Responsibilities \& Tasks**
* Development of initial concepts, including concept overview, hardware selection, protocol selection, cost estimates, and tender materials for SCADA and network solutions
* Design of SCADA systems used for tenders
* Design of network solutions and integration with other systems
* Implementation and advisory on cyber security measures in SCADA and network design
* Interface management
* Conducting supervision and commissioning
* Preparing man\-hour estimation for CTR preparation and review of tender documents.
* Preparation and evaluation of general project documentation.
* Coordination and follow up of packages with system Vendor.
* Coordination with Transmission System Owner and substation owner / contractor, issue and follow up of CSS questionnaire.
* Review / Preparation and evaluation of general project documentation in addition to engineering deliverables.
* Handling multi discipline task\-oriented projects.
* Handling and guiding junior engineers / designers and draughtsman.


**Important Relations.**
* HOD/Team Lead/Lead Engineer/Sr. Engineer \& team
* Works with other engineers in the project team of REN EEC and DK (or other Ramboll countries) team
* Works with HV Engineering counterparts in other REN offices


**Qualifications**
**Qualifications \& Experience**
 From the moment you start with us, we will support your personal and professional development so that you can grow together with the company. We have identified the following qualifications and skills that will contribute to your success in the role. Therefore, it will be an advantage if you can relate to most of the following points:
   

  

  

* Engineer with experience in SCADA, SRO, and network systems, including IEC 61850–based substation automation
* Experience applying relevant standards and legislation within SCADA/ICS/DCS and networks, including IEC 62443, NIS2, IEC 61508, ISO/IEC 27001, and related frameworks
* Practical experience with converter technologies such as STATCOM, HVDC (including rectifier and inverter stations), and other power electronics–based systems
* Strong background in network principles and cyber security for critical infrastructure
* Experience with tendering processes, specifications, and technical evaluations
* Relevant professional experience from consulting, utilities, OEMs, or system suppliers is an advantage
* Fluent in English; experience working in European, multilingual project environments (additional European languages are an advantage)
* Master/Bachelor of Electrical or Automation or Instrumentation or Control Engineering recognized University
* Should have the experience of 15 to 20 years
* Experience of at least 3 years in the consulting firm is a must.
* Experience in working on US and European projects preferred.
* Experienced in performing technical, economic and environmental studies
* Excellent in English skills oral and written is very important and a requirement
* Skilled user of Microsoft office – Excel, Word


**Personal competences**
* Engineering skills with analytical approach
* Work as a team member with good interpersonal skills
* Structured working style with result\-oriented approach
* Should be able to build and maintain good relationships with clients and colleagues
* Excellent in English skills oral and written is very important and a requirement


**Additional Information**
**Working at Ramboll**
 To work at Ramboll means being part of a people organisation. We are focused on knowledge sharing and collaboration across competence areas and geography, and we aim for a strong diversity among our employees. This enables us to solve a broad range of projects, and we firmly believe that cross\-collaboration leads to creative and longstanding solutions. Thus, the possibilities at Ramboll are many and diverse –we invest a lot in the development of people and offer career paths tailored for each individual.
   

  

**Welcome to our Energy division**
 Ramboll is at the forefront of addressing the green transition and offers a holistic approach to energy that supports the sector on the journey towards more sustainable solutions. With 1,800 experts in 14 countries, covering the full spectrum of technologies and all parts of the value chain from production and transmission to distribution, we plan, design and implement energy solutions all over the world.
   

  

**Ramboll in India**
 Ramboll has more than 1,000 experts working across five offices in India applying their passion to deliver innovative solutions in markets as diverse as Buildings, Transport, Planning \& Urban Design, Water, Environment \& Health and Energy. Founded in Denmark, Ramboll is a people company. We invite you to contribute to a sustainable future working in an open, collaborative and empowering culture.
   

  

**How To Apply**
 If you are interested in applying, please send your application through our online recruitment system by clicking the link ‘apply’ below. Attach your CV, cover letter and relevant documents showcasing why you are the right fit for the role, and when you are available to start. We look forward to receiving your application.

title: Workday Techno Functional Consultant
description:
**About Poshmark**
**Poshmark is the leading fashion marketplace where style comes alive through discovery, self\-expression, and human connection.** 
 Powered by a vibrant community of 165 million members, Poshmark brings real people and taste to shopping through a social experience shaped by shared discovery. Buying and selling fashion feels simple, joyful, and personal, while every item tells its own story. Poshmark empowers sellers to grow meaningful businesses, keeps fashion in circulation longer, and gives shoppers access to unique and trusted finds, from everyday pieces to one\-of\-a\-kind vintage and luxury.
   

  

 We are seeking a highly skilled and analytically driven
 **Senior Specialist II, HR Technology** 
 (Workday Techno\-functional consultant) to join our People team. In this role, you will serve as a senior subject matter expert at the intersection of HR systems and people analytics, helping to optimize our HR technology ecosystem while enabling data\-driven decision\-making across the organization.
   

  

 While you will bring deep expertise in Workday HCM—our current HR platform—your value extends beyond any single tool. You are an HR technology and people analytics professional who can build scalable reporting and analytics solutions, support workforce planning through data\-driven insights, and translate complex workforce data into actionable recommendations for HR and business leaders. You contribute to the development of analytics frameworks and predictive analyses while helping ensure that our people data ecosystem remains scalable, reliable, and adaptable as technology evolves.
   

  

 You will partner closely with HR, IT, Finance, and business stakeholders to enhance system capabilities, improve data quality, streamline processes, and deliver meaningful workforce insights that support organizational goals.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* People Analytics \& Workforce Insights
* Develop and maintain workforce dashboards, scorecards, and recurring reports that support HR and business decision\-making.
* Analyze workforce trends across headcount, attrition, recruiting, diversity, performance, engagement, and employee lifecycle metrics.
* Partner with HR Business Partners, Talent Acquisition, Total Rewards, and business leaders to understand reporting needs and provide actionable insights.
* Build and maintain data visualizations using tools such as Tableau, Power BI, Workday Prism Analytics, or equivalent platforms.
* Support workforce planning, talent reviews, succession planning, and organizational effectiveness initiatives through data analysis and reporting.
* Contribute to the development of people analytics frameworks and predictive analyses that support talent and workforce decisions.
* Ensure consistency, accuracy, and integrity of workforce metrics by adhering to established reporting standards and governance practices.
* HR Systems Administration (Workday)
* Administer, configure, and maintain Workday HCM modules including Core HR, Recruiting, Talent Management, Compensation, Benefits, Time \& Absence, and Helpdesk.
* Configure and support business processes, workflows, notifications, security roles, and system controls in alignment with HR policies and operational requirements.
* Develop and maintain Workday reports, dashboards, calculated fields, and composite reports.
* Support Workday biannual releases by assessing impacts, testing enhancements, and coordinating deployment activities.
* Investigate, troubleshoot, and resolve system issues while ensuring timely communication and resolution for stakeholders.
* Partner with HR Operations and IT teams to continuously optimize system functionality, user experience, and process efficiency.
* HR Data Governance \& Quality
* Maintain high standards of HR data accuracy, completeness, and consistency across HR systems.
* Conduct regular audits and validation activities to identify and resolve data discrepancies.
* Support compliance with internal controls, audit requirements, and applicable data privacy regulations.
* Document reporting definitions, system configurations, business processes, and operating procedures.
* Contribute to the ongoing development and maintenance of HR data governance standards and data quality processes.
* Support efforts to improve trust, transparency, and accessibility of people data across the organization.
* Systems Integration \& Technical Support
* Support integrations between Workday and connected systems including payroll, benefits, talent, learning, and finance platforms.
* Assist with data imports, exports, Enterprise Interface Builder (EIB) processes, and interface monitoring activities.
* Partner with IT teams and external vendors to troubleshoot integration issues and implement system enhancements.
* Participate in testing activities for integrations, system upgrades, new functionality, and process changes.
* Maintain technical documentation, configuration records, and knowledge base materials to support operational continuity.
* Process Optimization \& Stakeholder Enablement
* Identify opportunities to automate manual HR processes and improve operational efficiency through technology solutions.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
**About Kinaxis**
 Are you looking to join an innovative, market\-leading company where you can truly elevate your career? At Kinaxis we are serious about culture, we are serious about technology, we are serious about customers, and we are serious about not taking ourselves too seriously. If you are looking to be part of an incredible growth story, then we might just be the place for you!
   

  

 In 1984, we started out as a team of three engineers. Today, we have grown to become a global organization with over 2000 employees around the world, 6 global office and a best\-in\-class HQ in Ottawa, Canada. As winners of several Top Employer awards globally, we are proud to work with our customers and employees towards solving some of the biggest challenges facing supply chains today.
   

  

 Kinaxis is a global leader in modern supply chain orchestration, powering complex global supply chains, and supporting the people who manage them. Our powerful, AI infused platform provides full transparency and visibility across end\-to\-end supply chains, enabling our customers to make faster, better decisions. We are trusted by renowned global brands to provide the agility and predictability needed to navigate today’s volatility and disruption. With more than 40,000 users in over 100 countries, we are expanding our team as we continue to innovate and revolutionize how we support our customers.
   

  

**Location**
 Chennai / Bangalore \- India
   

  

 Work Model \- Hybrid
   

  

**About The Role**
 Kinaxis is building a Forward Deployed Engineers team whose singular mission is to Help customer transform how work gets done in the Agentic Age. This is not a consulting role, and it is not a features team. It is a Multi deployment unit embedded, operating with the speed and ownership culture of a startup.
   

  

 This team operates as a POD inside Kinaxis — a small, tight unit with end\-to\-end ownership and a startup mentality inside a larger company. We are scrappy, resourceful, and self\-directed. We move fast, trade tasks to whoever is closest to the need, and stay relentlessly focused on customer impact.
   

  

 You will work shoulder\-to\-shoulder with customers — from warehouse floor to executive sponsor — designing, building, and shipping Agentic AI solutions on the Kinaxis Maestro Platform. When a solution works, you abstract it into a reusable pattern. When something breaks in production, you own the fix. You operate in a POD team: tight, multi\-disciplinary, and self\-directed.
   

  

 💡 Attitude is the biggest asset. We hire for trajectory and mindset, not years on a resume. The right bias to action, ownership, and appetite to keep learning cannot be taught — but every technical skill here can be. Bring those, and we will invest in the rest.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
**Build the data backbone for AI Agents on Maestro**
* Design, build, and operate production data pipelines — ingestion, transformation, serving, and monitoring — that feed agentic AI workflows on the Kinaxis Maestro Platform.
* Integrate customer data sources (ERP systems, data warehouses, supply chain applications, flat files, APIs) into a unified data layer that agents can reason over reliably.
* Build and maintain data platform services, tooling, and infrastructure that enable reliable data ingestion, processing, sharing, and discovery across customer deployments.
* Own data quality end\-to\-end: profiling, validation, anomaly detection, and lineage — because an agent is only as good as the data behind it.


**Ship AI Agents alongside the POD**
* Partner with AI\-focused FDEs to design, develop, and ship agentic AI workflows — including multi\-agent orchestration, RAG pipelines, and tool\-use patterns — ensuring the data layer is production\-ready.
* Translate messy, real\-world customer data landscapes into clean, well\-modeled foundations that agents can consume — iterating rapidly from prototype to deployment.
* Troubleshoot complex production issues across the full stack data pipelines, model context, API layers, and infrastructure — in live customer environments.


**Own the full solution lifecycle**
* Carry multiple customer engagements in parallel; set expectations early, renegotiate honestly when priorities shift, and own outcomes end\-to\-end.
* Define and track success in business terms: data freshness SLAs, pipeline reliability, query performance, exception rates — not just deployment completion.
* Drive platform engineering best practices through Infrastructure\-as\-Code, CI/CD automation, observability, and automated testing across customer deployments.


**Work inside a POD team**
* Operate as part of a small, self\-directed POD within Kinaxis tasks traded fluidly to whoever has the right skills, focus maintained with urgency.
* Partner closely with Product and Engineering to convert field learnings and repeatable data patterns into durable platform capabilities, not one\-off scripts.
* Serve as the technical face of the team in customer rooms — from IC\-level engineers to skeptical architects to VP sponsors and build genuine trust across all of them.


**Drive adoption and change**
* Guide customer data teams through solution transitions: the new data architecture has to stick, not just ship.
* Mentor customer teams on modern data engineering practices, agentic data workflows, and new operating patterns so capability transfers and does not remain dependent on you.


****What we are looking for****
**Bias to action**
 You move on what matters. You finish what you start. The outcome is yours — no waiting for perfect clarity.
   

  

**Self\-directed**
 You identify what matters, secure the help or learning you need, and deliver — without being told.
   

  

**Always learning**
 Every customer, teammate, and new tool is a chance to level up. Not knowing something is fine; refusing to learn it is not.
   

  

**Customer\-obsessed**
 You can sit with a frustrated VP, a skeptical architect, or a junior analyst — and leave each one feeling heard, helped, and impressed.
   

  

**Comfortable with ambiguity**
 Undefined problem, undefined scope, undefined success metric — and you still ship.
   

  

**Drives change, not just code**
 You guide customers through transitions and mentor their teams to adopt new ways of working.
   

  

 The following are the technical areas we look for. You do not need depth in all of them — we look for strong foundations, a growth trajectory, and the ability to pick up what is missing quickly.
   

  

**Data Engineering \& Platforms (Primary)**
* Strong hands\-on experience building and operating production data pipelines — ingestion, transformation, serving, and monitoring — using tools such as Spark, Airflow, Kafka, dbt, or equivalents.
* Deep working knowledge of modern data platforms (Databricks, Snowflake, BigQuery, or similar), including Unity Catalog, Delta Lake, data modeling, query optimization, and performance tuning at scale.

title: Sr. Test Analyst
description:
**Job Summary**
 Serve as a senior test analyst specializing in MES validation and automation for hybrid work model projects ensuring high quality manufacturing execution solutions through rigorous functional integration and AI assisted testing. Apply expertise in Camstar MES platforms and multi layer integration to improve reliability reduce defects and support efficient supply chain operations while collaborating with diverse global teams.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Design and execute comprehensive test strategies for MES validation that align with project scope regulatory expectations and enterprise quality standards ensuring reliable delivery of manufacturing execution capabilities across hybrid work environments.
* Develop and maintain detailed automated test suites for MES applications using suitable frameworks focusing on regression coverage repeatability and rapid feedback to project teams to reduce release cycle times and production defects.
* Perform thorough manual functional and integration testing for MES features where automation is not yet feasible documenting clear test conditions reproducible steps and evidence to support release readiness decisions.
* Validate and test MES L4 L3 and L2 integration flows across enterprise planning systems shop floor control systems and field devices ensuring accurate data exchange timing and transaction integrity for manufacturing and supply chain scenarios.
* Configure and validate Camstar MES features workflows and business rules in test environments ensuring that process configurations meet user requirements while upholding data integrity and traceability standards for regulated manufacturing contexts.
* Utilize generative AI tools in a compliant manner to accelerate test design test data generation and defect analysis while applying critical judgment to review AI generated outputs for accuracy relevance and risk.
* Collaborate closely with business analysts developers MES engineers and operations stakeholders to clarify requirements define acceptance criteria and proactively identify risks or gaps that could impact manufacturing continuity or supply chain visibility.
* Analyze test results and production like data patterns to identify systemic defects performance bottlenecks and integration issues then work with technical teams to prioritize and verify fixes that provide measurable operational improvements.
* Create and maintain clear test documentation including test plans test cases traceability matrices and execution reports that support audits and provide transparent evidence of validation coverage for all MES components.
* Provide mentoring and practical guidance to other test professionals on MES validation techniques automated testing practices and integration testing patterns fostering a culture of quality ownership across the delivery team.
* Engage in defect triage sessions and change review activities presenting well reasoned impact analyses and retest strategies that balance quality risk with project timelines for day shift hybrid operations.
* Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives by identifying opportunities to enhance test automation frameworks test data management and environment stability thereby increasing efficiency across recurring MES validation cycles.
* Partner with manufacturing and supply chain stakeholders to understand process flows and key performance indicators ensuring that test scenarios reflect real operational conditions and help safeguard product quality and service reliability.


**Qualifications**
* Demonstrate extensive hands on experience in MES validation and automated testing with a proven track record of owning test design execution and reporting for complex enterprise scale implementations.
* Exhibit strong proficiency in manual MES validation activities including requirement analysis test case creation risk based prioritization and evidence collection suitable for regulated manufacturing environments.
* Show advanced skills in testing L4 L3 and L2 integration scenarios across planning manufacturing and shop floor systems with an ability to troubleshoot data flow discrepancies and interface failures effectively.
* Apply practical knowledge of generative AI in the context of software quality engineering using it to enhance test asset creation and analysis while maintaining strict review controls and compliance awareness.
* Demonstrate deep working knowledge of Camstar MES configuration object modeling and workflow behavior enabling precise validation of manufacturing processes and electronic records under varied operational conditions.
* Display solid understanding of manufacturing and supply chain business processes including work order management inventory tracking and quality events so that test coverage aligns with real world operational needs.
* Communicate findings and recommendations clearly in written and spoken form to cross functional teams enabling timely decisions on release readiness and risk mitigation in a hybrid day shift setting.
* Maintain strong analytical and problem solving capabilities supported by a methodical approach to root cause analysis that helps reduce recurring defects and enhances overall MES ecosystem stability.

title: Creative Technologist
description:
**About WPP Production**
 We are WPP Production \- the unified global production company that brings together all of WPP's content producers, studios and craft experts into one connected organisation.  A Creative Technologist at WPP Production operates at the intersection of creativity, technology, and generative AI to design and deliver AI\-powered creative solutions at scale. The role collaborates with creative, production, technology, and strategy teams to develop intelligent workflows that combine multimodal AI, automation, and human creativity to produce high\-quality marketing content across digital channels.

* Partner with technical teams to build, test, and improve AI\-driven production pipelines and automation workflows.
* Prototype and evaluate emerging AI tools, models, and technologies to enhance creative production capabilities.
* Ensure AI\-generated content aligns with brand guidelines, creative quality standards, and campaign objectives.
* Support the development of reusable prompt libraries, templates, workflows, and best practices for scalable content production.
* Work closely with cross\-functional teams to integrate AI capabilities into existing creative and production processes.
* Present AI\-powered creative solutions, demonstrations, and recommendations to internal stakeholders and clients.
* Identify opportunities to improve production efficiency through automation, workflow optimization, and AI innovation.
* Stay up to date with advancements in Generative AI, multimodal models, creative technologies, and industry trends.


**Requirements**
* 3\+ years of experience in Creative Technology, Digital Production, Creative Development, Design Technology, Innovation, or a related field.
* Strong understanding of Generative AI technologies, prompt engineering, and multimodal content generation (image, video, text, and audio).
* Experience working with AI creative tools such as Midjourney, Adobe Firefly, Runway, Flux, Stable Diffusion, OpenAI, Google Veo, Kling, or similar platforms.

 At WPP Production, you’ll help shape the future of content production at a truly global scale. You’ll work in a collaborative, borderless environment where craft excellence is valued, innovation is encouraged, and AI and next\-generation tools are used to amplify not replace human creativity. With access to diverse projects, global career opportunities, and the backing of WPP’s unmatched network, this is a place where you can grow your skills, make real impact, and create work that performs for every audience, across every channel, at every moment.

 WPP is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics.
