The role also involves learning and applying relevant standards and guidelines, participating in project meetings, and assisting in monitoring project progress and quality. The position offers structured training, mentoring, and exposure to multidisciplinary building projects across various sectors.

* Candidates should possess solid Analytical Skills to interpret technical data, perform basic calculations, and support engineering assessments.
* Candidates should possess foundational Mechanical Engineering or Manufacturing Engineering knowledge, preferably with exposure to building services or related disciplines.

title: Head of Fundraising
description:
**Head of Fundraising \& Investor Relations, South – Chennai** 




 Vantrock Investment Managers LLP
 



**Vantrock is a multi\-product real assets platform. Not a warehousing fund.** 
 Logistics and industrial is the first strategy. Office, plotted sales, land, pre\-leased and yielding assets, private credit, data centres and senior living follow behind it. This seat builds the distribution network for all of it in Chennai, Coimbatore, Kochi and the Tamil Nadu and Kerala markets.
 



**THE SEAT** 




**Employer:** 
 Vantrock Investment Managers LLP, the investment manager within Vantrock Ventures
 



**Reports to:** 
 Chief Business Officer, Fundraising and Investor Relations. Until that seat is filled, directly to the Founder \& CEO, who will build the franchise with the zonal team hands\-on
 



**Direct reports:** 
 None at launch. A senior single\-contributor seat with a very large number attached
 



**Location:** 
 Chennai, in office, with twelve to fifteen travel days a month across Chennai, Coimbatore, Kochi and the wider Tamil Nadu and Kerala markets
 



**Experience:** 
 10 to 16 years
 



 Team structure, reporting lines, seat titles and hiring entity reflect the current plan and may change. Compensation is confirmed in the offer.
 



**ABOUT THE COMPANY** 




 Vantrock is an operator\-led real assets platform, and it is multi\-product by design. Real assets only. Warehousing and industrial parks are
 **the first strategy, not the platform** 
 , across the full chain: first mile, last mile, city\-centre, dark\-store and self\-storage formats, and logistics\-anchored mixed\-use with distribution below and office above.
 



 Behind that first strategy sits the rest of the platform, launched in sequence and only as each is delivered: industrial plots; suburban campuses, GCC and back\-office space, where our expertise transfers directly; strata offices; and, in parallel, data centres and senior living. Each is a strategy in its own right, with its own pipeline and its own distributor relationships behind it.
 **A candidate who reads this as a warehousing platform has read the first line and stopped.** 




 Three parts, kept separate. The founder's balance sheet takes the first risk: land is acquired, de\-risked and approved on his capital before any investor commits. Vantrock Real Assets Private Limited develops and operates; Vantrock Investment Managers LLP underwrites every asset independently and answers to an independent Investment Committee. Assets enter at cost, with no founder premium. The platform earns only after its investors have.
 



 Founded by
 **Anshul Singhal, Founder \& CEO** 
 . Three institutional platforms built from zero, and the fourth now on his own capital. Across that career: India's largest industrial real estate exit, Rs 5,250 Cr to Blackstone; a fund platform taken from zero to about USD 1\.4 billion in peak AUM in six years, two SEBI Category II funds run to a successful close, Rs 2,775 Cr from roughly 1,000 investors through the channel, on India's first domestic warehousing AIF; 52 million sq ft delivered, 32 million as developer and 20 million as contractor; 2,000\+ acres acquired, all litigation\-free; 200\+ buildings. Delivered across the founder's three prior platforms.
 



**Warehousing is where the founder is best known. It is not where this platform stops.** 
 That record is the anchor that opens the door in the channel. The mandate you would be selling is considerably wider than it.
 



 We hire number twos who want to become number one.
 



**THE PRODUCT SET YOU WOULD BE SELLING** 




 This is the part most candidates get wrong. You would not be carrying one product into the channel. You would be building a channel that carries a succession of products across real assets. The proposed set, built out in sequence as each is delivered and as approvals are obtained:
 



 – Industrial parks, logistics and warehousing
 



 – Office: suburban campuses, GCC and back\-office space, starter and strata office
 



 – Plotted and industrial plot sales
 



 – Pre\-leased and yielding assets
 



 – A land strategy
 



 – Private credit
 



 – Data centres and senior living
 



 – In time, listed or pooled vehicle formats including InvIT and REIT structures
 



**Multiple product lines, one channel.** 
 That is why this is a franchise\-building job rather than a product\-selling job. An RM you certify on the first strategy sells the second, third and fourth without being recruited again.
 



 The intended route is a seeded AIF alongside deal\-by\-deal co\-investment through CIV, co\-investment PMS and other structures, subject to approvals. Seeded is the point: the operator puts assets in place before a fund launches, so much of the pipeline is de\-risked on day one and no blind pool is raised. Two sales in one: a fund commitment into a visible pipeline, and larger co\-investment tickets into named assets.
 



**WHY THIS ROLE EXISTS** 




**Own the zone.** 
 Build the distribution and IFA network across Chennai, Coimbatore, Kochi and the wider Tamil Nadu and Kerala markets. Activate the RMs and advisers inside it, and convert that network into committed capital for the first strategy and into a channel that is ready when the office, plotted, land, credit and yielding strategies arrive behind it.
 



**Not a cold start.** 
 The platform brings an existing investor base, anchor commitments in place, and a founder known in the channel from two prior funds. The channel will take the meeting. What does not yet exist is the franchise: the empanelments, the certified RMs, the joint calls. There is no team to delegate that to in Year 1\. Seniority here means credibility and judgment, not a desk.
 



**WHAT YOU WILL OWN** 




 – The network. National distributors' regional offices, regional distributors, IFAs and MFDs, DSAs, RIAs, multi\-family offices and wealth\-platform desks. Target 5 to 7 firms empanelled and live.
 



 – The full empanelment cycle, locally. First meeting to product committee to go\-live, for both the fund and the co\-investment routes. Empanel the platform, not a single product, so the next strategy does not start the cycle again.
 



 – Activation. Branch meetings, huddles and desk conversations until 35 to 50 RMs and IFAs have each placed at least one ticket.
 



 – Conversion. Joint client meetings as the core of the job. The pipeline from interest through contribution agreement to funds received.
 



 – The map, in the CRM, weekly. Investor relations in the zone after the close, with Fund Operations. The face of Vantrock in Chennai and Kerala.
 



**THIS IS A FRONT\-FACING SEAT** 




 You do not sell to the distributors and stop. You sell with them. Accompany partners and their RMs to their clients and pitch yourself. Tell the story so an RM can repeat it under pressure. Host investor evenings, partner meets and site visits, speak where the channel meets the asset class, and be a named voice of the platform on LinkedIn.
 



**Approved material only. Nothing bespoke, nothing verbal\-only, no return promises, ever.** 




**WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR** 




**Essential** 




 – 10 to 16 years in financial services, at least five in B2B or B2B2C distribution of PMS, AIF or mutual\-fund products from the manufacturer's side, an AMC, alternatives manager or fund house. You have carried a distribution number and been paid against it.
 



 – Verifiable relationships with distributor product heads, national and regional distributors and the top IFA and MFD firms in Tamil Nadu and Kerala. You can name them, and they will take your call.
 



 – You have launched a product into the channel from scratch at least once, not only carried an established brand.
 



 – Third\-party capital raised through the channel, stated as capital drawn, not assets influenced.
 



 – Graduate. MBA, PGDM, CA or CFA or equivalent. NISM as applicable.
 



 – Appetite for the road. Twelve to fifteen travel days a month is the job, not an exception to it.
 



**Advantageous** 




 – A real assets fund background. Not mandatory: a strong alternatives channel salesperson from equity, credit or PMS is often the superior hire, because channel sales is harder to teach than an asset class.
 



 – Experience carrying more than one product line into the same channel. This platform will ask you to do it repeatedly.
 



 – An AMC alternates or PMS desk. Co\-investment tickets sold alongside a fund. Standing in the Chennai and Kerala markets, which are conservative, referral\-driven and reward patience over pressure.
 



**COMPENSATION AND WEALTH CREATION** 




 Benchmarked against the upper quartile, then deliberately weighted from take\-home to wealth creation. Four parts, offered as a mix: fixed; a fundraising incentive on the capital you personally bring in, with a team component on the platform's total raise; a share in the platform's additional returns on strategies you help close; and ESOPs. Numbers in the first conversation.
 



**Prepared for recruitment only. Not an offer of, or invitation to invest in, any fund, scheme, security or interest, and not marketing of any investment product. The product lines, structures and routes described are proposed and indicative, subject to change and to all necessary SEBI and other regulatory approvals. The track record above relates to the founder's prior roles at other organisations, is not the track record of Vantrock, and is not indicative of future results. No return is stated or implied, and none may be quoted in connection with this search.** 




 9,112 plain, about 9,840 with formatting. That closes the set: CBO, North, East, West, South Bengaluru, South Chennai.
 



 Two things now stale against these six postings and not mine to edit: SEAT\_ROSTER still carries the old titles and one South seat, and the parent seat's internal name is now Chief Business Officer rather than Head. Flagging both for the roster.

title: Machine Operator
description:
**Company Description** 
 Topaaz Industries is a leading manufacturer of coated roll\-formed building products, including roofing and cladding profiles, purlins and grits, decking, puff panels, standing seam roofs, and accessories. The company specializes in complete solutions for pre\-engineered metal buildings and roofing systems, tailored to meet diverse client needs. Its state\-of\-the\-art manufacturing facility in Chennai, India is equipped with advanced machinery and has a capacity of 20,000 MT per annum. Topaaz Industries offers a comprehensive range of high\-quality products and accessories such as gutters, down take pipes, louvers, ridges, turbo ventilators, and polycarbonate sheets. The organization is recognized for delivering quality, reliable service, and timely project completion, earning the trust of clients through successful roofing and wall cladding projects for landmark buildings.
   

**Role Description** 
 This full\-time Machine Operator role is a hybrid position based in Chennai, with some work\-from\-home flexibility as appropriate to operational needs. The Machine Operator will set up, operate, and monitor production machinery used for manufacturing roofing, cladding, and related building products, ensuring smooth and safe operation throughout each shift. Daily responsibilities include performing routine checks on equipment, handling materials and hand tools, following production schedules, and maintaining accurate records of output and any issues encountered. The role also involves conducting basic quality checks on finished products, reporting defects, and collaborating with supervisors and team members to maintain production targets and adherence to safety standards. The Machine Operator is expected to follow all company policies, comply with health and safety guidelines, and support continuous improvement in manufacturing processes.
   

**Qualifications**
* Candidates should possess strong skills in Machine Operation and working with industrial Machinery in a manufacturing environment.
* Candidates should possess skills in Quality Control, including inspecting products, identifying defects, and following quality standards.
* Candidates should possess skills in using Hand Tools safely and effectively for setup, adjustments, and minor maintenance tasks.
* Candidates should possess clear Communication skills for coordinating with supervisors, team members, and maintenance staff.
* Basic mechanical aptitude and the ability to read and follow work instructions, safety procedures, and production documentation.
* Experience in metal building products or roofing systems manufacturing is an advantage.
* Ability to work in a hybrid setup in Chennai, including standing for extended periods and handling materials within safety limits.
* High school diploma, technical certificate, or equivalent practical experience in industrial or mechanical fields is preferred.

* Certifications: Relevant certifications preferred (e.g., CompTIA Security\+, CySA\+, CEH, GSEC, CISSP, or vendor certifications in Azure/AWS/CrowdStrike/Palo Alto).

**Experience \& Educational Requirement**
 BE/B\-Tech or equivalent with Computer Science or Electronics \& Communication

* Strong understanding of Industry security standards like ISO 27001, PCI\-DSS, SOC\-1\&2

title: Strategic Insights Analyst
description:
At Quantcast, we don't just build advertising technology, we revolutionize how it works. Our AI\-powered Demand Side Platform (DSP) connects the world's most ambitious marketers with their ideal audiences across the open internet, delivering results that actually move the needle. Since 2006, we've been the industry's trailblazer, launching the first AI\-powered measurement platform for publishers and the first AI\-driven DSP. Our AI doesn't just optimize—it delivers the measurable outcomes that matter most to our clients, giving them the competitive edge they need in a crowded marketplace. Ready to join the team that's defining the future of digital advertising?
   

  

 The Insights team is looking for a
 **Strategic Insights Analyst** 
 to serve as a trusted partner to our sales leadership and clients. In this role, you will act like an owner, move with velocity through change, and find innovative, strategic ways to deliver extraordinary outcomes. You will leverage data to build trusted relationships with customers, uncovering their business needs and translating complex datasets into powerful, story\-driven solutions. You will work alongside sellers, help shape the future of advertising in the AI era, and make a real impact on our global brand and agency partners.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Data\-Driven Storytelling: Uncover first\-party (1PD) and third\-party (3PD) consumer, industry, and market insights. Distill complex datasets into key executive learnings to create high\-impact sales narratives, pitches, and custom client collaterals.
* Commercial Alignment \& Pushback Handling: Map insights directly to core digital media metrics (CPM, CTR, CPA, ROAS, Incremental Lift, Post\-Campaign Attribution, Reach \& Frequency). Address and counter common customer pushbacks using authoritative data points.
* Go\-To\-Market (GTM) Pitching: Empower sales teams by identifying key growth opportunities and aligning Quantcast’s AI solutions with client business objectives. Develop thought leadership strategy for focus verticals.
* Scalable Analytics \& Tooling: Design scalable insights solutions including dashboards, automated reports, and AI insight agents. Query large\-scale datasets using SQL, Snowflake, or BigQuery, and present visualization outputs via Tableau, Sigma, Looker, Python, or R.
* Stakeholder Partnership: Partner cross\-functionally with sales, product, and solutions teams to deliver C\-level presentations and build Quantcast’s regional Point\-of\-View.


**Who You Are**
* Education: Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* Experience: 8\+ years of experience in advertising sales, marketing, consulting, media agencies, or DSPs.
* Customer Collateral Creation: 8\+ years of experience crafting customer\-facing materials (e.g., pitches, narratives, one\-sheets, or C\-level presentations) for sales enablement.
* Insights \& Measurement Expertise: 8\+ years of experience in consumer/market insights, media measurement
* Technical Skills: Hands\-on experience with SQL and data querying (Snowflake, BigQuery), as well as data visualization tools (Tableau, Looker, Python, or R).
* Domain Fluency: Full fluency in digital performance metrics (CPM, CTR, CPA, ROAS, Incremental Lift, Attribution, Reach \& Frequency) and familiar with key digital advertising verticals.
* Core Competencies: Exceptional presentation and storytelling skills, strong critical thinking, ability to navigate ambiguity, and a track record of driving standardized, scalable processes in a fast\-paced environment.
* Language Skills: Ability to communicate fluently in English and engage effectively with stakeholders is desirable.


 At Quantcast, we craft offers that reflect your unique skills, expertise, and geographic location. On top of a competitive salary, this position includes a performance bonus, equity, and a comprehensive benefits package. For more details, visit our Careers Page and see how we support our team. We are headquartered in San Francisco with offices around the world. Quantcast is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Please see the Applicant Privacy Notice for details on our applicant privacy policy. Join the team that unlocks potential.

**Job Description**
**Product Analyst, Lynks / Integration Catalog**
**Role Summary**
 The Product Analyst, Lynks / Integration Catalog will support the growth and operational execution of LynkUp, UPS Digital’s integration platform for connecting UPS capabilities, third\-party systems, and partner/customer platforms into reusable solution components.
   

  

 Within LynkUp, a “Lynk” is a reusable integration or endpoint that can be used across UPS Digital solutions. These Lynks may include third\-party carrier integrations, ERP / OMS / WMS / TMS system integrations, partner platform connections, or UPS product “action” endpoints such as Delivery Intercept, InsureShield, or other capabilities that can be assembled into customer solutions.
   

  

 This role will help move Lynks from idea to usable catalog capability. The analyst will support intake, discovery, requirements, external coordination, testing, UAT, roadmap tracking, and business enablement. This is an individual contributor role, but it requires strong project management, follow\-through, and comfort coordinating across UPS product teams, engineering teams, commercial sponsors, customers, carriers, and external technology contacts.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Manage intake for new Lynk / integration requests from product, commercial, customer, carrier, partner, and internal solution sponsors.
* Support discovery to clarify the business problem, customer use case, integration need, expected value, technical dependency, and adoption path.
* Help determine whether a requested integration should become a reusable Lynk in the catalog versus a one\-off customer or solution\-specific integration.
* Identify and coordinate with the right external contacts at carriers, customers, technology platforms, or partner organizations to obtain credentials, technical documentation, sandbox access, test data, and other integration inputs.
* Coordinate integration delivery activities across UPS product, engineering, architecture, commercial, customer, and third\-party teams.
* Translate business and integration needs into clear requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, testing needs, and handoff materials for engineering.
* Support integration testing and UAT, including defining test scenarios, coordinating test execution, tracking defects, validating expected outcomes, and confirming readiness for business use.
* Maintain the Lynks roadmap, integration inventory, ownership, status, dependencies, documentation, and availability.
* Support prioritization of Lynks across carrier integrations, ERP / OMS / WMS / TMS systems, marketplaces, partner platforms, and UPS internal action endpoints.
* Communicate newly available Lynks to product, sales, solutions, and business stakeholders, including what the Lynk does, why it matters, where it can be used, and how teams should engage.
* Follow up with commercial or product sponsors after launch to confirm the Lynk is being used, identify blockers to adoption, and capture feedback for future roadmap needs.
* Help create repeatable processes for Lynk intake, prioritization, credential coordination, testing, launch readiness, inventory updates, and business communication.


**Preferred Experience And Skills**
* 4\+ years in product analysis, business analysis, systems analysis, integrations, implementation delivery, product operations, or technology project coordination.
* 5–7 years preferred.
* Experience supporting APIs, third\-party integrations, customer implementations, technology delivery, platform products, SaaS solutions, or logistics systems preferred.
* Experience coordinating with external customers, vendors, carriers, platforms, or technology partners preferred.
* Strong project management skills, including issue tracking, dependency management, follow\-up, documentation, and cross\-functional coordination.
* Ability to translate ambiguous business needs into clear requirements and delivery\-ready work.
* Comfort supporting testing, UAT, defect resolution, and launch readiness.
* Strong communication skills and ability to explain technical capabilities in business terms.


**Employee Type**
 Permanent
   

  

 UPS is committed to providing a workplace free of discrimination, harassment, and retaliation.

 We are building a high\-performance Revenue \& Marketing pod — a geography\-focused business unit that owns end\-to\-end top\-line and bottom\-line delivery for an assigned state or cluster. The pod operates like an autonomous business unit: defining local strategy, executing marketing and growth plans, running platform operations, and generating the consumer insights that drive every commercial decision.
   

  

 This is not a support function. Every person in this pod owns outcomes — revenue, margin, platform health, or market intelligence. If you are commercially driven, data\-fluent, and thrive in a fast\-moving execution environment, this team is built for you.
   

  

**What You Will Do**

* Own and deliver revenue and gross margin targets for an assigned geography or function within the pod
* Track P\&L on a weekly and monthly basis — identify gaps early and course\-correct with data
* Drive revenue growth through a mix of new user acquisition, base reactivation, and improved margin per transaction
* Identify and unlock new revenue opportunities — brand partnerships, channel monetisation, and promotional levers
* Marketing, Growth \& Campaigns
* Plan and execute user acquisition campaigns to drive installs and first\-order conversions at efficient CAC
* Own reactivation marketing for lapsed and install\-not\-transacted user cohorts
* Design and run CRM, push notification, and in\-app messaging campaigns to improve repeat purchase frequency
* Execute on\-app promotions, deal constructs, offer panels, and sale events — end\-to\-end, accurately and on time
* Build and manage hyperlocal BTL activation plans tied to regional events, festivals, and seasonal demand peaks
* Promote high\-margin SKUs and categories to improve the overall GM profile of the geography
* Market Intelligence \& Consumer Insights
* Build and maintain a revenue intelligence framework covering consumer spending patterns, competitive pricing, and category growth
* Lead quantitative research: cohort analysis, pricing elasticity studies, and transactional data mining
* Conduct qualitative research: consumer focus groups, in\-depth interviews, and retailer feedback sessions
* Produce competitive intelligence reports — share of wallet, competitor activity, and whitespace opportunities
* Generate data\-backed demand signals for new SKUs and assortment decisions
* Platform Health \& Fulfilment
* Own platform revenue health KPIs: availability rate, catalogue fill, listing quality, order completion, and RTO
* Identify and plug revenue leakage — stock\-outs during campaign periods, broken listings, and fulfilment failures
* Coordinate with Supply Chain and Inventory teams to ensure stock availability ahead of activations
* Escalate platform issues — broken listings, payment failures, checkout drop\-offs — with revenue\-impact quantification
* Own fulfilment SLAs; work with logistics partners to reduce TAT, RTO, and delivery failures
* Analytics \& Reporting
* Maintain a real\-time revenue dashboard and weekly health scorecard accessible to the entire pod

* Report on key metrics: installs, CAC, reactivation rate, traffic, GM impact, and channel revenue contribution

* Data fluency: comfortable with Excel, SQL, BI tools (Tableau, Looker, or equivalent), and building dashboards or revenue models
* Experience working cross\-functionally across Brand, Supply Chain, Product, and Marketing teams

title: Manager - Ecommerce transformation
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**Consulting \- Manager \- Ecommerce Transformation**
 At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
   

  

 We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
   

  

 Join EY and help to build a better working world.
   

  

**About Global Delivery Services**
 Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
   

  

 Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000\+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
   

  

 Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy \& Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high\-quality, value\-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
   

  

 Enablement Services provides cost\-effective, high\-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
   

  

 Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 The Manager \- Ecommerce Transformation will drive ecommerce transformation initiatives within the Customer practice, combining digital commerce strategy, customer experience improvement, operating model design, and delivery excellence. The role will support clients in improving online growth, commerce operations, product discovery, conversion, order experience, and omnichannel effectiveness. You will work with business and technology stakeholders to shape commerce roadmaps, design scalable operating models, and implement transformation initiatives that improve revenue realization, digital adoption, customer experience, and operational efficiency.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Business Development \& Market Leadership
+ Support ecommerce transformation pipeline development across advisory, implementation, and managed transformation opportunities.
+ Contribute to proposals, RFP responses, business cases, demos, and executive presentations focused on digital commerce growth and operational improvement.
+ Support GTM strategies for ecommerce transformation offerings across B2B, B2C, and marketplace\-led business models.
+ Design and refine commerce transformation offerings aligned with client priorities, including digital channel growth, product data improvement, checkout optimization, and omnichannel enablement.
+ Contribute to thought leadership, client workshops, and points of view on ecommerce trends, digital buying behaviour, platform modernization, and commerce operating model evolution.


* Client Engagement \& Delivery
+ Lead ecommerce transformation workstreams from current\-state assessment through strategy, roadmap design, implementation planning, and execution support.
+ Assess commerce journeys, digital storefronts, product information flows, merchandising processes, search and navigation, order management touchpoints, and performance metrics to identify improvement opportunities.
+ Design ecommerce operating models, governance structures, product data processes, merchandising workflows, channel strategies, and performance management frameworks.
+ Support initiatives across product discovery, catalog readiness, personalization, pricing and promotions, cart and checkout, order visibility, returns experience, and customer support integration.
+ Partner with product, technology, data, marketing, sales, and operations teams to translate commerce priorities into structured requirements, process flows, user stories, and delivery roadmaps.
+ Develop business cases and benefits models to quantify conversion improvement, revenue uplift, digital adoption, cost\-to\-serve reduction, and operational productivity gains.
+ Ensure delivery excellence across assigned workstreams, including scope, timeline, budget, risks, dependencies, and stakeholder alignment.
+ Support change management, adoption, and governance activities to embed sustainable commerce capabilities across business teams.


* Technology \& Innovation
+ Enable teams to leverage ecommerce platforms, product information management systems, order management systems, CRM, analytics, personalization tools, automation, and AI\-enabled insights.
+ Stay ahead of technology trends shaping ecommerce transformation, including composable commerce, headless architecture, AI\-enabled product discovery, personalization, digital shelf analytics, and omnichannel orchestration.
+ Identify opportunities to develop reusable accelerators for commerce journey assessment, product data maturity, conversion diagnostics, and benefits tracking.


* Leadership \& People Development
+ Manage project teams or workstreams and ensure high\-quality delivery across ecommerce transformation engagements.
+ Mentor consultants and analysts on ecommerce strategy, requirements structuring, delivery governance, and cross\-functional stakeholder management.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
**Ideally, you’ll also**
* Demonstrate knowledge of digital commerce capabilities, including B2B and B2C commerce, marketplace models, dealer and distributor portals, and subscription commerce.
* Have exposure to leading commerce platforms and ecosystems, including Salesforce Commerce Cloud, Adobe Commerce, Shopify, SAP Commerce Cloud, commerce tools, BigCommerce, Akeneo, Salsify, and similar technologies.


**What We Look For**
* 8\+ years of experience in ecommerce transformation, digital commerce, omnichannel strategy, customer experience, product data transformation, or commerce operations.
* Consulting experience is desired.
* Proven experience supporting or leading ecommerce transformation programs, digital channel improvement initiatives, or commerce operating model redesign.
* Strong understanding of ecommerce journeys, digital merchandising, product information management, order experience, conversion optimization, and commerce performance metrics.
* Hands\-on experience with ecommerce platforms, analytics tools, PIM, OMS, CRM, or related digital commerce technologies.
* Strong business development support, stakeholder management, communication, and project delivery skills.


**What We Offer You**
 At EY, we’ll develop you with future\-focused skills and equip you with world\-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
   

  

 Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
   

  

 To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability\-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
   

  

**Our Commitment:** 
 As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
   

  

 Professional Development: From entry\-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
   

  

**People and Culture:** 
 In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
   

  

**Benefits:** 
 Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting\-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
   

  

**How to Apply:** 
 If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user\-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.
   

  

 Successful candidates advance to a competency\-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.
   

  

 “We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity \& Inclusion”.
   

  

**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

description:
**ASSA ABLOY** 
 is a global leader in access solutions, dedicated to shaping the future of security and convenience. With a rich heritage spanning over 150 years, ASSA ABLOY has built a reputation for delivering innovative and reliable locking and access control solutions. Their diverse portfolio includes well\-known brands like Yale, HID Global, and Mul\-T\-Lock, offering a comprehensive range of products and services to meet the unique needs of customers worldwide. From residential and commercial buildings to critical infrastructure and healthcare facilities, ASSA ABLOY's cutting\-edge technologies ensure safety, security, and seamless user experiences. With a commitment to sustainability and customer satisfaction, ASSA ABLOY continues to drive advancements in access solutions for a safer and more connected world.
   

  

**Summary** 
 : We are seeking a highly experienced
 **Senior IBM i Administrator** 
 to manage and maintain our IBM i (AS/400, iSeries) systems. The ideal candidate will be proficient in day\-to\-day operations, monitoring, and performance tuning, with a strong secondary focus on
 **IBM i security hardening** 
 , compliance, and best practices.
   

  

 You will work as a key member of our IT infrastructure team to ensure system availability, reliability, and security in a mission\-critical environment.
   

  

**Summary Of Responsibilities**
**System Operations**
* Monitor and manage the health, performance, and availability of IBM i systems.
* Execute and maintain backup, recovery, and disaster recovery procedures.
* Perform IPLs, system saves, PTF installations, and license key updates.
* Schedule, monitor, and troubleshoot batch jobs and job queues.
* Perform daily system checks and log reviews to ensure optimal operation.
* Collaborate with application teams to troubleshoot issues and optimize system usage.


**Security \& Hardening**
* Conduct IBM i security audits and implement corrective actions to address vulnerabilities.
* Harden system security by configuring object\-level and user profile security, exit programs, authority collections, and audit journaling.
* Implement and maintain security policies in line with industry standards (e.g., NIST, CIS) and compliance frameworks (e.g., SOX, HIPAA, PCI).
* Manage and monitor security logs (QAUDJRN) and intrusion detection/prevention settings.
* Work with internal auditors or external consultants to ensure compliance with internal and external security requirements.
* Review and improve user access controls, password policies, and role\-based authority.


**Qualifications**
 To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
   

  

**EDUCATION:**
 Preferred undergraduate degree in computer science, information systems or related field and/or equivalent work experience.
   

  

**EXPERIENCE:**
 A Minimum of 5 years related experience in a business production environment.
   

  

**Required**
**TECHNICAL KNOWLEDGE and/or ABILITIES**
* 5\+ years of hands\-on experience with IBM i operations and administration.
* Strong working knowledge of IBM i command line and system tools (e.g., WRKACTJOB, WRKSYSSTS, WRKDSKSTS).
* Experience with IBM i security features: user profile management, object authority, exit points, and audit journal.
* Proficiency in backup and recovery techniques using BRMS or equivalent.
* Experience with security auditing tools such as PowerTech, HelpSystems, or native IBM i tools.
* Excellent problem\-solving, documentation, and communication skills.


**Preferred**
* Experience implementing IBM i security best practices and frameworks.
* Familiarity with RPG\-based application environments.
* Understanding of TCP/IP networking and communication protocols on IBM i.
* IBM i certification (e.g., IBM Certified System Administrator \- IBM i) is a plus.
* Experience with high availability (HA) technologies and logical partitioning (LPAR).


**Soft Skills**
* Strong analytical thinking and attention to detail.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a team environment.
* Ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities in a fast\-paced environment.
* Commitment to continuous learning and staying current with IBM i platform developments


**We are the ASSA ABLOY Group**
 Our people have made us the global leader in access solutions. In return, we open doors for them wherever they go. With nearly 63,000 colleagues in more than 70 different countries, we help billions of people experience a more open world. Our innovations make all sorts of spaces – physical and virtual – safer, more secure, and easier to access.

**Job Description**
 As a Powder Coating Booth Operator, you will manage end\-to\-end powder coating booth operations while ensuring that you achieve safety, quality, productivity, and continuous improvement standards.

**Your Responsibilities**
* Take complete ownership of Powder Coating Booth operations, including workplace organisation through 5S implementation and housekeeping activities.

* Perform quality inspections and testing including DFT (Dry Film Thickness), Impact Test, Scratch Test, Bend Test, and Gloss Level Test while maintaining production and maintenance records.
* Ensure compliance with safety procedures, PPE requirements, chemical handling regulations, continuous improvement programmes, and training of co\-associates to support operational excellence.


**The Essentials – You Will Have**
* ITI, Diploma, or equivalent technical qualification.
* 2 years and Maximum 5 years of experience in Powder Coating Booth Operations within a manufacturing environment.
* Experience operating Electrostatic Powder Coating Guns and Pretreatment (PT) Lines.
* Knowledge of powder coating processes, coating quality standards, and process control parameters.
* Experience performing coating quality inspections including DFT, Impact, Scratch, Gloss, and Bend Tests.
* Understanding of chemical handling, workplace safety standards, PPE compliance, and preventive maintenance practices.
* Flexible to work in shifts.


**The Preferred – You Might Also Have**
* Experience in Automotive, Electronics, Electrical, Heavy Engineering, or Industrial Manufacturing environments.
* Experience maintaining production checklists, maintenance records, rejection reports, and rework reports.
* Knowledge of Kaizen, Continuous Improvement, Lean Manufacturing, and 5S methodologies.
* Experience in powder recovery systems, recycled powder management, and wastage reduction programmes.
* Experience mentoring operators or production associates.

* Comprehensive mindfulness programmes with a premium membership to Calm.

* Employee Assistance Program.
* Personalised wellbeing programs through our OnTrack programme.
* On\-demand digital course library for professional development.
* and other local benefits!

You may be just the right person for this or other roles.*

**Job Summary**
 Serve as a specialist in health care claims processing for Medicare and Medicaid claims and commercial claims within a remote work from home environment focusing on accurate adjudication compliance with health care product guidelines and timely resolution of member and provider claim inquiries during night shift operations while communicating effectively in English to support business quality and service goals.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Review health care product claim submissions for Medicare and Medicaid and commercial programs to ensure accurate data capture and alignment with policy and benefit rules minimizing errors and rework to support operational efficiency and member satisfaction.
* Analyze claim details and supporting documentation to validate eligibility coverage and pricing logic and to identify discrepancies or potential issues that could negatively impact members providers or company financial outcomes.
* Process assigned claims queues within established service levels by applying adjudication rules and regulatory requirements ensuring that each claim outcome supports organizational quality standards and customer commitments.
* Collaborate with internal operations and configuration teams through clear written and spoken English communication to resolve claim processing issues share insights on recurring defects and contribute to continuous improvement of health care product workflows.
* Investigate claim escalations from customer service or provider relations by reviewing transaction history and system notes then provide detailed resolutions that address root causes and enhance trust in company claims handling.
* Maintain up to date knowledge of Medicare and Medicaid regulations and commercial plan guidelines related to claims handling so that daily decisions remain compliant and reduce risk of audit findings or penalties.
* Utilize claims administration systems and reporting tools to track claim status identify aging or backlog trends and propose practical actions that help the team meet productivity and accuracy targets.
* Document all claim actions in the system with clear concise and complete notes to ensure transparency for downstream teams and support accurate reporting to business stakeholders.
* Coordinate with quality review teams when claim samples are audited by responding to findings explaining processing decisions and integrating feedback into future claim handling practices.
* Support night shift operations by managing workload independently escalating only complex or policy sensitive scenarios and ensuring continuous coverage that upholds service commitments in a work from home model.
* Contribute to knowledge sharing by updating procedure references and claim processing tips based on new health care product features or regulatory changes helping colleagues deliver consistent service and outcomes.
* Identify patterns in claim denials or adjustments across Medicare and Medicaid and commercial segments to recommend improvements in messaging configuration or provider education that reduce avoidable rework and member dissatisfaction.
* Engage in periodic training and calibration sessions to refine adjudication skills strengthen regulatory understanding and align individual performance with company objectives and societal impact through fair and accurate claims decisions.


**Qualifications**
* Demonstrate practical experience working with health care products and claim administration platforms for at least one year and not more than three years with a proven record of accurate and timely claims processing within a structured environment.
* Show strong domain expertise in Medicare and Medicaid claims by confidently interpreting benefit rules cost sharing structures and regulatory requirements involved in claim adjudication and resolution activities.
* Apply solid knowledge of commercial claims operations including plan variations network considerations and pricing approaches so that decisions consistently reflect product intent and contractual obligations.
* Communicate fluently in English in both written and spoken forms to collaborate effectively with peers supervisors and cross functional teams and to craft clear claim notes and responses that support transparency and service quality.
* Thrive in a work from home night shift setting by maintaining focus self discipline and reliable connectivity while meeting defined productivity quality and attendance expectations without direct physical supervision.
* Adapt quickly to changes in health care product features claim rules and system enhancements by engaging in ongoing learning and applying updated guidance accurately to daily claim processing tasks.


**Certifications Required**
 Preferred certification in health care claims or medical billing such as Certified Professional Coder or equivalent industry credential.

You will work with supplier representatives to ensure requirements are understood and implemented.

* On a small sized project, represents Bechtel as the supplier’s prime contact with respect to supplier quality and performs quality surveillance activities defined by the assignment scope to verify that supplier furnished equipment and material conforms to the technical and quality requirements of the procurement documents

* Reviews supplier generated quality verification documentation to verify conformance to procurement document requirements

* Releases conforming material for shipment and notifies other Bechtel functional organizations to assist in coordination of their activities
* Evaluates supplier’s conformance to specified quality criteria on a specific assignment or group of assignments to provide input to recommendations for placement of future orders
* Conducts surveys or audits or surveys of suppliers, when assigned

* Assists with the establishment of Quality Surveillance levels required for each purchase

* Investigate quality issues reported to the Supplier Quality Manager on equipment/materials where quality surveillance has been performed. Available documents such as UOS\&Ds, Field Change Notices, back charge notices, NCR \& Deviation Report registers, etc. should be utilized during the investigation process
* Review, edit, accept and distribute reports in accordance with this Manual and Project Procedures. Ensure survey and audit reports are approved and then posted into GSIS

title: What being a Care Buddy means at Prayojana?
description:
The Care Buddy will be the first point of contact and the face of the Prayojana. More importantly, they will participate in supporting their assigned members with the same level of empathy and warmth that the member's own children would have
   

  

**The Care Buddy’s Primary Role Will Be To**
* Check on the members assigned to her/him on their day to day well being
* Help out with errands – like bank\-related work, basic groceries or vegetable procurement
* Schedule appointments for doctor visits \& accompany them for such
* Schedule periodic lab visits as required
* Help members handle any technology\-related issues, like setting up Whatsapp, fixing internet issues, using social media (Facebook, Instagram), etc.
* Visit the member at least once in a week or as frequently as required, to check their needs \& help them accordingly
* Educate them on the process of emergency management, how to call, what to do etc.
* In case of an emergency
* report to the hospital \& co\-ordinate or facilitate the treatment
* keep all stakeholders informed on the status
* Update medical records in Prayojana Health App from time to time
* Monitor medicine inventory \& help in ordering refills
* Be a friend to the member, accompany them for walks once in a week
* Accompany them to social events, concerts as per requests
* Organize tickets for events like music concerts, movie, drama if needed
* Arrange \& co\-ordinate transportation needs for the members for them to go to such events/family functions


 A Care Buddy will be assigned a maximum of 10 members to assist at most simultaneously
   

  

**Who can be a Care Buddy?**
 Our Requirements
   

  

* Should be a person with a high level of integrity \& trustworthiness
* Should be independent \& willing to be available to take emergency calls 24x7
* Should demonstrate a high level of empathy \& patience, willing to listen, be polite, softspoken, punctual \& stick to commitments
* Be willing to go the extra mile to keep seniors happy, comfortable and without worry about how to manage their day\-to\-day life
* Should have experience using web and mobile\-based applications with basic computer and internet knowledge
* Should have a personal two\-wheeler (bike/scooter)


**Nice to have**
* Bachelor’s Degree in Social Work would be a big plus

**Job Description:**
 The Senior Controls Software Engineer is responsible for the design, development, implementation, and lifecycle management of software for industrial automation and control systems. This role involves developing PLC, HMI/SCADA, motion control, and industrial communication solutions while collaborating with cross\-functional teams throughout the complete project lifecycle—from concept and design through commissioning and customer support.

**Essential duties and responsibilities:**
* Design and develop machine control software for custom automation systems from concept through commissioning.
* Develop PLC, HMI/SCADA, motion control, safety, and industrial communication software.
* Configure and integrate servo drives, VFDs, robotics, vision systems, and field devices.
* Prepare Functional Design Specifications (FDS), I/O lists, software architecture, and technical documentation.
* Perform software testing, debugging, Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT), Site Acceptance Testing (SAT), commissioning, and customer support.
* Collaborate with Mechanical, Electrical, Manufacturing, and Project Engineering teams throughout the project lifecycle.
* Participate in the review of electrical designs, Bills of Materials (BOMs), and ensure compliance with customer specifications and applicable industry standards.
* Troubleshoot control systems and optimize machine performance.
* Participate in software code reviews and maintain software quality standards.
* Support continuous improvement initiatives, software standardization, and engineering best practices.
* Maintain project schedules and communicate technical progress to project stakeholders.


**Requirements \& Experience**
* Minimum 8\+ years of hands\-on experience in industrial automation, controls development, and machine commissioning.
* Experience designing and implementing control systems for custom automation projects.
* Strong knowledge of PLC programming, HMI/SCADA development, and motion control.
* Experience integrating servo systems, drives, motors, robotics, sensors, and vision systems.
* Strong knowledge of industrial communication protocols including:
* Profinet
* EtherCAT
* Ethernet/IP
* Modbus TCP
* OPC UA
* Experience with Safety PLCs and machine safety devices.
* Strong troubleshooting and commissioning skills.
* Experience with software version control and software lifecycle management.
* Ability to prepare technical documentation including:
* Functional Design Specifications
* Software Architecture
* I/O Lists

title: University Guidance and Career Counselling
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION
 



  





 University Guidance \& Career Counsellor – IBDP \& Cambridge A Level
 



 Designation: University Guidance \& Career Counsellor
 



 Reporting To: Head of School / Director
 



 Location: Chennai
 



  





 About the Role
 



 We are seeking an experienced University Guidance \& Career Counsellor to lead undergraduate university counselling for students pursuing IBDP and Cambridge A Level. The role will manage the complete student journey from career exploration and profile building to university selection, application, admission and enrolment, across India and international destinations.
 



  





 Key Responsibilities
 


* Provide individualised university and career counselling from Grade 6 onwards.
* Develop student profiles, career pathways and strategic university application plans.
* Guide students on university selection, including reach, match and safety choices.
* Manage end\-to\-end applications through UCAS, Common App, BridgeU and other international/Indian portals.
* Review and guide students on personal statements, essays, resumes, portfolios, interviews and entrance assessments.
* Advise on SAT, ACT, IELTS, TOEFL, scholarships, financial aid and university\-specific requirements.
* Maintain application timelines, documentation, predicted grades and recommendation requirements.
* Conduct student/parent counselling sessions, university admission workshops and career guidance programmes.
* Build relationships with universities and coordinate university visits, fairs and admission interactions.
* Maintain accurate application records and report on offers, admissions, scholarships and placement outcomes.



  





 Education \& Experience
 


* Master's degree in Education, Counselling, Psychology, Career Guidance or a related field.
* 5–6 years of experience in university counselling, college admissions or student placement.
* Mandatory experience with IBDP and/or Cambridge A Level, preferably in an international school.
* Proven success in undergraduate placements to top global universities, including Ivy League, Oxbridge, Russell Group and other highly selective institutions.
* Strong knowledge of Indian and international university admissions and application processes.
* Experience with UCAS, Common App and BridgeU is essential.
* Strong university network and demonstrated ability to manage multiple applications and deadlines.



  





 Preferred Institutional Background
 



 Preference will be given to candidates with relevant experience in reputed university counselling/college admissions organisations such as:
 



 Crimson Education India \| Athena Education \| Univariety \| Mindways \| Bon Avenir
 



 Candidates from comparable organisations with strong experience in student profile building, university strategy, application management and international admissions may also be considered.
 



  





 Key Competencies
 


* Excellent counselling, mentoring and communication skills.
* Strong knowledge of global higher education and admissions trends.
* Strategic thinking with strong attention to detail.
* Excellent stakeholder management and parent engagement skills.
* Ability to independently manage multiple students, applications and deadlines.
* High professional integrity and confidentiality.



  





 Key Performance Indicators
 


* Successful university placements and quality of offers.
* Admissions to highly selective/top\-ranked universities.
* Student and parent satisfaction.
* Timely and accurate application completion.
* Scholarships/financial aid secured.
* Effective university engagement and career guidance programmes.



  





 The ideal candidate will combine strong counselling expertise with proven international admissions experience and a demonstrated track record of achieving exceptional university outcomes for students.

This role aligns with industry titles such as ServiceNow Engineer, ServiceNow System Administrator, ServiceNow HRSD Administrator or HR Systems Administrator (ServiceNow)
 


  

  


**The Role:** 



  

  


 We are seeking a highly motivated and detail\-oriented ServiceNow System Administrator to join our team. This role involves a mix of administrative tasks, development of new functionalities, and collaboration with various business stakeholders to ensure the platform effectively supports our HR operations.
 


  

  


**Key Responsibilities:** 



  

  


 System Administration \& Maintenance:
 


  

  
* Facilitate and execute User Acceptance Testing (UAT) and Production Validation for biannual ServiceNow version updates.
  

  
* Perform testing of newly deployed functionalities to ensure they meet business requirements and are free of defects.
  

  
* Monitor and manage issues raised by HR Operations, working to resolve them in a timely manner.
  

  
* Coordinate with external teams to implement fixes and new features, such as coordinating with Service Management Platform for Automated Test Frameworks (ATF) to reduce manual testing.
  

  
* Maintain and update important company lists, such as the VIP list, by comparing data from different systems (e.g., Fusion Master Active Report and SNow User Profile Report).
  

  
* Manage the ownership and configuration of various ServiceNow assets, including Knowledge Management components such as User Criteria and HR Criteria setup, assignment groups, and key dashboards for HR Operations and Knowledge Management.
  

  
* This includes ensuring proper access control, content visibility, and alignment with organizational workflows and reporting needs.o Creation and maintenance of system\-related knowledge articleso Maintain historical files such as HR Taxonomy, List of HR Services, List of Users with cross country access etc.
  


  


**Development \& Implementation:** 



  

  
* Develop new functionalities for HR Operations to improve efficiency and user experience.
  

  
* Facilitate the rollout of new functionalities for HR, ensuring a smooth transition for users.
  

  
* Participate in regular ServiceNow development grooming calls to represent HR and discuss new stories.
  

  
* Assist with UAT and production validation for ongoing projects, such as the Onboarding, Lifecycle Events, and Offboarding projects within HRSD.
  


  


**Reporting \& Analytics:** 



  

  
* Create and distribute monthly reports, including the Monthly Content Hits Report and the Monthly HR Knowledge Base (KB) Feedback Report, to inform the Knowledge Management team of key metrics.
  

  
* Analyze and present data from the QnA Log to identify trends and areas for improvement.
  

  
* Update progress on various metrics for projects.
  


  


**Stakeholder Collaboration \& Communication:** 



  

  
* Attend and represent the team in various meetings, including the HRSD Monthly check\-in, Knowledge Management Forum, and myHelp Governance Board.
  

  
* Act as a point of contact for the GPC team regarding requests for ServiceNow checklists and HR case usage.
  

  
* Communicate with stakeholders including employees, HR agents, and senior leadership regarding the status of issues and projects. For example, keep the Knowledge Management team updated on the status of Hi\-Tickets or problem tickets related to reporting functionalities.
  


  


**About You:** 



  

  


 Required Skills \& Qualifications
 


  

  
* Proven 5\-years' experience as a ServiceNow Administrator, with specific experience in HR Service Delivery (HRSD) highly preferred.
  

  
* Strong understanding of ServiceNow modules, functionalities, and best practices.

description:
Join us as an Environment Analyst
   

  

* In this key role, you’ll support a set of environments used by a platform’s applications and assist as a point of contact for environment related activities
* We’ll look to you to assist Environment Managers in preparing a rolling environmental strategy which considers risks in relation to stability and resilience
* You’ll be joining a collaborative and supportive team, and have the opportunity to work with a range of stakeholders across the bank
* We're offering this role at senior analyst level


 What you'll do
   

  

 We’re looking for an Environment Analyst to enable the successful implementation of platform change and deliver customer value by assisting Environment Managers to deliver complex and critical environment related activities. You’ll help create stories and features for the domain backlog to enable a continual progression of changes and look for ways to improve efficiency, resilience, reliability, quality and manual inconsistency by increasing the use of automation and virtualisation.
   

  

**Your Responsibilities Will Also Include**
* Supporting Environment Managers in managing a set of non\-production environments and maintaining non\-production environment dashboards
* Understanding and maintaining a focus on customer value and providing a positive customer experience
* Working with Environment Managers to understand the upcoming flow of work and the customer vision in order to contribute to a fast response to environment related needs
* Understanding and communicating the environment status, health checks and status reports for the platform’s environments
* Working with a range of stakeholders across the bank and third\-party suppliers to make sure that platform environments are optimised


 The skills you'll need
   

  

 We’re looking for a capable communicator, with knowledge of scaled Agile and Prince 2 tools and methodologies spanning value stream, portfolio, platform and feature team levels. You’ll also need technical knowledge, including platform, technology, products and domains and experience in multiple languages or technical domains.
   

  

**We’ll Also Expect**
* Experience in supporting and maintaining non\-production environments and related dashboards
* Experience in monitoring environment health, performance, and availability, with the ability to proactively identify and resolve issues
* Expertise in delivering environment changes through collaboration with technology teams and stakeholders
* Expertise in process automation to improve efficiency and reliability
* Good collaboration and stakeholder management skills

title: Trainer - Transcription Review
description:
Role: Trainer — Transcription Review
   

 Location: Chennai, Tamil Nadu · Full\-time
   

 Reports to: Operations Manager
   

  

 About the role:
   

 We run an English\-language transcription\-review operation: reviewers listen to audio and correct machine\-generated text into clean, accurate, client ready transcripts — working on platforms and to quality standards similar to TranscribeMe.
   

 As Trainer, you own how quickly and how well new joiners reach production standard, and you build our team of Reviewers who correct and finalize transcripts to a client\-ready bar. You will design and run onboarding, coach on clean\-verbatim style and English grammar, calibrate the team to a single standard, and grow reviewer capability as we scale from a small pilot team to \~90 seats
   

  

 What you'll do:
   

 • Onboard new reviewers — deliver structured training on platform/tool navigation, clean\-verbatim style, speech tags (inaudible, crosstalk, etc.), speaker labelling, timestamps, and researching names and terms.
   

 • Own the curriculum — build and maintain the training material, house style guide, and a certification/assessment path; keep them current as client style guides change (US vs. Commonwealth English, file\-specific rules).
   

 • Coach English fundamentals — grammar, punctuation, spelling, and formatting to one consistent standard; run targeted refreshers on recurring error patterns.
   

 • Develop Senior / Lead Reviewers — identify strong performers and grow them into senior reviewer roles who can guide others and hold the quality bar as the team expands.
   

 • Run calibration — hold regular sessions so all reviewers correct the same file the same way; track and close inconsistencies between reviewers.
   

 • Own ramp\-quality metrics — time\-to\-productivity, accuracy / rejection rate, critical\-error rate, and rework rate; report progress against the hiring ramp.
   

 • Pick up new domains fast — absorb new subject areas and client accounts and turn them into training material quickly (e.g., US legal transcription conventions where required).
   

  

 Must have:
   

 • Excellent command of English — near\-native grammar, punctuation, and spelling (US and Commonwealth), with strong reading comprehension and an ear for meaning.
   

 • Transcription, proofreading, or review background, ideally including clean\-verbatim work.
   

 • Fast domain learner — able to absorb a new subject or style guide and teach it clearly within days, not weeks.
   

 • A coaching instinct — patient, structured, and able to give feedback that actually changes behaviour.
   

 • Detail\-obsessed — comfortable holding a quality standard and working to measurable accuracy targets.
   

  

 Nice to have:
   

 • Exposure to US legal / court transcription conventions — verbatim vs. non\-verbatim, speaker labels, bracketed notation (\[phonetic], \[indiscernible]), and numeral/formatting rules.
   

 • Hands\-on experience with TranscribeMe (or Rev, GoTranscript, Verbit, etc.) as a transcriber or reviewer.
   

 • Experience handling varied English accents (US, UK, Australian, Indian) and difficult audio.
   

 • Prior experience standing up training for a new or scaling team.
   

  

 Success in the first 90 days:
   

 • New reviewers reliably reach production accuracy within the defined ramp window.
   

 • A documented house style guide, training deck, and certification test are live.
   

 • At least one internal Senior Reviewer cohort is trained and holding the standard independently.

title: SAP Basis-Senior
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**EY GDS CONSULTING – SAP BASIS SENIOR**
 At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
   

  

 We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
   

  

 Join EY and help to build a better working world.
   

  

**About Global Delivery Services**
 Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
   

  

 Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000\+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
   

  

 Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy \& Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high\-quality, value\-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
   

  

 Enablement Services provides cost\-effective, high\-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
   

  

 Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 As a Senior SAP BASIS Specialist, you will be responsible for managing and optimizing our SAP BASIS infrastructure and operations. This senior role offers you the opportunity to ensure system stability, security, and high performance across complex SAP landscapes.
   

  

 You will work closely with IT teams, functional consultants, and business stakeholders to implement best practices, troubleshoot complex technical issues, and support system upgrades, patches, and migrations. Your expertise will be essential in maintaining system health, ensuring compliance with IT policies, and supporting disaster recovery and business continuity efforts.
   

  

 In this role, you will also provide guidance and mentorship to junior BASIS team members, fostering knowledge sharing and professional growth. You will be part of a collaborative team that values technical excellence and innovation, delivering reliable SAP BASIS services to support business operations
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Responsible for decision\-making, optimizing processes, resource management, and overseeing team management as needed for task execution.
* Accountable for allocating personnel, supervising team members, assigning tasks, ensuring that the team has the necessary tools and support to succeed in their roles and optimizing and evaluating their performance to meet organizational goals.
* Performance monitoring \& tuning, Problem analysis \& resolution, and other activities required to maintain system integrity SAP administration on UNIX \& Windows
* System /System copy
* ABAP \+ Java\-dual stack
* Add\-on and Support Pack application and troubleshooting
* Kernel Upgrade
* Client copies and export\-import
* TMS administration and configuration and troubleshooting Transport errors
* SAP system monitoring and thorough analysis of issues
* SAP parameter change, operation mode setup, Logon group setup
* SAP Role based Authorization knowledge \- Role creation and modification
* Spool administration and troubleshooting spool/printer issues
* OSS Note application
* Experience in Single \-Sign On, Web Dispatcher
* Experience in working SAP on public cloud and private cloud.
* Experience in working with cloud service providers like AWS, Azure and GCP.
* SAP Solution Manager experience with basic and advanced configuration.
* Hands\-on experience with SAP user provisioning, authorization troubleshooting, and role assignments.
* Basic knowledge of OS/DB migration processes.
* Familiarity with Web Dispatcher, Gateway, and SAP integration components.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Should have 4 to 7 years of experience in SAP Basis domain.
* Solid hands\-on experience in SAP system administration, including installation, configuration, upgrades, and performance optimization.
* Should understand SAP architecture, transport management, kernel updates, and system refresh processes.
* Proficient in administering SAP HANA (monitoring, tuning, backup/recoveries, basic troubleshooting).
* Experience supporting landscapes like S/4HANA, ECC, BW/4HANA, PO/PI, Fiori, Solution Manager, etc.
* Strong SAP BTP knowledge, including key services, integration patterns, and administration fundamentals.
* Strong working experience with RISE with SAP environments and operational activities.
* Strong documentation skills for system delivery, ensuring clear, structured, and audit‑ready technical documentation.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to interact effectively with clients and stakeholders.
* Knowledge of Solution Manager features such as CHARM, EWA, and monitoring.


**Ideally, you’ll also**
* Practical experience managing SAP workloads on Azure or AWS (VMs, storage classes, networking, monitoring).
* Exposure to SAP Cloud ALM (CALM) for monitoring, change control, and operations.
* Exposure to SAP Data Archiving with OpenText


**Certifications:**
* SAP Technology Associate certifications (SAP Basis or HANA).
* SAP Cloud Certifications (RISE, BTP, HANA Cloud, etc.).
* Cloud certification (AWS, Azure and GCP).
* Exposure to enterprise transformation tools such as Signavio and LeanIX for process modeling, architecture governance, and landscape documentation.


**What We Offer You**
 At EY, we’ll develop you with future\-focused skills and equip you with world\-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
   

  

 Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
   

  

 To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability\-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
   

  

**Our Commitment:** 
 As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
   

  

**Professional Development:** 
 From entry\-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
   

  

**People and Culture:** 
 In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
   

  

**Benefits:** 
 Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting\-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
   

  

**How to Apply:** 
 If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user\-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.
   

  

 Successful candidates advance to a competency\-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.
   

  

 “We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity \& Inclusion”.
   

  

**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.
