title: Lead/ Sr. Analyst – Business Research/ Market Intelligence/ Competitive Intelligence
description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.
   

  

 The Position
   

  

 Position Title: Lead/ Sr. Analyst – Business Research/ Market Intelligence
   

  

 Location: Hyderabad/ Chennai
   

  

**Job Description**
 Roche has established Global Analytics and Technology Center of Excellence (GATE) at Chennai/ Hyderabad to drive analytics \& technology driven solutions by partnering with Roche affiliates across the globe.
   

  

 As a Lead Analyst, you will act as a dedicated SME to Roche’s global business partners. You will transcend traditional data collection by integrating Clinical and Commercial Competitive Intelligence (CI), Market intelligence with advanced GenAI\-driven analytics. Your goal is to provide high\-level strategic
   

  

 foresight using established business frameworks to influence Roche’s global product pipeline and commercial launch strategies.
   

  

 The Opportunity
   

  

* Integrated Strategic Competitive/ Market Intelligence: Lead the end\-to\-end monitoring of the competitive landscape, bifurcating insights into Clinical CI (R\&D pipeline, trial design shifts, MoA breakthroughs) and Commercial CI (pricing, market access, field force shifts, and launch trajectories)
* Strategic Framework Application: Synthesize complex market signals into actionable strategies using structured frameworks such as SWOT, PESTLE, Porter’s Five Forces, and Patient Journey Mapping to identify unmet needs and white\-space opportunities
* GenAI \& Innovation: Architect and implement GenAI\-powered workflows (e.g., LLMs for rapid secondary research synthesis, automated earnings call sentiment analysis, or GPT\-based clinical trial summarization) to increase the velocity and depth of strategic recommendations
* High\-Stakes Conference Coverage (ASCO, ESMO, AACR, JP Morgan, Jefferies, etc.): Provide pre\-conference/ post\-conference impact assessment analysis of competitor data readouts on Roche’s portfolio
* Strategic Advisory: Transform market insights from public \& proprietary data sources (e.g. CT.gov, Clarivate, AlphaSense, EvaluatePharma) into "Executive Stories" that provide clear "So What?" and "Now What?" recommendations to partners \& senior leadership
* Predictive Intelligence: Flag "Trigger Events" (e.g., Breakthrough Designations, FDA/ regulatory signals, M\&A activity) and perform Scenario Planning to assess potential implications for Roche brands


**Qualifications \& Skills**
* Experience: 5–8 years of experience in Strategic Business Research/ Market Research/ CI within Pharma/Life Sciences
* Methodology: Expert\-level proficiency in applying Business Research Frameworks (SWOT, PESTLE) to the pharmaceutical lifecycle—from Phase I to Loss of Exclusivity (LoE)
* Tech\-Savviness: Proven experience or a strong vision for using GenAI tools to automate data extraction and enhance strategic consulting
* Commercial Acumen: Deep understanding of the Drug Development Process, including clinical trial endpoints, regulatory pathways (FDA/EMA), and commercial launch excellence
* Communication: Ability to influence global stakeholders through structured communication and data visualization
* Self\-Driven Ownership: A proactive "self\-starter" who manages complex projects with minimal guidance in a fast\-paced global environment
* Innovative Problem\-Solver: Possesses an agile, GenAI\-forward mindset to reinvent research workflows and tackle intricate life science challenges
* Strategic Influencer: Passionate about the "why" behind the data, using structured narratives to move stakeholders from insights to action


 Education
   

  

* UG: B. Tech/B.E./B. Pharm
* PG (Preferred): MBA or Masters in Life Sciences/Biotechnology


 Who we are
   

  

 A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life\-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.
   

  

 Let’s build a healthier future, together.
   

  

**Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.**

 **Claims Support Executive/Associate**

* Prepare and organize documents required for investor claim processing.

* Ensure all claim\-related documents are prepared within defined timelines.



**2\. Suspended Claims Management** 



* Monitor claims placed on suspension and maintained an accurate tracker.

* Maintain accurate and timely updates in client AIQ and other internal systems.

**Your IT Future, Delivered.**
**Technical Support Engineer**
 With a global team of 5600\+ IT professionals, DHL IT Services connects people and keeps the global economy running by continuously innovating and creating sustainable digital solutions. We work beyond global borders and push boundaries across all dimensions of logistics. You can leave your mark shaping the technology backbone of the biggest logistics company of the world. All our locations have earned the \#GreatPlaceToWork certification, reflecting our commitment to exceptional employee experience.
   

  

**Digitalization. Simply delivered**
 At IT Services, we are passionate about JAVA, C\# and mobile technologies. Our Self Service Solutions team is continuously expanding. We are looking for a Senior Test Automation Engineer. In our diverse environment you can always grow depending on your qualification level.
   

  

 We are working in an agile way. This means that our teams are completely product oriented, have end to end responsibility both for the product in development and in production. The same people not only take care of the application, but also of the business side of the product. The everyday work is typically organized using agile frameworks. This means the implementation of daily scrum, reviews, and retrospectives.
   

  

**Grow together** 
 .
   

  

 Our mission in Self Service Solutions is “We strive for a Business Partner and Product centric organization, that lives E2E responsibility by maximizing team empowerment”. In our team we are building a team culture with proactive E2E mindset enabling us as IT Services Self Service Solutions to be a competitive advantage for the group. We are responsible for round about 14\.000 lockers from DHL all over Germany. We currently have 3 different types of lockers in use. The Packstation Classic with its focus on Java, the Lean Packstation with its focus on Java, iOS and Android and the Poststation. The Poststation is a combination of a Classic and a Retail Store with a focus on C\# and React. Our test automation development is based on gherkin, cucumber, java and playwright. Like our company, our team is quite global. We have technical teams located in Chennai, Prague, Darmstadt, Berlin and Bonn. To help us collaborate better, we are using tools like Teams, Jira, Confluence or Mural. You will find a nice mix of motivated people, typically geeks who are passionate about technology and who are reading about IT, even after work. But most importantly, we are a team where everyone supports each other even in tough times and where every single member tries to make things better every day
   

  

**Ready to embark on the journey? Here’s what we are looking for** 
 :
   

  

 As a 3rd Level Support Engineer, you will be responsible for the technical operation, incident resolution, and continuous improvement of the Broker and LPS backend services. Working in an international environment, you will collaborate closely with global stakeholders, ensuring stability, performance, and reliability of critical applications. This role requires strong analytical capabilities, a high sense of ownership, and a proactive mindset in identifying and resolving technical and procedural issues.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

  

* Handle Incidents and Service Requests in 3rd Level Support for the Broker and LPS applications, ensuring timely and accurate resolution.
* Daily Monitoring the Broker and LPS backend services, applications and interfaces to ensure stability, availability, and proper system behavior.
* Perform proactive and reactive Problem Management, including detailed root cause analysis and preparation of both workaround and permanent solution proposals.
* Support the Service Owner in the preparation and execution of Change Requests according to ITIL processes.
* Participate in operational acceptance tests and rollout activities, ensuring production readiness.
* Execute smoke tests on various environments to validate service functionality and early identify potential issues before deployment and “Going\-Live”.
* Create ad\-hoc database reports based on Service Requests and operational needs.
* Optimize the performance of database queries and existing SQL reports, identifying opportunities for improving overall system efficiency.
* Develop and propose improvement measures for processes, system components (especially the existing PACKSTATION Broker applications and their interfaces), and operational workflows.


 Personal Requirements
   

  

  

* Excellent communication skills in English, with the ability to convey technical information clearly and professionally to diverse stakeholders.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving capabilities, enabling effective handling of complex incidents and identification of long\-term corrective measures.
* Self\-driven and well\-organized working style, with the ability to manage priorities independently while ensuring high\-quality delivery.
* Proven ability to work effectively in international, virtual, and cross\-functional teams, demonstrating cultural awareness and collaborative mindset.
* High customer orientation, ensuring responsiveness, ownership, and reliable support throughout the entire incident lifecycle.
* Resilience and adaptability when dealing with high\-pressure situations, critical incidents, and changing business priorities.
* Detail\-oriented approach to documentation, ensuring accuracy and clarity in technical guidelines, knowledge articles, and operational procedures.
* Continuous improvement mindset, with a willingness to learn new technologies, follow standards, and contribute to process optimization.


 Professional Requirements
   

  

  

* Excellent SQL and PL/SQL skills, with hands\-on experience in Oracle environments and in the administration and optimization of complex database structures.
* Very strong Java development skills, ideally with experience in maintaining and enhancing enterprise\-grade applications.
* Advanced Linux expertise, including system administration, troubleshooting, and performance tuning in production environments.
* Strong scripting capabilities (e.g., shell scripting, Python, etc.) to support automation, monitoring, and operational workflows.
* In\-depth knowledge of the ELK Stack (Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana), including log analysis, dashboard design, and performance optimization.
* Excellent knowledge of Global ServiceNow (Service Management Tool), particularly across incident, problem, change, and request management processes.
* ITIL 4 Foundation certification or equivalent understanding of IT Service Management best practices.
* Strong expertise in Oracle WebLogic, including configuration, deployment, performance tuning, and operational troubleshooting of middleware environments.
* Very good knowledge of Quarkus, including development, deployment, and optimization of cloud\-native or microservice\-based Java applications.


**An array of benefits for you:**
* Hybrid work arrangements to balance in\-office collaboration and home flexibility.
* Annual Leave: 42 days off apart from Public / National Holidays.
* Medical Insurance: Self \+ Spouse \+ 2 children. An option to opt for Voluntary Parental Insurance (Parents / Parent \-in\-laws) at a nominal premium covering pre existing disease.
* In House training programs: professional and technical training certifications.

* Data Extraction \& Verification
*

+ Discrepancy Resolution: Identify and resolve mismatches in the Database

* Data Entry \& CRM Management
* 
+ Real\-time Logging: Accurately input the fetched utility data into the company's CRM or onboarding platform during or immediately after the call.

+ Pipeline Progression: Move the customer's profile to the next stage of the onboarding pipeline once the required data is verified.

*

+ Handle escalations and ensure timely resolution of customer and operational issues.

* Strong communication, stakeholder\-management and leadership skills (Preferred)

 Support the VAVE team through product tear\-down, detailed data collection, technical documentation, and report generation to enable cost optimization and product improvement.

description:
**Vestas is a top company in wind technology and a driving\-force in the development of the wind power industry. Vestas’ core business comprises the development, manufacture, sale, marketing, and maintenance of Wind Turbines. Come and join us at Vestas!**

description:
Company Description:
 



 Altacit Global is an ISO 9001 certified and CRISIL Rated Law Firm with a strong presence across Bangalore, Chennai, Cochin, Coimbatore, and Hyderabad. The firm specializes in Corporate and Intellectual Property Law. Recognized by globally acclaimed legal guides such as Legal 500, Chambers and Partners, and Asia IP, Altacit Global is ranked among the top law firms in India. The firm is committed to delivering high\-quality legal services to meet diverse client needs.
 



 Role Description:
 



 This is a full\-time, on\-site role for a Patent \& Trademark Docketing Executive based in Chennai. The role involves managing all aspects of patent docketing, including filing and tracking patent applications, managing timelines for patent preparation and prosecution, and coordinating patent law compliance. The executive will also support patentability assessments and liaise with intellectual property attorneys to ensure accurate documentation and filings.
 



 Trademark Management:
 



 1\. Docketing and maintenance of records of trademark, copyright and design applications, status updation,prosecution, renewals, restoration and deadline tracking.
 



 2\. Monitoring of Journal Publications and reporting to associates.
 



 3\. Document handling and processing.
 



 4\. TMR Correspondence tracking and saving.
 



 5\. Client tracking and lead docketing.
 



 6\. Responsible for working and assisting associates.
 



 7\. Convey and draft instructions to foreign counsel related to trademark matters. Coordinates with different in\-house departments and supervise outside counsel to assure deadlines are met.
 



 8\. Performs searches of the Trademarks Journals and Trademarks Registries online database.
 



 9\. Support attorneys to prepare documents pertinent to oppositions, cancellations or litigations.
 



 10\. Develop and execute trademark portfolio reports.
 



 11\. The candidate prepares Trademark, Copyrights and designs applications for filing at the Registry.
 



 12\. Conduct through searches in trademark databases to identify potential oppositions to trademark applications. (Opposition Watch). Analyse search results and prepare detailed reports summarising findings.
 



 Patent Management:
 


1. Patent Management:Handle cost queries and coordinate with accounts for billing and invoicing.
2. File new patent applications via the IPO e\-filing and PCT modules.
3. Prepare and file all statutory forms.
4. Manage the Request for Examination (RFE) portfolio and amendment filings.
5. Prepare and file requests for addition/deletion of inventors, change of ownership (Form 6\), or withdrawal.
6. Follow up with clients and IPO regarding publication corrections, LPDs, recordal documents, and recordal status.
7. Track and ensure all IPO and PCT deadlines are met within due dates.
8. Handle NBA requests and ensure compliance with biodiversity regulations.
9. Maintain detailed records of filings, correspondence, and official communications.
10. Administrative \& Docketing Duties:Manage data entry and updates in the Docket Management System.
11. Digitize physical documents and organize electronic files systematically.
12. Generate periodic docketing reports and client\-specific status updates.
13. Coordinate with internal teams and clients to ensure seamless document flow.



  




* **Skills \& Qualifications:** 
 Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in any discipline (Computer Science, or Data Management preferred).
* Minimum 2 years of experience in patent/trademark docketing or IP paralegal work.
* Strong computer proficiency — capable of handling data management systems, MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint), and IP management/docketing software.
* Excellent organizational skills with keen attention to detail and accuracy.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to handle multiple priorities and meet tight deadlines.
* Understanding of IPO, PCT, and trademark filing workflows.

title: Technical Support Engineer (Customer Engagement Specialist)
description:
**Technical Support Engineer (Customer Engagement Specialist)** 
**, Enterprise LMS** 




**Location:** 
 Chenai
 



**Experience: 8 to 12 years** 




**Function:** 
 Product and Customer Engagement
 



  





**About the role** 




  





 This is not a ticket\-routing job.
 



  





 PeopleOne earlier known as
 **ExpertusONE** 
 is an enterprise learning platform used by global organisations to run compliance training, certification programs, instructor\-led and virtual sessions, and skills development at scale across tens of thousands of learners. When something behaves unexpectedly in an environment like that, the question is rarely "did the user click the wrong button." It is usually a configuration interaction, an integration payload, a permissions model edge case, or a genuine defect hiding behind three layers of plausible explanations.
 



  





 We are looking for someone who can tell the difference, and prove it.
 



  





 You will own customer\-reported issues end to end: reproduce them, isolate the root cause, resolve what can be resolved through configuration or guidance, and hand the rest to Engineering with a diagnosis sharp enough that they can start fixing instead of start investigating. You are the person who makes the difference between a bug report that says "enrollment is broken for this customer" and one that says "enrollment fails when a training plan has sequencing enforced and the learner holds a prior exempted module, here is the reproduction path, here are the three affected tenants, here is the query that identifies them."
 



  





**If you enjoy the puzzle more than the ticket count, read on.** 




  





**What you will do** 




  





**Investigate and diagnose** 



* Take ownership of escalated customer issues across the platform: enrollments, training plans, compliance and certification workflows, ILT and virtual classroom sessions, content playback (SCORM, xAPI, AICC, cmi5\), reporting and analytics, notifications, mobile, and integrations.
* Reproduce issues in test environments. Establish what is configuration, what is data, what is expected behaviour that the customer did not expect, and what is a genuine defect.
* Query production data (read\-only) to quantify blast radius: how many learners, which tenants, since when, and under what conditions.
* Read application and integration logs, trace API request and response payloads, and inspect webhook and SSO flows to isolate where a transaction actually failed.
* Distinguish correlation from causation. The most recent change is not automatically the cause.



  





**Resolve and communicate** 



* Resolve issues directly where the fix is configuration, data correction, workflow redesign, or customer enablement.
* Write customer\-facing responses that a non\-technical LMS administrator can act on: what happened, what the impact is, what we are doing, what they need to do, and by when.
* Manage expectations honestly on issues that will not be fixed quickly. Vague reassurance is worse than an inconvenient timeline.
* Run live troubleshooting sessions with customer administrators and IT teams including screen shares with enterprise security and identity teams.



  





**Escalate with a prognosis, not a summary** 



* Package defects for Engineering with a reproduction path, environment details, affected versions and tenants, log evidence, expected versus actual behaviour, and a stated hypothesis on root cause.
* Assign severity and business impact yourself, and defend that assessment. Everything is not a P1\.
* Stay attached to the issue through to resolution. Escalation is a handoff of ownership for the fix, not a handoff of ownership for the customer.



  





**Improve the system** 



* Identify recurring issue patterns and drive them to permanent elimination: product change, documentation gap, onboarding defect, or default configuration problem.
* Build and maintain internal diagnostic runbooks and customer\-facing knowledge articles. Reduce the number of issues that need you at all.
* Feed themes and evidence back into the product roadmap. You will have a direct line to Product Management and your input is expected to be substantiated with data, not anecdote.



  





**What success looks like** 




  





**By 90 days:** 
 You are independently resolving escalated issues across at least three functional areas without shadowing. Your defect reports are accepted by Engineering without a round trip for missing information.
 



  





**By six months:** 
 Your average escalated\-to\-Engineering rate is falling because you are resolving more at source. You have shipped knowledge articles or runbooks that measurably reduce repeat issues. You have raised at least two product changes that were accepted onto the roadmap.
 



  





**By twelve months:** 
 You are the person other engineers and CSMs come to when an issue does not make sense. You are trusted to speak directly to enterprise customers during severity incident without supervision.
 



  





**What you need** 




  





**Non\-negotiable:** 



* **8 to 12 years** 
 in technical support, application support, product support engineering, or solutions engineering for a B2B SaaS or enterprise software product. Consumer support and pure L1 experience will not transfer.
* **Working SQL.** 
 You must be able to write joins, aggregations, and filtered queries against a relational schema to investigate an issue yourself, without asking an engineer.
* Practical fluency with R
 **EST APIs** 
 : reading documentation, constructing requests, interpreting status codes and error payloads, and using Postman or an equivalent tool.
* Demonstrated ability to read application logs and trace a transaction across systems.
* Structured diagnostic reasoning. You form a hypothesis, test it, and discard it when the evidence disagrees.
* Written English strong enough for direct communication with enterprise customers in EMEA and North America.
* Comfort with ambiguity and with saying "I do not know yet, here is how I will find out."



  





**Strongly preferred:** 



* Prior experience with an LMS, LXP, HCM, or talent management platform (Cornerstone, Docebo, Absorb, SuccessFactors Learning, Workday Learning, Saba, or similar).
* Understanding of e\-learning standards: SCORM 1\.2 and 2004, xAPI, AICC, cmi5, and LRS concepts.
* Enterprise integration experience: SAML and OIDC single sign\-on, SCIM provisioning, HRIS data feeds, webhooks, and file\-based imports.
* Exposure to BI or reporting tools (Superset, Tableau, Power BI) and the ability to validate a reporting discrepancy against source data.
* Experience supporting multi\-tenant SaaS, including the reasoning required to separate tenant\-specific configuration issues from platform defects.
* BE, BTech, MCA, or equivalent technical education. We care more about what you can do than where you learned it.



  





**What we are not looking for** 




  





**To save everyone time:** 



* This role does not involve reading from a script or routing tickets to a queue.
* This is not a Customer Success Manager role. It is not primarily about renewals, QBRs, or adoption metrics, although you will work closely with the people who own those.
* If your last three years have been spent exclusively in a tier\-one queue with a strict escalation\-after\-fifteen\-minutes policy, this will be a difficult jump.
* If you are looking for a step towards a pure development role, be honest about that in the interview and we will tell you honestly whether this is the right path.



  





**How we evaluate** 




  





 Beyond conversation, we will put a real anonymised issue in front of you: a description,
 



 some log output, and a data extract. We will ask you to tell us what you think is happening
 



 and what you would check next. We are assessing how you reason, not whether you already
 



 know our product.
 



  





**Why this role is worth your time** 




  





 You will get read\-only production access, direct access to Engineering, and a direct line into
 



 Product Management where your findings shape what gets built. You will work on genuinely
 



 complex enterprise problems for recognisable global customers. And you will be measured
 



 on whether problems stay solved, not on how many tickets you closed.
 



  





 If you're passionate about troubleshooting complex enterprise applications and delivering exceptional customer outcomes, we'd love to connect.
 



  





 📩 Apply now or share your profile with us @swethav@peopleone.co

description:
Role Summary
   

 We are seeking a Data Scientist with strong Databricks and machine learning experience to develop, deploy, and monitor data\-driven models. The role will work closely with business, data engineering, and technology teams to convert business problems into scalable analytics and AI/ML solutions.
   

 Key Roles \& Responsibilities
   

 • Understand business problems and translate them into data science, predictive analytics, or machine learning use cases.
   

 • Explore, clean, transform, and validate structured and unstructured data from multiple data sources.
   

 • Develop statistical, machine learning, and predictive models using Python and Databricks.
   

 • Build end\-to\-end ML pipelines in Databricks for data preparation, feature engineering, model training, evaluation, and deployment.
   

 • Use Databricks capabilities such as notebooks, Spark, Delta Lake, MLflow, and Databricks Workflows for scalable model development and lifecycle management.
   

 • Evaluate model performance using appropriate metrics; perform tuning, validation, and error analysis.
   

 • Collaborate with Data Engineers to ensure reliable data ingestion, data quality, feature availability, and production\-ready pipelines.
   

 • Support model deployment through APIs, batch scoring, or integration with downstream applications and reporting platforms.
   

 • Implement model monitoring for performance drift, data drift, accuracy, bias, and retraining requirements.
   

 • Document datasets, assumptions, model logic, performance results, limitations, and deployment/release details.
   

 • Present findings, insights, and recommendations clearly to business and technical stakeholders.
   

 • Follow data governance, security, privacy, and responsible\-AI requirements applicable to the client environment.
   

 • Participate in code reviews, peer reviews, agile ceremonies, and continuous improvement initiatives.
   

 Essential Skills / Experience
   

 • 4–8 years of experience in Data Science, Machine Learning, Advanced Analytics, or related roles.
   

 • Strong hands\-on experience with Databricks and Apache Spark/PySpark.
   

 • Strong Python experience, including Pandas, NumPy, Scikit\-learn and relevant ML libraries.
   

 • Experience developing classification, regression, clustering, forecasting, NLP, or recommendation models.
   

 • Experience with SQL and large\-scale data processing.
   

 • Hands\-on experience with MLflow, model versioning, experiment tracking, and model deployment is preferred.
   

 • Understanding of Delta Lake, data lake/lakehouse concepts, and cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or GCP.
   

 • Experience with Git, CI/CD, APIs, and MLOps practices is desirable.
   

 • Good stakeholder communication and ability to explain model outcomes in simple business terms.
   

 Preferred / Good to Have
   

 • Databricks certification.
   

 • Experience with Azure Databricks, Azure ML, AWS SageMaker, or similar platforms.
   

 • Experience in regulated industries, healthcare, medical devices, pharma, or data privacy\-sensitive environments.
   

 • Knowledge of Responsible AI, explainability, bias assessment, and model governance.
   

 • Experience with Power BI/Tableau for insight visualization.

 Lloyd’s List Intelligence are the trusted experts delivering transparent and actionable maritime data empowering 60,000 professionals around the globe to make confident decisions that drive the safe, efficient, and lawful movement of trade by sea. Our advanced analytics, artificial intelligence, and industry expertise transform our unparalleled data into unique insight delivered through data and analytics services, news and commentary, and publications.
   

  

 Our global teams span data and analytics, product management, editorial and market analysis, technology, marketing, sales, and customer success.
   

  

 Role Profile
   

  

 The Data Quality Analyst is responsible for improving the quality, consistency, and reliability of data across Salesforce and related business systems, helping to ensure reporting, dashboards, and business decisions are based on trusted information.
   

  

 The successful candidate will be a detail\-oriented, business\-minded data professional with strong analytical and problem\-solving skills. Working closely with stakeholders across the business, they will identify data quality issues, carry out data cleansing and validation activities, monitor adherence to data standards, and support the ongoing improvement of data governance practices.
   

  

 The role supports the delivery of a structured data quality and governance programme, initially focused on core Salesforce data and related business systems. Responsibilities include monitoring data quality, investigating and resolving issues, identifying opportunities for improvement, and helping to establish trusted datasets that underpin reporting and analytics across the organisation. Over time, the role will also support data enrichment initiatives that improve the completeness, accuracy, and value of business information.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Maintain and improve the quality, accuracy, completeness, and consistency of data across Salesforce and related business systems.
* Execute data cleansing, validation, and correction activities to resolve data quality issues and improve confidence in business information.
* Monitor data quality metrics and investigate trends, recurring issues, and process gaps.
* Work with business stakeholders to identify data quality issues, prioritise improvements, and support the adoption of data standards and governance processes.
* Perform data audits and quality reviews to ensure information is fit for reporting, analytics, and operational use.
* Identify opportunities to improve data capture, reduce duplication, and minimise manual intervention across business systems.
* Support the development and maintenance of trusted datasets used in reporting and dashboards.
* Document data quality issues, data definitions, governance processes, and remediation activities in a clear and consistent manner.
* Support data enrichment initiatives to improve the completeness, accuracy, and value of customer, product, commercial, and operational data.


 What We Are Looking For
   

  

**Essential**
* Experience working with Salesforce data in a Data Quality Analyst, Salesforce Analyst, Sales Operations Analyst, Revenue Operations Analyst, or similar role.
* Strong experience maintaining, cleansing, validating, and improving data quality within Salesforce.
* Experience creating reports and dashboards in Salesforce to support business reporting and decision\-making.
* Advanced Excel skills, including data analysis, cleansing, validation, and manipulation of large datasets.
* Experience using Salesforce Data Loader or similar tools to perform data imports, updates, exports, and data maintenance activities.
* Strong attention to detail, with the ability to identify data quality issues, inconsistencies, and anomalies.
* Experience analysing data, identifying root causes of issues, and recommending practical improvements.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work effectively across business functions.
* Working knowledge of data governance principles and data quality management practices.
* Well\-organised and methodical, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver high\-quality work.


 Desirable
   

  

* Experience working with reporting and analytics platforms such as Power BI, Snowflake, or Adobe Analytics, or advanced Salesforce reporting capabilities.
* Experience supporting data enrichment initiatives and third\-party data sources.
* Experience working in subscription\-based businesses, ideally within B2B SaaS, information services, media, maritime, or other data\-led organisations.

**Skills And Qualifications**
